review_headline: I really did want to like this chair but sadly that was not to be
review_body: I really did want to like this chair but sadly that was not to be. Foolishly, I bought this and the drafting stool without first reading the negative reviews. Lesson learned. The Good: Very easy to assemble. With the included tool it can be assembled in 2-3 minutes. Color is  awesome, it's very stylish and makes a nice accent piece. The Bad: This chair is only marginally functional and it's also potentially dangerous. If you have short legs and a long torso, this is probably not the chair for you. I'm 5'10" and just shy of 200lbs. At its lowest height (about 18"), the seat of the chair is just high enough to prevent me from sitting comfortably with my knees bent at a right angle. For the price, I wasn't expecting an executive office chair experience but my thighs get fatigued after just 10 minutes sitting in this chair. This can probably be addressed with a foot rest or possibly a thick floor mat. The backrest can't be adjusted so, again, if you have a fairly long torso, the backrest is pretty much just for show. The Ugly: The plastic is very slippery and can easily scoot out from under you (especially on an uncarpeted floor) if you're not careful when you sit down. People who are elderly, disabled, or heavyset should be very careful sitting in the chair. Now that I realize how much of a hassle returning this will be (more on that shortly), I think the best thing to do would be to modify the chair with some non-slip strips or tabs or a non-slip cushion. Finally, forget about disassembling the chair to return it. Try as I might, I couldn't figure out a way to disengage the seat's gas cylinder from either the seat bracket or the base of the chair (without damaging it). This isn't the worst possible waste of $50 (well $100 including the drafting stool) but it will definitely be my last from this company.

Every time we moved it was loud and creaky and just awful.
Now for this product. I read some reviews that said it was so creaky they returned it. I'm a little short, so I'll probably get some stairs.
Overall I'm very happy with this purchase. It has storage space underneath, it's quiet, and gives my bed awesome support. Also, it gives a little wiggle room for a bed frame, although I don't know what additional materials are needed for that. Still, I highly recommend it.

product_title: Coaster Modern Metal Computer Station Desk Table with Glass Top, Silver Finish
review_headline: Great desk but takes some effort to assemble
review_body: I couldn't be more pleased with the quality of the parts and how well everything fit together. The shipment was incredibly well packaged and everything arrived in great condition.      For those of you who are not spatially challenged, (apparently I am), the assembly of this desk will probably be a breeze. However, if you sometimes have difficulties in assembling furniture, etc., you may want to look my review over before proceeding.    Look carefully at diagram #1 for attaching the sliders to the shelf holder.  The set up of the two pieces is not identical because the two sides are opposite each other (mirror image?) and if you just automatically turn each of the units the same same direction when attaching you will end up having to undo and redo the attachments. (Ask me how I know.)  When attaching the sliders to anything, keep in mind that the sliders can slide open from the top or the bottom, thus exposing screw holes in each side.  **Check often to see if the sliders are set to slide in the same direction and if they are both at the bottom of the shelf holders and further on, shelf tray frame.      For step 2, look carefully at the picture on the front of the directions (not just the diagram) of the unit you are assembling.  Make sure you can identify the top and the bottom and the front and the back of the desk and set it up so that it is oriented correctly.. The large square tubes go at the top and the 3 large round tubes are lower down in in the assembly.    The two large square tubes should be attached with the four hole sides facing to the inside and outside of the desk, and the side with only two holes should be facing up (this is the side that the suction cups fit on and where the glass top rests).      When you go to attach the slide out tray frame you will find out if you have put that unit together properly.  The tray / frame unit attaches to the top square tubes using the holes FROM THE INSIDES.  If you have assembled the square tubes with the four holes facing up, you can't do this part.  Loosen the screws and turn the square tubes so that the holes are facing the sides.    I didn't need the CPU holder, so it wasn't installed.      I really do like this desk and it seems to be made of quality materials.  All of the parts were there. I'm usually pretty good at putting things together, but this one took me much longer than I was anticipating (including a couple of do-overs). I re moved one star because I thought the assembly directions and diagram needed some serious work. Hope this helps someone save some time and frustration.

product_title: Sauder Deco Panel TV Stand - Black
review_headline: TL;DR: Great product, assembly sucks b/c things aren't labeled.
review_body:
TL;DR: Great product, assembly sucks b/c things aren't labeled. Pay extra attention to every single little hole and nub on the pictures to be sure you're using the right rod in the right place.

So the actual product is great. Looks very modern, is very sturdy, haven't had any problems to date (~1 month later). However, the assembly instructions suck. They mention parts by letter, but none of the parts in the box actually have letters on them, so you're left to try to figure that out on your own by comparing pieces to their pictures. That doesn't work very well when the only difference between some pieces is a single hole that appears as a (not even kidding) < 1 mm dot on the assembly picture. Some tips to make assembly easier:

1.) Before you start assembling things, go through and try to figure out which letter belongs to which piece, and label everything yourself. Pay extra attention to the number of holes in rods, the placement of those holes along the rod length, etc. Trust me, it will save you the headache of screwing the wrong rod in place at least once.

2.) The "Rear Panel" (sheet of metal with two holes shaped like eyes in it) has an up and a down that isn't mentioned in the instructions. Make sure the panel's metal tab that sticks out perpendicular to the panel is at the top, and that the end with 3 screw holes is on the bottom.

3.) Pay attention to the position of the screw holes on the bars when attaching the bars to the support legs. The bars tend to turn when you tighten the screws, and then the holes aren't facing upwards like they're supposed to be.

4.) The glass shelves appear to have a top and bottom that (again) isn't mentioned in the instructions. There is a subtle difference in the finish of the glass on each side. One side appears more opaque while the other is more like a mirror. AFAICT the opaque side goes down.

Anyway, once you get past the assembly you shouldn't have to worry about the product again, it's quite nice :) But for the love of god, if you move and disassemble it, label the pieces again to make reassembling it easier.

review_body: I wanted an affordable and practical standing desk that (1) I could move around as needed, (2) wouldn't take up a lot of space, and (3) had some storage capabilities. I was surprised to find exactly what I wanted at such a great price. Yes, the pieces are made of some sort of composite board covered with high end contact paper (hence the low price), but when assembled the desk feels very solid and the smooth finish has a nice feel. It actually looks better than I thought it would. Assembly was easy: the instructions were very clear, all parts were clearly labeled and sorted, and everything fit together as it should. I didn't need any tools or hardware other than what came in the box, though an electric drill certainly would have made things go faster. But the desk feels sturdily constructed with only hand-tightening. It rolls very nicely in my room, which has hardwood floors. The wheels have a bit of trouble on the thick carpet I have in other rooms, but it's doable (and needless to say it's more mobile than a desk without wheels at all). If I find myself wheeling it on carpet a lot, I may replacing the wheels with rubbers ones. In full disclosure, I got it for just under $50 and found it an exceptional bargain that offered a lot more than anything else in it's price range. I'm not sure how I would feel if it were at the full $75 list price.

product_title: ioHOMES Pleasanton Media/TV Console Stand, 60-Inch, Black Finish
review_headline: Looks Good, Decent for the Price
review_body:
I'm reviewing this just a couple days after assembling it and installing my components into the stand.

Quality
It is not wood it is a type of particle board. The particle board was not as dense as I thought, Ikea is more dense, but once the item was assembled it was sturdy and the drawers worked and looked good. One of the feet had glue that had dripped on the gloss black finish, but I just put that one on the back of the unit. To me this looks as good as my previous Ikea unit, but I think the Ikea unit would be rated a bit higher.

There is no real "cable management" other than three holes which can be punched out of the back to run all of the wires through, but the unit seems to have enough of a low profile that I can't see the wires on the floor behind the media center.

Assembly
Time: Took about 2.5 hours to build taking short breaks during the assembly
Instructions: All pictures, only drawback was that they didn't show which side of parts was black vs.unfinished
Parts: All hardware was there (screws, etc.), one hole in particle board wasn't drilled deep enough
Tools: No tools included, requires a hammer, and philips screwdriver
Suggestions: leave the hardware in the plastic bag until you need them. The plastic bag is compartmentalized and in order so you know which screws and fasteners to use based on the step you are at.

Shipping
Time: Listed at free, five to eight day shipping. Amazon shipped it in just a few days. Don't know if it was because I also bought a TV at the same time and the Media Center arriving early gave me time to build it so I could put the TV on it.

review_body: We have had this bed for now nearly 2 years and it is pretty much dead and I am considering how to replace/fix this. product_title: PragmaBed Simple Base Quad-Fold Bed Frame
review_headline: Not the best bed for couples but can be fixed relatively cheap.
review_body: May be good for kids but a lousy bed for couples. I had one of these beds, not from this seller but judging by the pictures the same frame. One of the weak points is the hinges. This folding four times means it has more of them making it even worse. These things are made of relatively thin steel and with the long weld ran along the hinge the steel is weak at that point from the heat of the weld and the metal thinning at spots because of the weld. Over time the metal at these welds will fail from adults being adults. Ours lasted slightly over two years. Also the wing nuts for the leg supports would periodically loosen and need to be tightened, I put washers and lock washers on them and this helped. I strongly suggest getting a bi-fold, one with the middle leg under the joint. I would also suggest making a small box frame with 2x2s under this bed to strengthen it for large people or sexually active couples.  This can be done for less than $100 and would make this a better bed at a cheaper price than most other alternatives in the under $300 price range as even most of the wood foundations are lousy beds for larger people.

review_headline: I knew this chair was bad news. The actual parts themselves are very poor ...
review_body:
From the moment I pulled the parts out of the box, I knew this chair was bad news. The actual parts themselves are very poor quality. The die casting/machining of the metal is not very good and the quality control standards are obviously not very high. The only thing that hides these imperfections would be the chrome. Essentially scrap metal with a shiny coat of paint.

Couldn't get the chair full assembled due to one of the inlets for the armrest having about 1/10 of the threading needed for the bolt to go in. The rest of the armrests didn't seat well and the chrome caps to cover the holes were fallout out (again, due to poor machining).

Without even sitting in it I can tell it's going to fall apart fast. The stitching looks like it's about to come apart and I haven't even sat in it..

This chair is going back because a) it isn't functional or built properly and b) it won't last. I've had my fair share of chairs over the years, and this might be the poorest one I've come across.

If you are looking for a chair that looks nice from a distance and will not be used, this might be the chair for you. If you are looking something functional, this probably isn't the chair for you.

product_title: Naval Signal Nautical Flags Transportation Art Print 24 x 36in
review_body:
This is a note I sent Art.com on Friday October 3, 2014

Dear Art.com,

My wife order the International Naval Signal Flags print from Amazon and shipped by your company. She purchased this as a gift for me.

Item #: 28600499942A

I do like the print. It is fun to look at but one of the flags on the print is not correct. The incorrect flag is for the letter G (golf). The correct flag should show 3 gold and three blue stripes alternating with gold on the hoist and blue on the fly. Your flag representation shows 3 gold and 2 blue alternating with gold on the hoist and fly.

The issue, if any, is explaining that this flag is wrong if showing this print. I taught for the Power Squadron for 8 years and hold a rating of advanced pilot with this group. Part of that education process was doing a show and tell with nautical flags and the importance even for recreational sailors. An incorrect flag can cause confusion if a novice considers that this nautical print accurate.

I would recommend that a note be placed on the print or at least on the advertisement for the print that the G flag representation is not correct. Of course the best result would be to replace the print.

Yours truly,
Bruce Stedman

product_title: South Shore Vito Collection 6-Drawer Double Dresser
review_headline: Furniture is a lot like other amenities on the market where you really get ...
review_body:
What should I say about this dresser that you probably don't already expect? Furniture is a lot like other amenities on the market where you really get what you pay for, and this is no exception. The instructions say assembly requires two people, but I discovered this isn't true. It just requires and a LOT of balance and patience if you feel like going solo. The instructions are in french, but the once you figure out how to interpret the hieroglyphic pictures on the first few pages, it becomes significantly easier. You'll probably scream a few times, find you are missing a few pieces, and realize too late that you have some mysterious leftovers. But in the end, you have a dresser that seems surprisingly lighter assembled than when it was in the box, getting hauled up the stairs.

Like stated before, you get what you pay for with this one. It has drawers that move, and it only wobbles if you push on it from a certain side, but aside from that, the edges of the drawers do not line up perfectly and the finish is basically just a white papier-mache that if a drop of water lands on it, it swells up that part of the finish permanently. It came with a lot of nicks and bumps, one big one on the top of the dresser and a few on some of the drawers. This thing nicks easily, and the finish is so thin that it splits to reveal the brown cork material that this whole thing is made of, so damage is very visible.

I considered calling the company to request some new parts when I discovered they had arrived damaged, but I never did. It wasn't worth the hassle it took to put it together, and I can live with a little damage on a piece of virtually disposable furniture. All in all, this thing has tons of space on the inside for me to fill the drawers. It's strong enough to hold up with my TV and hamster tank on top of it, and big enough that I still have plenty of counter space. For what I paid for it, I didn't get much on the side of luxury but as a starving college student who is already breaking the bank on tuition and books, this dresser does exactly what it's supposed to and still looks better than most of the cheap furniture in my apartment.student who is already breaking the bank on tuition and books, this dresser does exactly what it's supposed to and still looks better than most of the cheap furniture in my apartment.

product_title: Classic Brands Instant Foundation for Bed Mattress, Easy To Assemble Box Spring
review_headline: I think this should work pretty good.
review_body:
I just received this today and it took about 22 minutes to put together. I used a cordless drill for securing the screws and nuts to speed things along. Being a guy, I did not read any directions and had no questions or even issues as a result. This thing just couldn't be easier to put together. I bought the king size.

I rarely give items 5 stars and I may adjust my stars up and down as time progresses and I actually use the product.

I don't know a lot about different types of woods but I know a little. I would be very surprised if this is indeed spruce. It appears to really be more like cheap pine. Other than the screws and bolts I installed, everything is stapled. I wasn't impressed with the staples but I wasn't sure what to expect in the first place. I had two twisted up slats but with all the screws they are now flat.

I felt the cover was very good quality and very easy to install. The cover lays over the top and down along the sides. I thought at first that this was going to be a complete cover like a bag and I thought that was going to be a big pain in the butt.

The reason I got this is because my wife has restless legs and it keeps me up. I usually go out to the rv to sleep after a while of her kicking around. To help remedy bed movement I got rid of the cheaply made box springs that moved quite a bit. This helped with bed movement but now the mattress is 9 inches lower and my wife was a little pissed. I started looking for options online and came across products like this. With this product I still have a solid base and the mattress is raised back up to keep the wife's yapper shut. Even with the reduced movement when the mattress was just laying on the bed frame, there was movement enough to keep me up so we may go to a foam mattress that reduces movement much more. I mention the foam mattress because this foundation will support a foam mattress fully unlike many box springs.

The kingsize has two side pieces where the notches are and the slats rest and are screwed into the side pieces. Being a king size this foundation has two supports that are spaced equally up and down the bed running head to toe. The slats run across these two supports so that the slats get 4 screws each going all the way across.

I will try to attach some pictures but I don't know if it will work out.

The frame is simple and if for some reason it loosens up there are many areas where screws can be installed or portions of it can easily be repaired with 2x4s.

I modified my bed quite a while ago due to the poor support originally provided by the bed manufacturer. They only provided three thin slats going left to right with legs in the center going to the floor. I installed 1/2 or thicker (two pieces) of plywood that goes over these original supports and the new foundation rests on these two pieces of plywood so the load is spread out.

I rolled around on the bed and got some creaking. This ended up being the way the plywood was bending slightly while laying on the original bed supports. I may just use 3-4 2x4's across the bottom of the bed, from one frame edge to the other in place of the original weaker supports.

The immediate fix was to pry up the plywood and place pieces of cardboard between the supports of the bed and plywood. Again, this had nothing to do with the new foundation other than the new foundation was distributing weight differently than the previous set up.

product_title: Laptop Stand
review_body:
I'll probably really like this if I ever get it completely together, but so far I'm really seeing a great example of POOR quality control. When I received the package all went well until it was nearly put together and I noticed there were no inserts at the top of the left side panel, i.e,. part 1 to receive the screws to hold the lateral structure that the top structure slides up and down on. There were not only no metal inserts, but the holes hadn't even been drilled where the metal inserts were to be. I complained about this and they sent a new part out and this took 8 days to get here. Fine, I've got the part with the holes drilled where the metal inserts are to be, but the metal inserts are still missing! So, I had to call again and they're going to send the metal inserts out in the mail. Poor, poor, quality control to send the same part TWICE incomplete, or damaged!

07-26-2014 Update

Received a package today from RTA which had four cam locks and 4 cam bolts to rectify my problem with part #1 of this product. This is after telling two different people on the phone that NO it wasn't the cam locks or bolts, but rather the metal inserts that are at the top of part #1 to hold the bolts, machine bolts, that secure the lateral structure. There may be a name for these metal inserts, but it's not given in the parts list as they're supposed to be an integral part of part #1 when it leaves the factory. I suppose I could put some plastic wood in the holes where the metal inserts are to be and just push the bolts into that, but I'm hoping for a better solution and now I'm in no rush and will probably get a hospital desk for my purpose. Now that I'm in no hurry I'll just keep requesting a fix until THEY listen to their customer, get it right, and send the part requested even if they have to send another complete panel (part #1 with the metal inserts).

product_title: Furniture of America Allesia Dining Buffet Table with 6-Bottle Rack
review_headline: Nice Piece of Furniture, Took Under 2 Hours to Put Together, Looks Nice!
review_body: This is one of those times I almost wish we could give 1/2 stars - really - this Buffet is close to a 5 star item.  Just a few little things bring it down in my eyes.    Pros -  1. Pretty easy to assemble (I used a hammer and a palm-sized ratcheting screwdriver that uses those little tips - only needed 1 tip the entire time    2. Not including pulling everything out of the box (because I was talking on the phone with a friend AND entertaining my 4 year old .... this caused said emptying of the box to occur over the course of a 68 minute phone call), this took me 1 hour and 50 minutes to put together, also not including breaking down the packaging ******  see note on that under CONS *******    3. Everything fit together perfectly - just had to unscrew one drawer back to get the bottom to fit in the groove far enough, then once it was in place, I tightened the screws back up - perfectly!!    4. The doors and drawers slide amazingly smoothly for a DIY kit!  I don't know that I have another piece of furniture where the things that slide are as nice as this.    5. It looks really nice    6. It is HEAVY, so won't be tipping anytime soon    7. It has a reinforced \\"leg\\" in the middle of the base that you can't really see that adds support in the very center.    CONS -    1. Ok - the packaging for this was a joke - it filled both our garbage can and recycling can 3/4 full - that is a LOT of styrofoam and cardboard!  Yuck!!!!    2. The finish shows finger prints amazingly well and they take some pretty good elbow grease to remove    3. In a few areas (especially the wine rack) the finish is very thin and you can kind of see through it a bit - wish it had come with a touch-up pen    Overall, this is a very nice piece of furniture.  It will add style to any room, and it has a lot of storage.  It is a nicely functioning piece of furniture - kudos to the engineers who made it easy enough to line up the right pieces according to the pictures, and to put them together pretty painlessly - and everything worked!    Update:  To the other Vine reviewer who left a comment and then deleted it - No, my Buffet did not arrive smelling at all.  I had my family go give it a sniff too, and it has no strong odor at all.  I'm sorry yours does, and I wonder if they used too much chemical during the building process for the one you received.  It might be worth calling them to ask about it.

review_headline: How to make Ruggies stick when they don't
review_body: I'd like to address some of the conflicting reviews here. When I first bought Ruggies they were purchased at a big box store.  They came in a box with directions and had 8 rubber corners and 8 vinyl corners with adhesive on one side.  If you stick the vinyl corners onto the underside of the rug and THEN put the rubber corners onto the vinyl the product works like a charm. I've had them on a couple of rugs for months and the dogs don't go sliding anymore. The rubber corners do not stick by themselves without the vinyl on.  HOWEVER, when I ordered the product on Amazon the Ruggies came by post from China.  There was no box, no directions and no vinyl corners.  As mentioned, the rubber corners do not work without the vinyl corners.  So I can understand why some of you love this product and some think it is junk.  I found a solution by using clear plastic packing tape and making my own corners to attach to the underside of the rug and the rubber corners adhere perfectly.  It seems that there are more than one supplier of Ruggies on Amazon since some of you are getting the full product and some are not.  Hope that helps!

review_headline: Not bad, but certainly not great.  Lumpy and a pain to put away, but serves it's purpose.
review_body:
We bought this because it seemed that we were buying a new air mattress for the same price every time we had guests, which ultimately would leak air after two or three nights. This seemed like the perfect solution because foam can't leak!

First, buy this way in advance of your guests arriving. It arrives vacuum packed and it takes much longer than the stated 24 hours to "re-volumize", and I had to put a lot of work in after those 24 hours to manually work out the lumps.

Taking this out of the bag and "setting up", was very easy, but I don't know how those two teenage girls in the video put it away so easily. It's not impossible, but it's a pain, and if you don't get it right, then it's function as a bean bag chair is impaired.

Finally, comfort. I have had two guests sleep on this. Despite some lumps, they didn't seem to mind it the first night. Both guests chose to sleep on the sofa the subsequent nights. This is very plush and impossible to get smooth. It is filled with shredded foam which clumps together in spots and no amount of flipping will make it even.

Ultimately, we chose to keep it because it's actually a very comfortable bean bag chair, though way too expensive for solely that function. We are very limited on space in our apartment, so even though it's not the most comfortable, it is no worse than an air mattress. I'm assuming if you're looking into this, you don't have room for an actual spare bed, in which case this isn't a bad option... it's just not a great option either.

product_title: South Shore Step One 54/60-Inch Platform Bed with 2 Drawers, Full/Queen, Chocolate
review_headline: functional bed, but don't really like it
review_body:
This is a decent looking bed, nice and low to the ground to make your room feel a bit bigger. Assembly of the bed was about what you expect, if you have put together as much IKEA furniture as we have. Unfortunately it has a few flaws worth mentioning. The structure underneath the platform is almost like two separate structures attached together: the frame under the head of the bed and the drawer structure under the foot of the bed. If you attempt to move this foundation across carpet, even a short distance, the structure doesn't stay squared up. This is compounded by the second big issue: the platform surface is not permanently attached to the supporting structure. The bottom of each of the four platform pieces has big rubbery pegs to hold it in place when you insert the pegs into the corners of the framework. The platform pieces further attach (and I use the word "attach" loosely) with some little plastic sideways pegs which fit together.

The end result is not pleasing. What you have is 4 platform pieces that do not blend together seamlessly to look like a solid piece. If you sit on the edge of the bed they wiggle and flex away from each other and even if nobody is on the bed you can see the cracks between the pieces. They're not huge, but between the way the cracks show the light color under the laminate, and the fact that they're sharp enough to snag your pajama pants, it's pretty noticeable. We actually ran to the store today to buy black duct tape to run across the seams and then tuck under the edges. It's a serviceable bed, but it's the kind of thing you put up with until you can find something better.

product_title: Boss Traditional Executive Black Caressoft Chair With Mahogany
review_headline: the quality of the chair is poor at best
review_body:
This chair was difficult to assemble, an extra set of hands would be helpful.

Be warned, the quality of the chair is poor at best. Warranty virtually nonexistent.

The chair looks reasonably good. It sits fairly comfortably. This is about as far as the good points of this chair go.

I've owned this chair just over two years in light duty home use. The lift mechanism has failed and no longer works. The chair squeaks every time it rotates left or right. There are two places where springs (or what ever support is in the backrest) is poking into my back by an inch or more and is about to tear through the cheap vinyl covering rendering the chair useless.

The six year limited warranty is pretty much a joke. If you read through the slick wording and \\"exceptions\\" you find these components are not covered for six years. Upholstery materials, foam, gas cylinders, wood components and controls. The most you will get is 18 months. Read below the hoops you have to jump through in order to get a defective part of your chair replaced and you may feel that you have no warranty at all.

In order to get replacement parts under warranty, according to the warranty sheet enclosed with my chair, you must return the chair to the dealer where it was purchased. The dealer will send the defective part back, freight prepaid, the manufacturer will repair or replace the defective part and return to the dealer.

In essence, it is my opinion that there is little to no warranty functional warranty.

Poor, poor quality, Even poorer and uncaring customer service.

My advice would be to choose another chair. You don't need these headaches.

UPDATE: With the spring in the backrest making the chair uncomfortable at best and with the spring about to tear through the vinyl covering I decided to open up the backrest and see if there was some way I could fix the problem myself because Boss Chair would not cover this defect under their six year warranty since the chair is more than 18 months old. Go Figure. I thought, what did I have to loose? I might be able to fix a chair I'd otherwise be throwing out.

What failed. There is a spring that goes across the backrest in the lower lumbar region of the back. The side frame of the back is made of some kind of cheap half inch thick plywood. It certainly is not a solid hardwood frame. I hate to think how the seat is constructed. This spring is attached on each end by a only couple of light weight staples. More like staples you'd see in a household staple gun. No bracket, no screws, no mount, no nothing except a couple of staples to hold a spring that really has quite a bit of tension. The staples actually broke, not the frame, not the spring. This released the spring from the frame allowing it to snap out of position and begin poking through the backrest. With just a piece of thin cheap plywood to mount the spring to there is no real way to fix the chair.

Certainly poorly designed (cheap). How Boss Chair can not expect this flimsy mounting method to fail is beyond me. Poor quality.

After already being denied warranty coverage I contacted Boss Chair again along with a photo of what failed and asked again for a replacement back under warranty because nowhere in the excluded warranty items do I see staples. It's been three days and no response.

UPDATE: After days upon days of emails they have agreed to replace the defective backrest under warranty.

review_body:
After a considerable amount of research on mattresses, we decided to purchase a natural latex mattress from Ikea and an Ultimate sleep 3" latex topper. I can't even begin to explain how much we love this combination. Because the mattress is fairly firm, we got the medium soft topper, which adds just the right amount of plush. (We're average sized people. The medium soft may be a little too plush for heavier people)

Having slept on both latex and memory foam now, i have to say that latex is MUCH more comfortable. Latex rebounds immediately, unlike memory foam, which leaves a depression when you move. Latex is cooler to sleep on, as well.

We tried this topper on our old, saggy middle mattress to see if it helped. It did not. If you have a saggy mattress, you should not get the medium soft topper. Perhaps a firm topper would help in that situation.

product_title: International Concepts Milford Double X-Back Chair - 2 Chairs
review_headline: If you can get them assembled, they are great.  Pay attention to that word "if".
review_body:
I will start by saying that once assembled- if you can get them assembled- these chairs have the look and feel of something quality. Very beautiful and solid. I will also say that Amazon did a decent job trying to correct the problems that arose. I wanted unpainted chairs because I built my own dining table and was having trouble matching chairs to the color of my table.

If the chair arrives and has all the parts and hardware, it is very easy to assemble. If.

I give this product 2 stars because I had to go through 8 chairs in order to get 4 good enough to use.

Unfortunately I ran into multiple issues with the pre-drilled holes, threaded inserts, and hardware. On a couple pieces of the chair, the threaded inserts for the screws were missing altogether, but still had a large hole for the insert which meant I couldn't just drill a hole for myself. Also, the pre-drilled holes didn't always match up appropriately or were positioned such that the chair did not sit level. If the package ships without a single piece of fastener hardware- or you lose a piece- you will have trouble replacing it quickly at the hardware store because all the fasteners are in metric and metric selection is limited in US stores.

I will also caution you to be careful while assembling the legs and to always double check the "left" and "right" labels on the legs. On the last chair I assembled the legs were mislabeled and I got them glued and fastened only to discover that they were mislabeled and needed to be swapped. Another word of caution for legs is that sometimes the left and right front legs weren't the exact same length and required adjustment to keep the chair level.

The chairs are somewhat pricey, especially for a product that requires assembly and painting before completion, so all these things were a bit disappointing. For a less costly chair, I would be willing to take some flaws but at that price I am not. I would have rather they just send me the wood pieces without any drill holes and let me handle the hardware assembly myself.

And while I was very pleased that Amazon was able to overnight me replacements, I am now left with the inconvenience of disassembling the partially glued and screwed together chairs in order to ship them back. This is going to be a pain in the rear to do and I am not looking forward to it. That's a lot of work to send back a product they are going to have to throw away upon arrival.I would have rather they just send me the wood pieces without any drill holes and let me handle the hardware assembly myself.

review_headline: Sturdy, Beautiful, and Easy to Assemble
review_body:
This arrived in 3 separate boxes all on the same day. After shopping for furniture on Amazon many times, I'm always concerned that packages will arrive in poor condition or with missing pieces. I relaxed somewhat when I saw that the packages looked in good condition, although I wasn't able to open them for assembly for several days. Once opened, we found all the necessary parts, pieces, and tools intact and in good condition (whew!). The foot board was boxed separately, the headboard was boxed separately, and the rails and supports were boxed separately. All of the tools/screws/bolts/whatnot came with an extra piece, which was very handy, as we screwed in one of the bolts crooked the first time around, but were able to replace it with the extra one provided. That was a great feature.

Assembly wasn't too difficult with two people. It took about 1.5 hours for the assembly itself (2.5 hrs for us, because we took a dinner break before connecting the headboard to the frame). Once done, we hit the hay, and were pleased to find the bed sturdy and quiet. Overall, I'm extremely pleased with my purchase and the quality of the product. I will post picture soon.

product_title: Newport Sliding Top Bar Cabinet
review_headline: The instructions for the assembly were easy to follow
review_body:
I ordered this bar in vintage mahogany finish. I received it in 4 boxes, very well packed. All the parts were present and it took about 1 hour for assembly. The instructions for the assembly were easy to follow, however I noticed during assembly how cheaply the cabinet was created. the back of the cabinet was the hardest to assemble because it was thinner than 1/4" and prone to warping while being fitted. Padding tape wasn't applied properly during construction under the sliding bar top which cause one side of bar top to stick to counter surface with sticky tape. It took me 15 minutes to remove the sticky stuff with goo gone spray. In the back of a little slide drawer a little bit of finish was missing, but due to it being towards the back I decided to keep the cabinet. The whole cabinet was constructed with particle board so it felt like I purchased something from Ikea.

Also, the finish of the vintage mahogany is definitely not vintage mahogany. All my other furniture in the room is vintage mahogany and it's more reddish brown color. The color of this cabinet is more medium brown color, and it definitely looks a bit lighter than in the picture. I checked the box to see if there was a mistake and I was sent cherry finish, but the box has vintage mahogany on it. If you can get over these things, it's a nice looking bar cabinet. Due to construction and finish I decided to give this cabinet 2 stars.

product_title: Sleep Master Ultima Comfort Memory Foam Mattress
review_body:
Been sleeping on this mattress for about a week and a half or so..

So anyone looking to buy this mattress can pretty much ignore all of the really bad reviews. I was hesitant to buy at first but I went with it anyway, it's only 200 bucks right? Here are some counters to negative claims made about this mattress

*Strong chemical odor
This mattress definitely has a strong odor, you'll be knocked over by it the minute you open up the vacuum sealed bag.. Do as the manufacturer suggest and let the mattress sit out for at least 48 hours. I let mine sit in a spare room with the windows open/fan on for a few days. I don't notice any smell coming from it since I have brought it in my room and added sheets/comforter.

*Mattress is too firm
I think half of the problem here is people are confused about what memory foam is all about. Many people are basing their claim on their experiences with memory foam toppers or pillows. Obviously, there's far more mass involved with a mattress, so you're not going to get that pillow-like feeling. Note that while this mattress is firm it perfectly contours to your body, eliminating pressure points. If you're really concerned about how soft it is, add a topper.

*Mattress gave out after X amount of time
In my opinion.. If this mattress lasts me for more than 18 months I'll be more than happy. The thing was 200 dollars, brand new. I don't see the argument here. Top of the line mattress cost thousands of dollars.

After typing that last one I feel like pretty much any other grievance can be countered with just that.. it's 200 bucks!

product_title: South Shore Zach Storage Bed
review_body:
This bed looks nice, like in the picture... but it's seems poorly made, like something I'd expect from Walmart. Unlike another reviewer's statement, this bed does *not* come together in 1 hour, nor are the instructions 'clear and easy to follow'. I put this bed together myself, with an active assistant, and it took 2 1/2 hours. The instructions were puzzling, with minimal wording, printed very small. I've put IKEA and Crate & Barrel furniture together too, it's not my first time at the rodeo. In fact, I normally love the challenge of assembling furniture.

Unfortunately, we had two pieces (headboard and footboard section) that were damaged during shipping: the corners were broken off. Even when I was coloring it with the Furniture Marker (it comes with a furniture marker!), pressboard was flaking off onto our carpet. Also, black color was coming off on our hands during assembly. AND the headboard and footboard are only colored on one side, so if you're sitting on the bed and look over to the end, you can see the light pressboard color at the end of the bed! Why, South Shore, why?

Another piece of wood was splitting and we had to glue it back together.

The off-gassing is strong. It's been days and the room still smells, and I've got windows open. Luckily it's summer. It smells sort of like wood, chemicals and plastic, which is essentially what the bed is made of.

Instead of any sort of \\"feet\\", the bed has 8 small, square foam stickers that you put on a few pieces. That's supposed to protect your floor? It's so incredibly weak. They aren't even fuzzy on one side like real self-stick floor care pads.

If I paid $175 for this bed, I'd regret it. I feel like the bed was designed and manufactured with minimal effort and no attention to detail. It makes IKEA seem like Buckingham Palace quality.

product_title: Serta Midtown Euro Lounger
review_headline: Great couch, particularly for the money (plus an assembly tip)
review_body:
For the money, this is a great unit. It is comfortable, solidly built, and highly functional. First, it works as a simple couch, and you can either fold up the ends or not, depending on your preferences at the time.

It can also fold flat into a sleeping area, and/or you can fold down only one of the back sections if you like, providing a smallish sleeping area (like for a child) while retaining a sitting area for an adult.

I've seen several complaints about the tight spaces related to assembly, and I'll say that I think many of those folks may not have realized that the couch sections that were in the way could be folded up and out of the way, leaving clear access to the mounting bolts.

Yes, it's still a bit of a pain to assemble, particularly since the leg bolts are so close to the leg shaft that I couldn't get my electric drill attachments on them and had to tighten them by hand, but it took all of 30 minutes once I figured out folding the cushions out of the way.

Bottom line is that this is a solid, comfortable, flexible unit, and the price is right. Highly recommended.

product_title: Ultimate Dreams Supreme Gel Memory Foam Mattress
review_headline: Had to return due to massive pain
review_body:
I bought this based on all the amazing reviews. I truly have to wonder about the authenticity of some of these reviews after having had this bed. We let the bed expand for 48 hrs before using it. First night wasn't too bad. Second was worse. Three nights in was unbearable. Neither my husband or I could hardly move. We both had back, neck, and shoulder pain that was so painful it was just plain horrible. They suggest you use it for 2 weeks to get adjusted, but no way could we have survived 2 weeks with it just getting worse every night. People said this bed was a little too firm, but that is not the issue we had. The bed was too soft. You would sink right into it to the point that you could hardly get out of it and you could barely turn over. And my god did this thing run hot. I can't recommend anything about this bed. And returning it was no picnic either. Since I live near an Amazon, they didn't charge me to return it, however they did send a company to pick it up. The company was supposed to pick it up between 10am-5pm one day. Never showed. I called them and was told that their driver was running 2 hours behind. I asked if he would still make it that night and was told they would check with him and call me back. They didn't call back. I called them back after an hour and half and was told wouldn't make it and that he would be there the next day, same time frame, and would call me an hour before arriving. The guy showed up the next day, without calling first, flung paperwork at me and told me to fill it out. He was surly and stunk up my house even after he left. So that experience on top of the the experience of using the mattress was just wonderful : (

Be warned. If you don't live near an Amazon warehouse, apparently according to "Chuck", the guy you call to ask questions before purchasing, you will get charged anywhere from $50-$100 to return the bed because it's an over sized item even if you are a Prime member.

review_headline: Ok but make sure you purchase the right thickness for your floor type
review_body: I purchased the bamboo floor mat a while ago now for my carpeted home office. Thinking this would hold up better than the plastic kind that broke into pieces after a while that I had prior to this. And at first this is great but then I noticed that this began to break and splinter into pieces. Once I contacted the manufacturer and what they didn't advertise at first when I originally purchased is that you have to make sure you buy the appropriate thickness for the type of flooring you have. My mistake is that I purchased a thickness that was not appropriate for the flooring. So if you have a thick carpet with padding and want this type of bamboo mat, make sure you get the thickest version (5MM thickness will not work for thick carpet) of this as opposed to the thinner bamboo mats or you will have splintering and cracking. I will say that it is my fault in this case for not researching but this wasn't originally made clear when I first purchased. Anji mountain will not replace under warranty in this case either.

For those of you used to ordering or assembling the other common names in assembly furniture you'll be pleasantly surprised with Walker Edison. I will buy from them again.

product_title: Best Choice Products Bamboo Area Rug Carpet Indoor Outdoor Wood 5' X 8'
review_body: It seems to be fairly well constructed, so should last pretty well.  Wasn't exactly what I wanted, but that was really my thing.

product_title: Winsome Wood Sasha Accent Table with Drawer Curved Legs
review_body:
I really liked these tables, got 2 in total. My bedroom is very small so I wanted night tables but the ones that come with all bedroom sets are too big. i decided to purchase these instead and they were a little bigger than expected yet perfect for the size of my room. They look very sturdy and not cheap at all. For the price its perfect, I am very happy with this buy!

One thing I do recommend is to be careful with the assembly as you may easily damage the table. If there's a complain it would be that the assembly is a bit difficult. Other than that its awesome!

product_title: Sleep Innovations Shiloh Memory Foam Mattress
review_headline: Have had for just over 2 months and we love it!
review_body: I was worried about buying a mattress online as I couldn't see it in person before I bought it. My husband and I went to a couple of mattress stores, tried out similar foam mattress there, and decided to give it a shot.  The mattress comes in a box that was about 3 feet tall 2 feet wide. It was just awkward enough to need to people to move it with easy. Once we had the box in our room, we pulled the mattress out of the box. It is in a large plastic bag with netting holding the mattress in a smaller shape.  We removed the plastic and then the netting and maneuvered the mattress in to position on the bed. There was an additional layer of plastic that we removed and the mattress instantly started to decompress. The directions stated that it could take 24 hours to reach full height, but ours was up to the full 12 inches within 4 hours. I was expecting a horrible chemical smell, but the small amount was not enough to cause my asthma to flair up. We were able to sleep on it that night.  We are both amazed at how much better we sleep with the new mattress! It cradles your body so that you don't wake up with sore spots.  My lower back pain has gone away completely.  My husband and I are not small people to say the least and it has held up very well to over 500 lbs each night. There are no body imprints left within a minute or so of either one of us getting out of bed.

product_title: STRONICS Jumbo Folding Shopping Carts with Front Swivel Wheels - Red
review_body: I got this cart for my wife loves it. I would glad to say it was great.thank you.I would buy a second one also.

product_title: Colonial Rose 2mm Satin Rat Tail Cord 2mm x 200 Yards
review_body: Love this cord just one color of 14 different colors I bought. Still looking for more colors. The Ladies Love the bracelets made with it.

product_title: Bernards San Angelo Nickel Headboard
review_body: I'm happy with my headboard. It seems to be made well and arrived in good condition.It's nice looking and just what I expected.

product_title: Sofab Coco Sofa, Beige
review_headline: Good couch. Poor shipping times and packaging.
review_body:
I have only had this couch for a little bit, however, it seems like a comfy and cozy couch so far. For the price, it is a great buy! However, my biggest issues were not with the couch itself. Hopefully if communication and shipping are important to you, then you won't be thrilled. Before I purchased this couch, it was really important to me that I receive it by a certain date. I had an event at my place and needed the seating. However, the couch did not arrive until FIVE DAYS AFTER the estimated ship time! This to me is unacceptable. If I had known it was going to be this late, I would have paid for quicker shipping or had purchased a couch at IKEA or something close to home. I was not even give a "your package has shipped" notice until the day before it was suppose to arrive. Not only did it arrive five days late, but the packages themselves look liked they had been handled by a tiger. The two boxes were barely held together by one piece of tape, and looked like they were ready to bust at the seams. I am very very surprised nothing was damaged.

So overall...

Couch 4 out of 5 stars
Shipping 0 out of 5 stars

Hope this helps anyone that is thinking of buying the couch. And if you do, hopefully your couch comes shipped on time and in better packaging then mine did.

product_title: Zinus SC-SBBK-14NT-FR Smartbase Bed Frame Metal, Narrow Twin
review_headline: Platform bed, solid easy set up
review_body: Easy to set up. Does not squeack when you get in or roll over. Very solid.Would recommend it to my friends, can be separated into twins.

product_title: Sands Rug Company Chateau Bistro Premium Kitchen Comfort Mat, 2-Feet by 3-Feet
review_body: I like the mat but I was a little upset that FedEx dropped it over my gate in its wrapping. Not a box just a plastic sleeve over the mat! Luckily the mat was fine but only because my dogs were in the pool.

product_title: Best Selling Mission  Tufted Leather Storage Ottoman Bench
review_body: Perfect size to put at the foot of our queen sized bed, although I had originally planned to put in front of the sofa. It would work nicely there as well. Rich brown color,  nice storage area, very good quality.

product_title: Crown Mark Barlow Bench with Bicast PVC
review_body: These benches are very sturdy and look great. we ordered two of these for our lobby and are very happy we got them.

product_title: Baxton Studio Botticelli Brown Modern TV Stand with Frosted Glass Door
review_body:
I put this as a good value. Especially for the mid-century modern look.

Yes, your getting veneer over particle board but it's pretty good quality.
Shipped in two, 110lb total weight boxes. Very well packed, clearly conscience to possible shipping damage.

Important things to note.
First, you have to put it together. Don't underestimate this task. It's not hard to assemble, but it is extensive. Took me, one person, six hours. And then another four hours to "rig" the installation of the TV and stereo wiring.

I was worried about the drawers. I liked the four drawer design and wanted fully out of sight CD's and DVD's.
Happy to report CD's fit tall side up, so you can see the titles. Weight stress may be a factor but you can probably fit 200 CD's in one drawer alone. DVD's fit on their side also to be able to see the title. The longer DVD's fit two full rows deep, easily 50 in one drawer.

The center section was another concern. I was able to stack a receiver, CD player, DVD player and a tall internet radio
and get it all in there. But I could not use the shelf and had to remove a section of the backing to get a quarter inch more depth to be able to slide the glass door into place. I also drilled large holes, out of sight, along top of the backing to allow more ventilation.

Very happy, thank you.

product_title: Crown Mark Cheval Mirror, Brown
review_body: For the price you pay for this mirror it is worth it. It is very nice looking and was easy to put together, I did it by myself. You are able to tighten the nuts on the sides to hold the mirror in place as you tilt it. The materials are not the greatest but that is how they are able to sell it for so cheap. I didn't have any problems with the shipping. Nothing was broken when it arrived. All in all I love the mirror and love how it looks.

product_title: Signature Design by Ashley
review_body:
I am thrilled with these tables. We purchased two of these. Both arrived on time, in good condition, and beautiful. These are essentially put together for you. All you have to do is attach the legs to the shelf and the top/drawer base. These go together with two screws each leg, and an allen wrench. The two screws near the drawer are fairly challenging to tighten as space is cramped with only a quarter turn allowed for each twist of the wrench.

Packaged very carefully with no damage on either table. Highly recommend.

product_title: HomCom PU Leather Contemporary Parson Dining Chair
review_body: The chairs are what I expected and at half the price than other vendors.  Easy assembly.  Anyone can assemble easily.

review_body:

review_body: This was a great buy and so worth it. This works great and keeps my cigars in perfect condition. I only have to add water to it once a month.

review_body: THIS UP AND DOWN CONTROL WAND WORKS AS WELL AS THE ORIGINAL.  IT WAS A SIMPLE JOB TO INSTALL THIS PRODUCT.

product_title: Eco Hold Rug Pad 8' x 10' - 100% Heavier and Thicker than Most Rug Pads, Provides Extra Cushion, For All Hard Surfaces, Earth Friendly
review_body: This rug pad runs a little large but does it's job. The only problem, really, was user error. :-) Our ::perhaps third and:: final install of the rug on top of the pad was to use masking tape to secure corners of pad to the floor and slowly rolling rug over the top to keep everything squared up. product_title: Winsome Wood Folding 4-Tier Shelf
review_body:
Perfect for a small space. We bought it for a small nursery space. We looked around everywhere for narrow shelving that could stand on it's own. This is perfect.

We purchases the shelving piece as well as cream-colored bins. We are using the top shelf for childrens books and the second as a place for a sound machine and night-light lamp. It's perfect for cords to go behind. The bins fit well, slide into place easily, and are perfect for storing quick-grab baby items.

The shelf is true to size and sturdy. It took me --maybe-- 10 minutes to put together with a screwdriver. (Only 6 pieces to screw into pre-drilled holes). So easy. I had it all set up and full of stuff in a half hour. Love it already.

product_title: Flash Furniture Granite White Plastic Folding Training Table
review_body: Long, narrow and perfect for a buffet service.  Not fancy, but toss a table cloth on it and it's good.  You do need to unpack it a few days before the event because the packing material has a weird, pesticide smell.

product_title: Ultimate Dreams 13" Gel Memory Foam Mattress
review_body: Maybe I got a dud or something, but after three months of ownership, this thing is a brick.  While it was very comfortable for the first few weeks, it has since become a total nuisance. I see that it is not too bad when there is only one person in the bed, however, being a married man, that does not happen very often. I now have pain in my hips and back every day, and feel like i am sleeping on a brick. I was excited for this bed before I made this purchase and am sad that it has turned out this way.  Again, after all of the positive reviews, maybe I just got a bad one, but I am not happy with my purchase.

product_title: Grip-It Premium Cushioned Dual Purpose Non-Slip Pad for Rugs on Hard Surface or Carpeted Floors
review_headline: Good premium rug pad but shipped folded resulting in a crease
review_body: This is a good value on a premium rug pad however it had a pronounced crease down the middle of the pad that resulted in a visible line in the rug placed on top of the pad.  I had hoped that it would eventually settle, but I wound up trying to iron the crease out which is very difficult since the material wants to melt.  I will try this pad again, but if it arrives with the same pronounced crease I will not go throgh the hassle of trying to flatten it and will return it.

product_title: Bobkona Jaden Collection Vanity Set with Stool
review_body: Bought this for my 14 year old daughter - she adores it. Looks like a wonderful piece of furniture that she may have for a long time.

product_title: Lift Top Coffee Table - Washington Cherry finish
review_body: this table is so easy to assemble my 16 year old did it all by himself! If you need a good pop up table, this is a great option.

review_body: The chairs are flimsy. My friend who is 130 lbs soak and wet sat in one if the chairs and he leg bent inward

product_title: Omron Hj-320 Tri Axis Pedometer
review_body: Easy to use, seems to track steps accurately. Set up was easy.  I like how it saves the previous six days and how it resets itself after midnight each night.

product_title: Arne Jacobsen Egg Chair - Cashmere Wool
review_headline: Good chair for a child with modern taste.
review_body:
Purchased for a child's room with modern decor. Chair is solid construction for the price, however, it is a very rigid upright design ... not too comfortable for an adult female (5'6 130lbs), and the seat area is even more snug for an adult male. Our 9 year old fits great in the chair and thinks it's very stylish ... however wishes it tilted. (Our chair did not arrive with any assembly instructions or instructions for the "tilt" mechanism". The tilt feature is somewhat odd and not much of a benefit. If you loosen the set screw to try to tilt the chair back ... you have to use all your body weight to achieve a bit of a lean ... and then the chair will not remain reclined unless continued pressure is applied. At 130lbs ... the chair legs come off the floor if I try to tilt it and I can not keep it tilted .... the mechanism just pops the chair back to the forward position. The chair will basically "rock" back and forth a little if you try quite hard to move it with your body.)

This chair was delivered by an outside freight company. I opened the box and inspected the majority of the chair before the driver left ... everything looked good except I did find one damaged area once I completely unwrapped it. (Not a tear, more of a permanent indentation in the felt. Since the driver was gone and the chair was in the house ... I decided to live with it).

product_title: ErgoErgo (Orange) ergonomic seat
review_body: I love my chair.  It does take practice sitting in but after you build up tolerance it's like any other chair.  It forces you to stabilize your core and sit more upright.  Great purchase for those committed to working on their core at their desks.  If you aren't then you may want to consider a traditional chair.

product_title: Linon Titian End Table - Antique Tobacco
review_body:
Usually, paying this price would get you particle board furniture, but this was all wooden and very beautiful. I was really worried that they would arrive with scratches from the shipping, but the packaging was so secure that I would never worry about products from whoever manufacturers these.

The instructions were very clear and everything went in perfectly. There is no way to screw a nail through to the other side unless you did not read the instructions and grabbed the wrong size screw. One thing to note is that for me, a hand drill was definitely needed; it's easy to screw a screw into particle board, but not into real wood. I had a little trouble with putting together the second one, so a tip for future buyers - If the screw will not screw in and causes your drill/hand problems, unscrew it, take apart that section, and screw the nail directly into the wood to make a hole, then take it out and put back the connecting piece and try again.

product_title: South Shore Jambory Storage Unit on Casters, Natural Maple
review_headline: Sleek, low profile, with lots of room.
review_body: We just bought a 52" flat-screen tv and wanted something sleek to hold it and all of our related entertainment devices. The specs say this is meant for a 48" tv, but our 52" fits just fine, as well as the sound bar for our surround-sound system. The unit was fairly simple to assemble, just taking time to follow directions - my husband and 13yo son had it up in about an hour. We decided to leave the wheels off and are happy with the results. This is a very attractive storage unit, with a low profile, but still plenty of room to store things. We have our VCR (yes, the kids still watch their old Disney VHS movies!), DVD player, Roku, Wii U, Wii Fit board, and assorted games and movies stored nicely in this unit. I'm very pleased with the style and organization of this unit!

product_title: Walker Edison Soreno 3-Piece Corner Desk
review_body: Good desk, but the glass top easily gets smudges and shows dirt easily.  Easy to put together and it's sturdy, the glass is quite durable as well, I dropped the keyboard tray piece on concrete and it only chipped very slightly.  Great product

product_title: Oajen arm pad for office chair, fits most newer office chair
review_body: This was much cheaper than replacing an otherwise good office chair.  I just double checked the distance apart for the screw holes and all was good.  The arm rests appear to be of good quality (better than the original?).

product_title: Grip-It Premium Cushioned Dual Purpose Non-Slip Pad for Rugs on Hard Surface or Carpeted Floors
review_body: I really like how much cushion this pad provides, but it's difficult a little difficult to move the rug around on top of it to get it placed correctly. Once it's set it's fine. Mine came a little large(or maybe the rug is a little small) and it was very easy to cut down to size.

product_title: High Tufted Padded Hinged Storage Ottoman Bench
review_body: Looks great, only issue would be the feet are plastic looking and don't screw in exactly straight, but you can't tell too much once fully put together. Good value overall.

product_title: Tvilum Tucson 6-Drawer
review_body: I was hesitant to buy this drawer because it only has a 3-star rating, but I really like the look and it's cheap. First thing was one reviewer wrote that it's poor quality. No it's not. It's not real wood though but for a 6-drawer chest of that price, I did not expect it would be. If I wanted real wood, I would have to be ready to fork out about a grand. Real wood for this price, I would probably just get a small night stand. Second thing was that it was not easy to put together or something like that. Well, one reviewer was right. It felt like it came in a hundred pieces. But all you needed to do is follow the diagram. First thing first, group same pieces together. And then second, you assemble all six drawers. Each drawer is composed of about 6 pieces (the 6th piece is that gray rubber strip that looks like the light effect that separate the drawers in that picture they have) and as for the screws, consult the diagram. It's very clear there what goes where. Now you only have about 11 pieces to put together. And you don't even need the diagram anymore to put the chest together. And you have to be gentle when you start attaching screws as they're only composite wood. But once put together, the thing is really very sturdy. I'm not gonna describe what it looks like because it looks just like in the picture. Quite frankly, I enjoyed putting it together. All I needed was my hammer, screw driver and a cup of coffee. Let's not forget the coffee. It arrived pretty quick, undamaged, and with nothing missing. All holes and lines are where they should be, hence the 5-star rating. If the chest arrived with coffee, I would have given it one more star...

product_title: TUL BTEC 800 Big & Tall Executive Chair, Wood
review_body: I could not be happier with this chair. Very comfortable and yet the price was right as well. Some of the reviews said it was difficult to put together. Maybe a little tight here and there. I had no problems. GREAT product!

product_title: Office Star Resin Multi-Purpose Sqaured Folding Chair with Grey Accents
review_body: Arrived on time and is quite sturdy. I like it a lot. There seem to be slight marks on the table and chairs though - I don't mind them but I will get berated by the wife when she sees them. Overall, well worth it.

product_title: Casual Home Folding Storage Ottoman Microsuede
review_body: Here it is - for me. Wanted something to go with the furniture and be useful - this is it. It is sturdy enough to not only put your feet on but the kid uses it for his laptop table in his room so I actually had to buy him his own to get mine back. Love it.

product_title: Atlantic 94835721 Glass Door Cab Espresso
review_body:
This DVD case is perfect and a step above just an open book shelf for storing DVDs. Easy to assemble and yes it feels rather unsteady and flimsy until all shelves and the back is secured. It still isn't the sturdiest wood but it does its job. The wood on one of the window panels looks like it had cracked in manufacturing as was glued back together but isn't too noticeable unless looking up close.
The center shelf is unmovable making at least two shelves unable to hold regular DVDs (laying down) but there was still more than enough space for my collection. If you like your DVDs standing up then you won't use two of the shelves provided. In summary that leaves 4 shelves for regular DVD's standing upright and I used the two shelves that are narrower to lay the blu-rays on. A row can hold approx. 48 regular DVDs.
Overall, great looking DVD case that really holds a lot more movies than expected. Would recommend and would purchase again.

product_title: Coaster Home Furnishings  Traditional 3 Piece Metal Vanity Table Stool Mirror Set - Pewter / Ivory Fabric
review_body: Like the other reviews said, it's not a childrens vanity. It worked perfect for me, large enough for my products but small enough that it's not a waste of space. Chair is sturdy and comfortable, I've got fairly wide hips and I've got plenty of room when sitting. It's beautiful. I didn't want to spend the $ for the expensive ones even the ikea hacks are far more costly.

product_title: Tuft & Needle Mattress
review_headline: It's True! Great Mattress! Great Value!
review_body: It's hard to believe that I paid so little for this great mattress. I would not have risked purchasing it if it weren't for the the extended, full-money-back trial period. The mattress is light weight, odor free, cool and relatively thin (I carried this mattress up a spiral staircase by myself with almost no effort at all.). It is, at the very least, just as comfortable as any premium mattress that I have ever slept on in the past.  The manufacturer sent me a reminder several weeks after purchase. They reminder suggested that I was welcome to deploy the return policy if I felt I needed to. Of course, they know I am as happy as a clam. All I can say is, Wow!

product_title: Wooden Clip-On Armchair Table with Protective Lip
review_body: Nicely made, but one of my couches hard arms too wide, and the other too slim. Had to return them.

product_title: Mid Back Mesh Ergonomic Computer Desk Office Chair
review_body: The look is terrific. The comfort is good. Adjust-ability is ok - not like you'd find in a well equipped commercial office today. My son and I shopped all the office, big box stores and decided on this chair due to price and looks. It won't disappoint if you are looking for a chair used for 3-4 hours, you are of normal size and your desktop is no higher than 32".

product_title: Stockport Corner Desk in Classic Black
review_body: I was so excited to get this desk. It arrived, noticed most of the pieces had slight scratches, small dents, and then the top of the desk had a huge crack from one side of the table to the other. I was really excited to get this desk and extremely bummed it was cracked in half. I ordered a replacement from Amazon, everything is going smooth so far, UPS came and picked up the old desk, & I should receive the new one within the next 5 days. this desk took a few days before I ship, even with prime you should expect 5 or so days before getting it. The packaging on the desk is really poorly done, no wonder it was snapped in half. I will update this review when I get my replacement desk.

product_title: Kids Table and Chairs
review_body: My 2 year old granddaughter loves it. We opened it at her birthday party, and assembled it together. She immediately sat down and got busy putting her favorite monkey toy into the secret compartment.

product_title: Multiple Colors - 2 Piece Regency Manor Microfiber Bath Rug Set - Brown/Taupe
review_body: These are a little on the cheap side, but they were very cheap. However, they look great and definitely get the job done. Also it's very useful that it's a matching set.

product_title: Best Selling | Storage Ottoman | Coffee Table | Square Shaped | Premium Bonded Leather in Espresso Brown
review_headline: Do not buy this piece of crap!
review_body: I should have known when I took it out of the box and it had plastic legs it was going to be bad. If this thing is real leather I am a monkeys uncle. Three weeks in my house and I see a tear in the \\"leather\\".  The one it replaced was in my house for 8 years and never had a rip. I have no pets. The material is paper thin and could tear just vy looking at it to hard. I am still pissed.

product_title: Dorel Home Products Bentwood Round Chairs, Set of 2
review_body:
I received these chairs last week, and spent 2.5 hours trying to build them until I finally called DHP customer service (which took almost 25 minutes to connect to) and then found out I'd been sent a defective model which is why I was having trouble building this. I asked for a replacement and BIG mistake. The second time around I got a second set of defective chairs. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!! This is the worst Amazon experience I've ever had with any product.

product_title: Flash Furniture Vibrant Apple Green and Chrome Computer Task Chair with Tractor Seat
review_body: For the price, it's actually nicer than I expected. Simple to put together as well, maybe only two screws. Only took a couple of minutes. It's also pretty comfortable for your average desk/computer work. Not sure about sitting in this thing all day, but it feels good for normal use. Goes great with the LumiSource B Sigma Workstation desk.

product_title: Frenchi Home Furnishing Large Size Portable Laptop Desk Stand Foldable Legs, Black
review_body: I have coats and various other clothes which occasionally need hanging. Thus, a coat rack was in order. It was either this or staple my clothes to the wall. I think I chose well. Plus, it looks pretty darn spiffy.

product_title: Coaster Kitchen Carts Serving Cart with 2 Black Glass Shelves
review_body: Too cheesey...... is that a word? too many parts etc Not sturdy enough for my tastes. Spent more $$$ and bought the wood one with mirrored top :)

product_title: Portland 10-Inch Inner Spring Futon Sofa/Sleeper Bed, Queen, Black Arms Suede Khaki Upholstery
review_headline: Good buy though a bit overpriced
review_body: This has proven to be a good sleeper sofa/futon. We've used it for both and it's comfortable though the cushion slips easily. It does take two people to change it from the sofa to a bed. Worth the money though you can probably find something cheaper online that's just as good.

product_title: Folding Step Stool 15 Inch with Anti Slip Dots
review_body: Love this stool. It's a little higher than other stools like this, which I love. It's just the right size. Also, very sturdy and easily packs away neatly.

product_title: Simpli Home Acadian Entryway Storage Cabinet
review_body: Came to us in very rough shape. The packing box was damaged and one of the pieces was broken. My handyman husband was able to repair it. We thought shipping it back and receiving a replacement would not improve the purchase. The pieces were covered in saw dust and needed a thorough vacuuming before assembly. Two of the screws were damaged and unusable. Once put together it is acceptable in appearance and will meet our needs. I would not recommend this item to anyone else, unless they are really handy and not daunted by the problems we faced.

product_title: Rolland Office Chair Caster Wheel for Hardwood Floor - Stem Diameter: 11mm, Stem Length: 22mm - 5 Unit/Pack
review_headline: Leaving white spots on my floor
review_body: I ordered these so that I wouldn't damage my wood floors.  Within a month I have started seeing little white spots on my floor under my chair.  I am ordering a rug.  The seller however was quick and efficient.

product_title: South Shore Cosmos Collection Full-Size Captain's Bed
review_headline: Follow my tips and you won't be disappointed.
review_body:
I see negative reviews and I'm surprised! This came quickly, and once constructed is solid. I'm a 230lbs man, and my girlfriend is around 107, and together on the bed it holds firm and there is no indication of give. I did read reviews complain of creaking. I have two tips when ordering this bed.

review_headline: I Should Have Bought an Aeron.
review_body:
I bought this chair because I wanted to save $660, just like everyone else that is on this product page. We all looked at all the open mesh seat and back chairs on the market, and decided that this is the second best option, because the best is just way too expensive.

This chair lasted about 6 months before it started to fail. The retaining band that holds the fabric to the frame was never fully riveted at the top left of the back, so that almost instantly gave way. Then the fabric started to tare at the back of the seat, and a few months later the left side of the seat started to tear. All this leads to the seat completely failing to support my posterior.

There isn't any lumbar support. The back of the chair starts just bellow my shoulder blades and then takes a sharp bend backwards mid way down, leaving absolutely nothing for any kind of support. You would have to sit so far back in the seat that you would hang off the end of it.

The seat left no cushion, no give. It felt like sitting on top a 4' concrete drainage pipe, and that was before the failures.

The construction of the chairs frame is thick steel, causing it to weigh a ludicrous amount.

All but one wheel failed, causing me to spend more money.

I am 6'5", 230lbs, I sit gently, and used this chair for 6 hours each day. The $900 price tag on an Aeron is hard to stomach, but so is the $1140 price tag for the Aeron, this chair and its replacement castors. Do you really want to save yourself a few hundred dollars? Then avoid this chair, and buy an Aeron, or just avoid this chair and take some other gamble.

My bum is on an Aeron, and it feels good - real good. What's your bum on?

review_headline: No more "thundering herd" on the stairs.
review_body: We have two cats that aren't all that big.  One weighs 10 lbs., and the other 11 lbs., but when they come running down the wooden stairs, the sound used to be pretty impressive due to some acoustical quirks of our home.  We heard not the \\"pitter-patter of little feet\\" but something far more alarming.  It made us laugh the first time we realized it was just the two cats, but it quickly became a little annoying.  These carpet stair treads look pretty nice on the stairs and really do stay put pretty well by themselves in spite of the two cats and the two of us.  We did use double-stick carpet tape on a few stairs but left the others unsecured to see how well that worked out, and as stated, it worked just fine. Haven't had to tape the others, but probably will if we have a lot of guests for a particular occasion, just as a precaution.  (Some of our friends are even older than we are.) We have a lot of stairs in a mostly vertical townhouse. Two flights which are used a lot less often are carpeted completely as they have no risers, but we used these on the stairs with risers after we'd removed the old carpeting, which had gotten pretty worn. review_body: Easy to put together, fold nice and flat. product_title: Shaw Living Accents Rug in Lima Pattern
review_body: The colors are perfect and I love the little bit of black.  The size is great for inside the front door.

product_title: Cabrillo Counter Height Chair Set of 2
review_body:
I am an avid online furniture shopper. I have bought most of my furniture online. These arrived earlier than expected, well packed, all parts are good. Everything went together very easily (but we're also very good at installing stuff as we're always buying stuff that needs installation! ;))
