product_title: 2 x Acrylic Hydraulic Lift Adjustable Counter Bar Stool Dining Chair Clear -Pack of 2 (2013)
review_body:

with parts that came with the kit. Very nice surface, simple pull out drawer.

review_body: Excellent buy for the money.  I've seen chairs of this quality for 2 to 3 times the money.  The seat is a little bit hard, but not so hard that it's uncomfortable.  One gripe....the seat cushion is not leather on both sides, so it cannot be reversed.  I always reverse cushions to save on wear and tear. product_title: SEI Classic Medium-Mahogany Desk with 2 Drawers and Keyboard Tray
review_headline: Handsome computer desk at great price
review_body: This good-looking solid wood SEI computer desk was exactly what I was looking for to replace our old heavy pressed wood desk.  I was very pleased with the medium mahogany finish, a warm reddish brown that closely matches our artisan collection furniture pieces that were labeled as light oak, but are more in the mahogany/cherry family (the furniture co. probably created this artisan line so nobody else's products would match theirs, ensuring you would purchase their similar computer desk for around $400, not worth the price for this simple style).  My husband had no problem with assembly, particularly as the body came with all drawers pre-bolted on, so it basically just needed the knobs & legs screwed in.  The 6"W side drawers slide in & out fine, and the flip down keyboard drawer at 19"W is a perfect size for our keyboard, with enough room for the mouse & pad right in front of it.  We have this desk in the far corner of our living room as we don't have an office, and it's a fine size & height for both our computer monitor & printer, plenty of work space, and with the tower on the floor on the side there is lots of leg room.  If you shop around for this same desk online you will find that nobody beats Amazon's direct from mfr. price plus free shipping.

product_title: All About Details Turquoise Chevron Favor/treat Bags, Set of 24
review_body: I wish I would have paid more attention to the size of these bags prior to ordering them.  I expected them to be the same size as a paper lunch bag when I ordered, but they are much smaller.  I could have clearly seen that If I would have looked more closely at the dimensions :(.  Other than my disappointment around the size, there are no other complaints.  The bags are very cute.  I just won't be able to fit in all of the items I had hoped for the birthday favor bags.

product_title: Brookstone Pear Shape Bungee Chair
review_body: These are great for kids and dorms. They are bouncy. Adult game rooms too (weight limit is 225 lbs.) Colors are bright & cheery!

product_title: 7-Leg Heavy Duty Adjustable Metal Queen Size Bed Frame with Center Support Rug Rollers and Locking Wheel
review_body: We love it! It was easy to put together. it has a low floor clearance, which is what we wanted.

product_title: Zinus 14 Inch Elite SmartBase Mattress Foundation / for Big & Tall / Extra Strong Support / Platform Bed Frame / Box Spring Replacement / Sturdy / Quiet Noise Free / Non-Slip, Twin
review_headline: This bed can host a party.
review_body:
4400 lbs is a lot. It's very sturdy, sized perfectly for my Queen Size Beautyrest. I just got the bedding for it and haven't put the bedskirt yet. It is a 14" drop and takes a 14" bedskirt. Macys for example doesn't sell the 14" drop bedskirt. BedBath and Beyond had it though. It does slide around if you bump it with your knee for example and nobody is on it. It is metal to mattress with no box spring. None needed. Double check (eg. if your mattress is thousands of dollars) though whether or not your warranty will be honored ... make sure it has acceptable mattress support PER YOUR MATTRESS WARRANTY. I will troubleshoot the metal to fabric slipperiness issue when my comforter gets here. These are the small details, the big detail of is it sturdy is: YES, VERY. In my opinion it has plenty of support for your mattress, these are not wires they are wide bars. That doesn't mean my opinion matters where it concerns your warranty. Double check with whoever warranties your mattress. Share links to the item, send pictures, whatever you need to do in advance. An oz of prevention is worth a lb of cure. Right.

One caveat.. I thought I was in for more customer service chit chat because two rails were bowed pretty hardcore upon delivery. Just sit down on the floor and put your feet someplace on it and pull the edges (by the center) back into form. After a couple medium hard pulls on each side.. perfectly straight. When I say medium hard pull, I mean at least relatively strong man pulls. If you are female convalescent you will certainly need help. They are stronger up and down than they are side to side put it that way. But they are still pretty tough sideways. Yours may not even come bowed, I have no way to tell.

No need to panic just deep breath, bend.

product_title: Wobble Stool By Uncaged Ergonomics - The Perfect Ergonomic Office Stool for Active Sitting, Sit/stand Standing Desks, Bar Stool Breakfast Adjustable Saddle Task Chair
review_headline: I bought it to use with a standing desk . . .
review_body: I bought this to complement a standing desk.  I'm 5'10\\" and 190 lbs.  I converted to a standing desk about a year ago for back reasons, and am sold on the concept.  Everything is better from my back to my energy.  I was told NOT to stand all day though and to mix it up, hence the chair.  I haven't had it long but will give it four stars for now primarily due to it being as advertised.  It appears well built.  It feels sturdy.  It holds my weight comfortably.  In the fully extended position, the height works for my standing situation.  I would say that the greater the extension the less it can be used as an actual sitting chair.  The greater the extension the greater the \\"wobble\\" so to speak.  It works fine for me as a \\"leaner\\" I can use to take weight off my feet for short periods of time.  To actually sit at full extension I would feel more stable with a footstool.  The hydraulic function is great.  I can take it to a file cabinet, drop it down, and sit just fine.  The seating area itself is not that comfortable and can imagine it could grate on you sitting for long periods.  As a complementary device, so far so good.  If you want a chair, I'd buy a chair.

product_title: Morgan Storage Cabinet
review_headline: Very cheap particle board - inadequately packaged
review_body:
We ordered two of these for our dining room. When they arrived, we opened the (thin cardboard, unpadded) boxes, and BOTH were damaged - the flimsy particle board panels were broken. Figuring they were just mishandled during shipping, we returned them for replacements.

Once more, when the replacements arrived, the very first one we opened was broken - in almost the exact same way as the others! The fourth one wasn't visibly damaged, but upon closer inspection, the fastener holes are clearly not going to support any weight - they are drilled through something basically the consistency of sawdust mixed with Elmer's glue, laminated by paper.

I didn't expect these to be hardwood furniture or anything at this price, but this isn't even good for particle board, and with a 75% DOA rate, they seriously need to reconsider the packaging...

Once together, they look good and are really pretty comfortable. The stain was a bit darker than I wanted, but overall I'm pleased with them. I'd given 5 stars had it not been so picky putting them together.

product_title: Zinus SC-SBBK-14NT-FR Smartbase Bed Frame Metal, Narrow Twin

product_title: Miracle Caster! Extra Large Chair Wheels. 4" Set of Five. Great for carpet. Replaces chair mat.
review_headline: Easy fit and now my chair moves again.
review_body:
I replaced my old computer chair with one that was better padded hence much heavier than my previous chair. Lately I have become somewhat of a pessimist in that, when i purchase something that i highly anticipate to test out, something always tells me to await some disappointment. Well my comfy chair arrived and after some challenging assembly I was anxious to test it out. While the chair was quite comfortable, I was disappointed when the chair could barely move on my not so deep a carpet. Thinking it was the casters that came with it (since my old chair rolled just fine), I exchanged the casters with the ones from my old chair and to my surprise the chair was still barely rolling. It wasn't the casters, it was the chair, it was too heavy.
Miracle casters have made a world of a difference. The chair now rolls with ease. The wheels are obviously quite large at 4\\" diameter. I hope they are engineered to accommodate the weight forces the large casters must place on the shaft and shaft socket as the center of gravity is appears to be quite displaced. They do add some height to the chair but that is a little sacrifice compared to what the chair was. So far so good, I am happy. If you are having a similar problem, i suggest you try these.

product_title: Flash Furniture Vibrant White and Chrome Swivel Task Chair with Tractor Seat

product_title: Eurotech Ergohuman Mesh Chair - 18.1A"22.9" Seat Height - High-Back Chair With Headrest - Burgundy
review_body:
I was searching for an office chair to use for my computer and bought one of these chairs looking for something high quality and durable. Upon putting it together it has a nice design, and is comfortable, albeit a little small for someone like me who is 6'2\\". The seat of the chair is very tiny and only half my legs fit on it.

However, soon after I received the chair the seat lock began failing repeatedly and the lock would break a few times a day when I leaned back. I received a replacement from the factory but the same issue continued to happen even after expending much time and effort replacing the mechanism. I am only about 200 lbs and do not exceed the weight limit, the mechanism for the seat lock is simply of very poor design and it almost injured me. It continues to cause frustration as the seat can jerk back with a loud SNAP at random times when I decide to lean back - an issue I have never experienced with any other chair.

The headrest also feels like it's made cheaply out of thin plastic and isn't stable at all. Even the seat of the chair wobbles back and forth when I sit on it, and it's only months old. Unfortunately the entire chair is made in China and apparently not to high quality specifications. The build quality is exactly the same as cheaper bog-standard office chairs but for a much higher price.

I would not recommend it as the mechanism can break if you are anything more than extremely gentle with the chair, and considering the quality of the parts they could afford to sell this chair for half of what it's selling now and still make a profit. If you're looking for something high quality, make sure it's made in the USA and accept no substitutes. Or, buy a $100 Staples chair that at least doesn't break when you sit on it.

review_body:
I thought the recline would be a tilt, but is just 4 different positions for the back of the chair (no tilt). The one thing which bothers me most is the footstool. It doesn't fold all the way up, as shown in the instructions. Consequently, it continually rubs the back of your legs, which becomes annoying. so I removed it. As someone else mentioned, the arms are far too low. I give it 0 for comfort and build, 1 for reclining, and 0 for the footstool.

UPDATE: I've had this chair for about one week now. It gets incredibly uncomfortable after about half an hour of sitting in it. The back of the chair feels like it isn't attached to the frame properly. Any shift in position causes both the seat and the back to move, as though it was ready to fall apart. I downgraded my original 3 stars to 1 star. If I could give it zero stars, I would. Don't waste your money on this chair.

UPDATE: Shortly after posting the above review, a customer service rep from School Outfitters (the people handling the sale for Amazon)contacted me. The were very polite, and tried to help me by passing on my complaint to the chair's manufacturer. After reviewing my issues with the chair, they sent a replacement seat (no legs). I asked for instructions on how to separate the legs from the malfunctioning seat, because they were stuck together tightly. The response from the manufacturer was that there were no instructions to do that, and suggested I use WD40 and a wooden mallet. I tried several times to do as they suggested, without success. I decided to order another chair from Staples (HON PillowSoft Executive Chair). It was more expensive than the above chair, but well worth the extra expense. The difference between the two chairs was like comparing heaven to hell.

After my HON chair arrived, I decided to try one last time to separate the defective chair parts. This time it worked, and I was able to put the replacement part on the chair. The chair now works properly, but was still uncomfortable, so I gave it to a neighbor. I can't fault School Outfitters. They had two customer service reps trying hard to resolve the problem. The manufacturer, on the other hand, never offered to replace the chair, or offer any real solutions to resolve the situation.

I still stand by my original review, but would like to thank School Outfitters for the time they spent trying to resolve this.ut was still uncomfortable, so I gave it to a neighbor. product_title: South Shore Axess Collection Desk
review_body:
It's been about 9 months since I purchased this... desk, I guess you could call it. I never got around to it until now and, honestly, that's not a good thing for me. I usually only review things if I'm blown away or so disappointed that the thought of one more person buying the product in question keeps me up at night. As you might have deducted from my rating and title, the reason for this particular review is the latter. Anyway, onto the specifics.
I was going to rip it to shreds before i realized how much i spent on it, so I will only talk about the basic things that one would expect from a desk, regardless of the price, and how this desk managed to let me down with almost all of them. Also, the price has come down a bit since I bought it. I paid 100 dollars for it according to my Amazon history, but for some reason I remembered paying more than that.
So, let's start with the drawer. This drawer is comprised of 22 parts total:
Piece of wood x5
Plastic place holders x8 (on the ends of the side panels of the drawer, pointing each way one 4 to the back panel, 4 to the front)
Screws x4
Plastic pin-type fixtures x2 (holding the sides of the drawer to the front panel)
PLASTIC track on which the drawer \\"slides\\" back and forth. x2
Metal handle x1

Okay, so now that you have an idea of what I've been working with, now I'll tell you what it took to even get this thing to be functional, at least as a drawer. I started noticed that the plastic fixtures that hold the sides of the drawer to the front panel kept inexplicably slipping past the screws that held them in, leaving them still screwed in and confusingly ineffective. This led to the front of the drawer literally just pulling right off in my hand when i tried to open it. After I took the screws out the first time and then replaced them, but with the fixtures back under them, I popped the drawer back in its plastic track and went back to whatever I was doing, wondering what exactly would have made that happen. The hole in which the screws went on the plastic piece weren't broken or even stretched. Anyway, the drawer behaved properly for about a week, I'd wager. The second time the drawer came off, I had to know how it happened. It was like some sort of magic trick that wasn't anywhere near as impressive as it was just down right inconvenient. I figured out that the lack of support from the back panel was allowing the sides of the drawer to move freely, and usually opposite of each other. This was causing a sort of bend on one side and against the other, so I suppose the plastic hole around the screw just stretched so much that it just popped to the other side of the screw. So i tried to tape the back panel to the bottom one in hopes that the bottom panel would stop sliding back and forth which, I forgot to mention, would be the only thing keeping the drawer from bending around like it does, were it supported WHATSOEVER. It, however, is not. The first tape i used, clear scotch tape (i'm chuckling at myself as i write for ever even believing that might work. So I moved onto duct tape. No dice. There was just way too much stress on those little fixtures in the front and the back is just too free. I eventually arrived at gorilla tape. It worked! For about 2 weeks. I couldn't believe it. Even GORILLA TAPE couldn't manage to keep this thing from falling apart??? How is that possible. My solution, at least for now, is as follows: Line the holes of the plastic fixtures with twine (couldn't find any washers laying around, I improvised), then screwing the screws in on top of that as tight as they would go. I also loaded the back and bottom panels down with several layers of gorilla tape. I also screwed two wood screws into the outside of the side panels, going into the back panel, and thus giving it some support. I have a feeling that any screws would have done the trick, but I was so frustrated with the effort ittook to get these pieces of wood to act like a drawer, I went for broke. Anyway, enough about the drawer, let's talk about the other things.

The desk is held together at all it's joints with these little 2 part screws. I actually found them kind of neat. There's a circular hole in the part that holds another part to it, for instance the parts that sit on the floor. You put the circular part of the screw into that hole, then with the other part, which is a metal piece that resembles the head of a nail and a plastic piece with teeth that held them into the wood that was being attached. Hopefully this is making sense. It's a bit unusual for me but this is also the first time I've ever bought a piece of furniture over the internet. So anyway, once the two parts meet, you rotate the circular one righty tighty, and it locks the other part into it. While this was, like I said, pretty neat to me (it's the simple things), one of the circular screws just straight up does not catch the other part. There are NO spares. So the very back panel of the desk, what would be by your legs were you sitting at the desk, has one screw that doesn't connect, so if I ever need to move the desk, I have to make sure I push it back against the side that isn't fully attached, lest the two side panels separate. The side panels also have the track that holds the keyboard tray, so if they separate, the tray comes crashing down (yes, it has happened with some pretty important things sitting on it). So there's that. The last complaint I have is, at least in my opinion, minor compared to the others. The shelf that sits on top of the desk is depicted in the photo as being a good place to put things like books, dvd's, or games. This, however, is not the case. The back of it is completely open! One careless nudge and your things are all not only on the floor, but behind a desk that you can't even slide out because if you do, your laptop is going to end up on the floor as well.

To wrap, I believe that you could find better value and quality in a product from WalMart. And I honestly hate the makers of this product for creating something so bad that I had to ever actually say something so ludicrous.

The only reason i gave it 2 stars was because it was surprisingly easy to move from where i lived when i bought it to where i live now.
It comes apart rather easily and, once you've done it once, putting it together doesn't require instruction. That being said, all of these problems existed before taking it apart and putting it back together.

Sorry for the length, I just really wanted to stress how important it is that no one ever gives this company another dime; at least not for the Axess Collection Work Desk.

It's not the most sturdy table, but it doesn't wobble and is certainly strong enough for its intended purpose.

Unfortunately, I noticed after assembly that my wood top was split slightly where two of the planks join. Amazon made the return easy and UPS picked it up the next day. I received a replacement a couple days later and it's fine.

This is a fairly inexpensive Chinese-made piece of furniture. So if you aren't expecting high-end quality, then you won't be disappointed. For the price, it's a decent table that functions well and looks good - it certainly doesn't appear cheap. With Amazon's easy return policy, simply exchange it if there's any problem/damage with the unit you receive.

product_title: Crown Mark Dentil Chair Side Table
review_body:
I just finished assembling this table. I was pleasantly surprised by the quality. It looks like 'real' furniture. It arrived well-packed and I could only find one minuscule flaw in the finish, but I'm not sure that it wasn't caused by my handling of the parts. The assembly directions are all in one standard, international, non-verbal diagram. But putting it together, once you look at the parts, is pretty intuitive. I don't think it took more than ten minutes, once I managed to unpack all the parts; they are well-protected. Getting rid of the box and packing material took longer.
PRO:
- The assembly points are concealed, so there are no screw heads or little caps visible.
- Putting it together was straightforward and didn't demand contortions or a second pair of hands. Each leg is fastened with two machine screws using the hex key and then the shelf is fastened in using one Phillips head 'wood' screw (a metal screw with a pointed end intended for use in wood) at each leg.
- A hex key is provided (you must supply your own Phillips screwdriver).
- It appears to be made out of solid, if very light, wood, the finish looked good and the \\"inlay\\" design in the top looks professional.
CON:
- It is a very light type of lumber (but the only way anyone else will know is if they go around lifting up your furniture).
- The bottom shelf fastens with a wood screw at each leg. Over-driving the screw could easily pull it through the soft wood connecting point.
TIP:
- I used a couple bungee cords to draw the legs in snug to the bottom shelf before fastening it in.
- Make sure you center each corner slot before fastening the bottom shelf.

I purchased this because I have a small apartment and I wanted to open up the space a bit. This fills the bill---and with class.

product_title: GTR Simulator - GTSF Model with Real Racing Seat, Driving Racing Simulator Cockpit with Gear Shifter Mount and Triple or Single Monitor Mount
review_body:
Let's start with the cons - I don't like where the gearshift bracket is. It's too far forward, and would be much better if it were about four inches farther back. It's still plenty close to use, don't get me wrong, but it's just not "perfect". It would seriously benefit from the bracket being adjustable.

Pros - everything else. The seat is excellent. It adjusts forward and back and it tilts just like a real car seat. If I'm not mistaken, the seat is also leather. There is no cable management per se, but a couple zip-ties, and everything is nice and tidy. The whole thing is sturdy, and the diamond plate aluminum is a very nice touch.

If it weren't for the gear shifter not being adjustable, I'd give this thing six stars. My G27 fits it perfectly, and I did mount it permanent with bolts. The bolts are not included, and I'm not sure what size they are. So if you order this and want to mount your stuff, you need to get bolts first.

review_headline: Versatile screen with lovely mocha option to blend in with dark furniture

review_body:

The thing is, they replaced the whole set. As these are apparently not meant to be disassembled, I took one stool from the replacement set Amazon sent and UPS is picking up the remaining one. Amazon also wants me to send back the malfunctioning stool, which would be fine except that they can't provide me with the shipping materials to send it. (Being unable to disassemble it, I can't make it fit into the box it was originally shipped in.) Amazon has threatened to charge me if I don't return the item and I've told them I'll dispute the charge if they do so. We're at kind of a standstill. Guess we'll see what happens...

The stools are fine. Pretty much what you'd expect. My rating is for the fact that one needed a replacement and Amazon hasn't made it a very good customer service experience in this case.

review_body:

product_title: Best Choice Products Mirrored Jewelry Cabinet Armoire W/ Stand Mirror Rings, Necklaces, Bracelets
review_body:
I had no idea what kind of up and down emotional journey I was in for when I ordered this item. For your sake, I will use the universal shorthand of :) and :( to communicate my pleasure and displeasure along the way.

First off, I can assure you it is a real glass mirror! :) How do I know this?

The mirror is "well-packaged," by which I mean inside a giant cardboard box and styrofoam inside another giant cardboard box and styrofoam. Lots and lots of styrofoam in my garbage. :( Once I finally worked my way through the gobs of packaging, I could see that, despite no damage to the boxes, the mirror was broken into at least twenty pieces. :( Which also meant lots of glass shards and debris inside the jewelry compartment, requiring lots of careful clean-up and vacuuming. :(

I contacted the seller, and they shipped me out a fresh mirrored door right away. :) It arrived lovely and intact after a couple days :) although with more giant box/styrofoam to fill up my garbage can again. :( I then had to unscrew the hinges from the broken door and attach them to the new door. This was not complicated :) but definitely a pain in the ass :( and it was impossible to get my screws flush into the hinges again :( but it will do the job. :)

Time for assembly! It was pretty easy to put the base together :)...but then I realized I had never received the cross-bar part! :(

I emailed the seller again, and they shipped me the missing piece promptly. :) Finally assembly time! Two weeks after my original receipt of the product! I got it all put together (it's not too challenging)...but when I went to put the last pieces in, I realized I had assembled the base wrong! :( This was completely my fault...so FYI, when assembling the base, make sure you have the three small holes for the pegs facing the center of the stand..also pay attention to the "made in china" stamp on the bottom to make sure it faces the rear!! SoI had to disassemble and reassemble the stand and get it all put back together again (it was way quicker the second time around). :)

Voila! Working mirror and stand! They do put some funky kind of tape strips over the mirror in an X shape, which left a strange residue on the mirror. :( It took a good amount of Goo-Gon, followed by Windex, and plenty of scrubbing, to get it all off.

So then to put my jewelry inside! Great for rings! Tons of ring slots! :) For earrings: Not the best design. :( Hook style earrings can go in the little slots for earrings. There are also tiny holes, which are feasibly for post earrings, but it's really challenging to finagle the back behind the hole and get the post through the front. I dropped quite a few backs onto the floor. It's almost impossible to get studs into those, so I put them into the ring slots instead. There's tons of room for bracelets, although as mentioned, bangles will prevent the door from closing if you put them on the rod. But as for necklaces...there's not nearly enough room. :( There is only one section with a long space below the hooks (and that's not long enough for my longer necklaces). The other hook areas have only about 7 inches between them, so anything longer gets tangled with the hooks below. :( I will have to figure out something else to do with my necklaces.

All in all, I'm still glad I bought this item. :) It was a lot of work, but I definitely have more storage than before, and a pretty mirror as well. The customer service was good and prompt. I just hope if you purchase this, you have a better experience than I did! :)

review_headline: Chair works great as a temporary replacement
review_body:
Full Disclosure: I'm only living in the U.S. for four months, and didn't like the chair I got with the apartment I was staying at (wooden), so I purchased this one from Amazon to replace it.

I have to say, I bought it for $28 after tax and shipping. For my needs, it wasn't too bad of a purchase. Let's go through some pros/cons as well as my standard use case to determine if it's right for a cool person such as yourself!

Pros:

- Vertical adjustment: I'm neither short or tall, but having the ability to change height depending on posture was a big one for me. This gives the chair easily at least four stars. The pneumatics in it are solid so far - even after a full month of use, I'm still able to get a precision height with little to no issue.
- Cushioned seat: I'll be honest, I didn't expect much, but I was pleasantly surprised at the durability and the comfortability of the seat cushion here.
- Wheels! I like being able to wheel around my room if I'm not going too far, especially since getting up sometimes takes effort (so sue me; I'm lazy!).
- Back-rest: It seems to support lumbar area, but see my cons below for a better explanation.
- instructions: these alone made it feel like an IKEA-type chair. I suck at building things, so this really helped
- included tools! -- this chair comes with that Allen-type wrench that allows you to screw in the major things together. Don't lose this!

Cons:
- "interesting" build. The screw that holds the backrest to the cushioned part fell out twice already; it was just a matter of screwing it back in, but something leads me to believe this was a very cheaply made chair.
- flimsy backrest - it seems as if it's just going to come off. it hasn't yet, but it's definitely worrying.

All in all, I'll give it a four - I'd give it a five star rating if we had the ability to do "leaning" in the chair (it can definitely support it, just the bottom hinge is designed a little warily), or if the back-rest was adjustable. Besides that, I'm not complaining - I paid under $30 for a chair I'm only using for four months!ottom hinge is designed a little warily), or if the back-rest was adjustable. Besides that, I'm not complaining - I paid under $30 for a chair I'm only using for four months!

review_headline: Huge toaster over with easy-to-use dials
review_body: This thing is enormous!  I love that it is large enough to cook something taller than a slice of toast.  It is extremely easy to use with old fashioned dials and no confusing digital stuff on the front.  You can select bake, broil, or toast.  Other than that, you can set the temperature and the timer ... nothing fancy.  It does have a 30-minute "keep warm" setting, which is very convenient.  The crumb tray slides out easily, although you do have to access it from inside the oven so you can't clean out the crumbs before it cools down.  Also, the oven has a self-clean coating that seems to do a great job preventing messy build-up.  The only down-side is that it has a portion of the oven that juts out about 4" in the back, so it does take up a good bit of room on the counter because of the added depth.  (Total depth is around 15".)  I don't mind the extra depth, because that translates into a larger cooking area inside.  But, it would be nice if the red box frame extended 4" further to the back so it would hide the rear components and so it didn't look like the unit was just sitting in the middle of the counter.  Other than that, this is a cute oven that does a great job, is big enough to cook a small roast, and is super easy to use.

review_headline: Not as comfortable and ergonmic as I'd hoped
review_body:
I did a lot of research online to get a comfortable/ergo chair that was 'reasonably priced'. I sit between 10-14 hours straight at work. I should've gone with my instinct and went out to sit in chairs before I decided. But I just was drawn to this one. For the price it is OK. Here's the good and bad:

Pros: Great height adjustment, decent lumbar support, arms can be pulled up and out of the way or put down, the rollers are wonderful- far better than the ones in the other chairs at work- They are very smooth, it is lightweight and easy to move around, I love the vibrant red color and leatherette option- easier to clean. Last, the assembly was not difficult. I had a coworker do it for me while I was on my lunch break and he said it was very quick and easy. It was all put together before I got back from a 30 min break.

Cons: The seat is not as soft as I wanted. If you sit for like 6 hours or less it's fine but more than that I start shifting all around to alleviate pressure. It does not rock, which I completely forgot to check before purchasing- sitting so long sometimes it's nice to have a little rocking motion, it's difficult to adjust the back (leaning further back vs straighter up)- there's a nob underneath that you turn but it's hard to get to and hard to turn and doesn't do all that much really. I feel like no matter what I'm sitting only very straight up and I like to recline a bit from time to time. Lastly, the arm height cannot be adjusted (yes they can be pulled up and put back down, but there is only one height when put down. For me this is a huge disappointment- ergonomically I need the arms raised about 1/2 in up; I'm 5'8 thin build- female)

Overall, I would not have bought this chair had I tried it out ahead of time.

review_body:
It fell apart When I took it out of the box. I lifted it out of the box and the 2 sides broke away from the table. The thing is very heavy and I didn't want to send it back. So I used new screws, wood glue and put it back together. It required some wood repair work as the wood spit. And after a little work, a lot of cussing and determination, I was able to put the table back together and I must admit it looks good. You can't see any of the repair work I did. And I must admit it works very well to.

It does not tip over as others have said. But I filled the drawer with items I would use such as: I put a phone charging station inside the top drawer by adding a stripe power surge plug with velco to the side of the drawer. I also keep my laptop computer in it when not is use as well as all my remotes, a pad of paper and a pen and my spare car keys.

All in all the table is nice but the construction is not so nice (cheap) thus the 3 stars. My best advice is to be very careful taking it out of the box. Lift it by the stone top. Do not attempt to use the side wood (even just to tip it on its side to get a better grip). Once it is put together it seems sturdy enough but keep in mind I rebuilt it with larger screws and wood glue.

product_title: Kesrer Laptop Cart with Wheel Laptop Stand for Home and Office Laptop Desk on Wheels Notebook Stand for Bed & Couch
review_headline: Excellent for disabled persons needing a workstation
review_body:
I purchased this for my mother who has several herniated spinal discs and is bedridden. She's had this issue for the past year, and the only way she has been able to use a tablet or laptop is by uncomfortably turning on her side and typing from that angle. This put even more stress on her back and needed to be remedied.

This laptop cart has enabled her to lay down comfortably in bed (with the assistance of three wedge pillows) and use her tablet or laptop at any angle she likes. No more craning into odd positions to use her electronics, she simply sets the position of the cart and she's as comfortable as can be. The flexibility of the cart's positions is what makes this item so great: The dual arms and tilting tray allow her to fine tune her positioning.

I would gladly pay $300 again to give her the freedom she now has to use her electronics at will without compromising her comfort and health.

The only flaw I have with the unit is that the mouse tray has to be attached to the arms in order for the laptop tray to be attached as well. When laying down in bed, it can be awkward having the mouse tray there when you're trying to get comfortable in certain positions. I won't reduce the rating because of this, but it would be nice to have the option to remove the mouse tray but still have the laptop tray attached.

product_title: (2016) Amerisleep Liberty 12" Natural Memory Foam Mattress
review_body:
I was sceptical about purchasing a memory foam mattress online having never owned one or slept on one before. All my research led me to Amerisleep. I purchased a King sized Liberty mattress after visiting a local mattress store to experience first hand the comparable mattresses which Amerisleep advertises.

I chatted with a sales rep and ordered the Liberty. I received it promptly, as promised, and slept on it the first night.

- Off gassing. There was none. If anything there was a slight odor but nothing that was noticeable enough to affect sleep.

- Comfort. The mattress holds you in place and really conforms well to your body. I sleep on my back, side, and stomache and regardless of position this mattress provides a great deal of support and comfort.

- Coolness. Some complaints about memory foam mattresses in general are that they tend to "sleep hot", however the Liberty is cool and comfortable.

I have recommended the Liberty to family and friends and I am a very satisfied customer.

-Scott

product_title: Signature Sleep 6-Inch Memory Foam Mattress, Twin
review_headline: Why didn't we do this sooner
review_body:
After reading a ton of reviews and doing even more research I settled on this mattress to replace a 12 1/2 year old Serta pillow top. I figured if memory foam didn't work out $300 was a small pill to swallow instead of $3000+ for a Tepurpedic.
We ordered it and waited. And waited. And waited. Finally contacted Amazon who informed me it must be lost and they would overnight a replacement. True to their word a new one arrived the next afternoon. Kudos to Amazon!
We used our existing split box-spring since it was still in very good shape,no sagging, etc. (the instructions said this mattress could be placed on any supportive foundation.) After unwrapping it I let it air out with the window open and ceiling fan on. That night there was a faint chemical smell, but only when my nose was right against the mattress. A week later and there is not any lingering odor.
The mattress was at 11" within an hour. The instructions stated that the mattress could be slept on immediately but could take up to 48 hours to reach full height.
My husband slept great on it from the first night. It has taken me a couple days to get acclimated, but each night it is more comfortable. We have no regret with the memory foam. My only issue and it is minor: the mattress seems to be wider than my old one. It overhangs on each side of the box-spring by about 1-2 inches. I have a bed-skirt and coverlet so I'm def. the only one who notices this. Also it slides quite easily. If i lean over the bed while making it the whole mattress slides. I'm going to try putting a layer of non-slip rug pad under it to see if it helps. But again a small thing in comparison to getting an awesome mattress for $300.
No problem with heat yet, but it is winter in New England so.....
Overall we love it and would definitely reccommend it.

product_title: Lifetime Box Spring, Great for Memory Foam Mattress, Boxspring
review_body:

However, do not try to screw the slats across the top by hand. There are many of them and you would have a lot of blisters and it would take a very long time. Use a drill with a phillips head and those screws just go right in. The cover that can be seen in the picture actually only covers the top as seen and the sides and is tightened via a nylon string like on a coat hood. Then after cinching it up, it is held in place with a plastic slide. So it does not look at smooth as it looks in the picture, but it is a good solid box spring.

product_title: Sauder Edge Water Estate Two Door Cabinet
review_body:
There are soooo many things wrong with this, I just can't go into them all. But here are the top three.
1. The finish flakes off as you try to put it together.
2. There is a face plate that goes behind the door pulls but if you try to attach them there are two little nibs on the back of the plates that keep them from lying flat against the door. So when you try to put the screw in from the back as the directions show it strips the screw and there is no way to attach them other than taking the door off and hammering them in, which with all the flaking finish, I guess wouldn't matter.
3. And this is the BIG ONE! There is a brace that holds the doors in place and is under the drawer. Well you can't get the drawer in with the brace in place, and if you take the brace out you can't keep the top of the cabinet on because the brace has the cams that hold the top front down and they are right where the front of the drawer is. It's such a lovely design. It's only what I've come to expect from Sauder!!!
We didn't expect much when we purchased this but we at least expected to be able to put it together and it to handle the little job we had planned for it. Now it looks like it's just $114.00 wasted.

product_title: Winsome Wood TV Table, Set of 4
review_headline: Love them, but one was broken.
review_body:
The TV trays are awesome themselves, but when I got them one was broken. I think it was a problem with the shipper--it was Prestige--perhaps and not the trays themselves, but regardless one is broken. I have taken pictures of the mangled box and submitted them in the packaging feedback section, so in a way I hate to slam the product itself since it is great. That's the reason for the 4 instead of a 5, though. I will also add that the package is SO HEAVY and so restrained in the box with tough ties and such that it is hard to get inside and then difficult to get to the trays themselves once out of the box, so if you have trouble lifting, etc., you may be best off buying it locally so that you can carry in each TV tray separately.

To the product itself, once out of the hell of packaging and barring any broken ones, they are beautiful. The wood is solid, they're heavier (in a good way also) than the ones purchased at Walmart, and it's a very pretty finish. I don't know if there's a way to request they not be sent by Prestige or not, but I suspect FedEx or UPS wouldn't damage it to the degree that this was. I say that because I got another box from Amazon through Prestige that day and it was also poorly handled and bumped and banged, and mine sent through FedEx and UPS are never that way. I get several packages from Amazon a week, and these two are the only to come damaged, and both were sent through Prestige, so I figure it's the shipping company most likely.

The trays work wonderfully, and I like the strength of the wood and durability of them--if the package hadn't been damaged, the tray would have either.

product_title: Winsome Wood Valet Stand, Espresso
review_headline: Poor packaging and poor quality control
review_body:
In short, it was defective when I got it, I had to get new parts twice because the first set were drilled wrong, and when I finally got it together, the fittament was poor at best, and due to the delays in shipping incurred each time, I can longer return it to Amazon.

Now for the longer story.

When I got this item delivered I quickly went to putting it together. After I got the legs and cross bars connected, I realized that both legs were warped. My guess is this was because they were directly against the side of the package which had a lot of force exerted against it. So I faxed in the new part request (they clearly must have serious quality control problems if the package comes with a form for requesting missing or damaged parts).

A few weeks later I received the new legs. The thrill of getting a new package was gone so I didn't rush to put it together. When I finally got around to putting the stand together I realized that the legs they sent me either went to a different stand or were drilled improperly as the gap betwen the screw hole and the dowel hole was too wide. Because this stand was almost exactly what I was looking for, I decided that I would give them one more chance to fix the Item, so this time I called in and explained the issue, and they said they would send me another round of new legs.

A few weeks later these new legs arrived. This time I immedeately pulled out the new legs and test fit them with the cross bars. Thankfully, the spacing was correct. Unfortunately though, these legs have different flaw. They are a little to short so the shelf is not stable. Worst of all, I am past my window to return to Amazon. I now have a wobbly stand, that can't be returned and that I am tired of taking apart just to have to rebuild again. I am sure that Winsome would send a 4th set of legs, btu it isnt worth dealing with and being without my stand for another few weeks. I have put some shims between the shelf and the legs to firm it up, but that should not be required.

How this item has had so many positive reviews I can't figure out, but they had 3 chances to get this right and failed each time. Now I am stuck with a defective item because they strung me along until Amazon's return window closed.helf and the legs to firm it up, but that should not be required.

How this item has had so many positive reviews I can't figure out, but they had 3 chances to get this right and failed each time. Now I am stuck with a defective item because they strung me along until Amazon's return window closed.

product_title: LumiSource Linx Coffee Table
review_headline: Two years and still love it.
review_body:
I bought this table two years ago and I still get compliments about it from visitors. It is small for a coffee table, but the dimensions listed are accurate. So measure your space and make sure it will fit the way you want it to before buying it. I have a couch with a chaise on one end, so this nicely fits the space in front of the section of normal seating.

The bottoms of the wooden rings that touch the floor are flat and have little feet to keep it from wobbling. The top glass surface is held very firmly in place by suction pads. That won't budge. The bottom glass surface simply rests on some knobs sticking out of the wooden frame, so you have to be careful not to accidentally knock that around with your feet as I have done occasionally.

I personally didn't find it difficult to put together. Just follow the instructions and be careful about keeping things oriented properly and you should be fine. Seems like some people might have problems with holes not aligning very well, but I don't recall having that issue.

product_title: Sonax D-204-NHL Slim Workspace Desk, Midnight Black
review_body:
I got this desk for my living room PC. I wanted something that wouldn't take up too much space and this fit the bill perfectly. Its only 16.5\\" deep and the open sides further allow the room to look more spacious. I have a mini-ITX PC (Silverstone SG05 case) sitting on it and there is enough room to mount a 24\\" monitor on a monitor arm clamped to the desk and to use a full-size keyboard and mouse comfortably. There's lots of room in the back for cable management.

Pros:
1. Very low depth perfect for a living room. Its the same depth as my entertainment center, IKEA Expedit.
2. Open sides make the room feel less cramped
3. Very sturdy. I have a heavy 24\\" professional IPS monitor mounted using a heavy clamp-type monitor arm (Ergotron) and the table doesn't give or budge.
4. Surface has a relatively durable matte finish. Note that this is particle board, so any hard dings will damage it easily.
5. Very easy to assemble. Took about 20 minutes.
6. There is a gap behind the rear board of the desk. If your wall has a base board like me, this gives plenty of room to hide things. I have a large power strip, a VOIP modem and a wireless router mounted back there. Since I have an outlet behind the table, this gives a very clean look with no wires visible.
7. Spacious enough to hold a compact desktop, large monitor, keyboard and mouse and work comfortably.
8. Secure packaging with reinforced corners. Arrived with no damage.

Cons:
1. Expensive for what is essentially 4 pieces of particle board. For this price, I would have expected something made of solid wood, pine at the very least.

Overall, I recommend this desk if you're using it in a highly visible area and want to take up minimal space (both perceptual and actual) without compromising functionality. It is expensive for the materials used, but sometimes you need to pay a premium to get exactly what you want.

review_body: We were looking for an in-closet shelf & the dimensions of this unit were perfect. Holds lots of can goods, books & such but I have mine in an enclosed space.  You'd have to anchor it if it was free-standing.  Easy to assemble, made of press board so nothing fancy.  I think it would be great for extra storage in a space/room that is not going to get a lot of "action".  Because of the nature of the materials I would not recommend this for a child's room.  Overall we are quite pleased with our purchase.

product_title: Sebring Coffee Bean Bonded Leather Sofa and Loveseat Set
review_body: If I could give 0 stars I would.  The leather began peeling off after a year and a half.  It is very poor quality and now I am forced to buy new furniture.  This is awful.  Do not waste your money.

product_title: Maple Finish 5 Piece Dining Set
review_headline: 4 legs are not even especially for hard floor
review_body: This product was very cheaply made and it looks cheap.  The 4 legs on the chairs were never even and wobbly, so had to switch around to minimize and we also had to exchange.  We have hardwood floor, so this made wobbling worse, but this might work better for carpet floor.  The assembly was easy and the exchange by the manufacturer was very prompt.

product_title: Coaster Home Furnishings Coat Rack with Umbrella Holder, Satin Black Finish
review_body:
This arrived quickly and was easy to put together and has so far worked wonderfully. It holds all our coats and my hubbys caps and hasn't fallen over even once(we were afraid it might at first with heavy coats on it).

The bottom is holding umbrellas and several other items that got stuck in there so it is being very useful.

product_title: Sauder Miscellaneous Office 35.28'' Storage Cabinet
review_body: Beware that this item comes unassembled and much labor and a fair amount of skill is required to assemble it. Also, the odor is terrible. We have had it a week and it is still strong. We are using our air purifer part of the time and opening the window (20 degree weather) part of the time. I gave it three stars because it is a beautiful piece of furniture. It does not look cheap! I just hope that odor leaves.

product_title: Mohawk Home Bristol Shag Black 60 by 96-Inch Rug
review_body: Its a nice plain black shag rug. Very soft and fluffy. Fits in my room perfect. A pretty good value for anyone.

product_title: South Shore Furniture Noble Collection TV Stand
review_headline: looks good but took the patience of 3 people to assemble
review_body: I have this entire south shore noble collection.... so with that being said this was nowhere near the adventure of the 6 drawer dresser but it was not a cake walk either. I messed with the directions for an hour before I was cursing like a sailor. I passed it to my brother & his girlfriend, who found the spanish directions more helpful and descriptive than the english. The overall process of assembling this thing was around 3-4 hours. Its very sturdy and solid, possibly because my brother also enforced everything with glue or it's actually good quality, either way I have moved 3 times and it's still standing. The touch up stick that also comes with this stand is nice but pretty far from the exact color. Better off to get a touch up stick from an actual paint store.

product_title: Zebra Animal Skin Print Modern Carpet Black Area Rug, 3 Feet by 5 Feet (3' x 5')
review_body: We like the rug and get it much use. The only thing is, that we order 2 and only got one rug. I have tried many times to get the word out about our missing rug, but have not got a response.

product_title: A To Z Animal Squares Set of 26 Kit
review_headline: Cheaper than the magazine we found it in.
review_body: I bought this for my mother, who is a teacher, to use in her kindergarten class. She was rather taken by them in a magazine but was put off by the price. Luckily I found them here for a more reasonable price and she couldn't be more happy with the purchase.

product_title: Choice Parts – Black Sectional Connector (Pack of 2) – Great Non Sliding Sofa Fastener for Couch, Loveseat, Recliner, Chair or Chaise Lounge Sections of Large or Small Sectionals - Model #240
review_body: I bought these to keep our sectional from coming apart. They were easy to install (measure twice, drill once!) and work very well. The middle of the couch no longer slides apart from the ends when we stand up. Thanks for a great product!

product_title: Rocker Recliner Sofa Chair Padded Arms Brown Bonded Leather
review_body: Incredibly comfortable with rocking and gliding motion as well as two reclining positions. Color is much richer and more beautiful than you can see in the product pictures. This is a BIG recliner so plan for the space you'll want to take full advantage of the buttery softness. Arrived in two pieces; the back just slides and locks into place -- couldn't be easier. In our case, "curbside" delivery was actually delivery to our door with help bringing the furniture (we ordered the matching sofa with this recliner) inside. If you order this, be sure to check your email to confirm your delivery address or you will end up delaying your own delivery. Delivery was very fast and careful. No damage; no nicks or scuffs whatsoever. This is bonded leather, so it is easier to clean and care for but looks and feels like quality solid leather at a small fraction of the price. This is NOT a custom $5,000 leather recliner, but it's a highly satisfying substitute in my experience. Completely satisfied with this piece even one year after purchase with heavy daily use.

product_title: South Shore Step One Twin Bookcase Headboard
review_body: The headboard was an excellent addition to our toddler daughter's coordinating South Shore twin bed.  She has a small room, and so we try to fit in extra storage space wherever possible.  This was the right answer at the right price.  Right now, she uses it to store her stuffed animals.  As she grows, the small cut-out in the backing will allow for cords for an alarm clock and/or lamp to fit through.  It is a sturdy piece of what is presumably OSB covered in natural maple paper.  So, while it is not real wood (and I was not expecting it to be), it is a respectable, stout piece of furniture that is quite attractive, particularly given the price point.  Assembly for the headboard alone was relatively quick - about a half hour with minimal tool usage.  There was a hex key included for assembly purposes.

product_title: Apontus PU Leather Swivel Hydraulic Bar Stool, Set of 2, Black
review_body: great chairs, very nice looking and easy to clean also very easy to put up. i'd say this is a great buy!

product_title: Wooden Daybed with Trundle Contemporary Style in Cherry
review_body: Bought this bed for my grandkids room and so very glad I chose this one after looking at many..It was packaged nicely and arrived very fast, was in perfect shape when we received it..Was easy to put together and the trundle bed is perfect for my 15 month old grandson to sleep on without needing to be in a crib..price is great and I've even slept on this bed with my 5 year old granddaughter, so the build is well also..

product_title: Home Styles Nantucket Pantry - Distressed White
review_body: I bought this to use in our kitchen. It was not difficult to put together but the hinges were already on the doors and were slightly crooked. You can't do much with them but we added washers so the doors would close correctly. For the price thought the piece is nicer than what you find at the stores that are particle board. The cabinet is nice and I wish they made all these a little deeper but it works well for a pantry.

product_title: Milliard Super Strong Portable Folding Rollaway Bed
review_body: High quality product.  Rated very comfortable by two users so far.  Ea sy to assemble and store.  Relatively lightweight  And easy to move.  Would rate five star  except it  arrived with torn packaging.  That needs improvement.

product_title: Kings Brand Multifunctional Laptop Table Stand With Cooling Fan & USB Ports

review_body:
if you can get a better one go ahead, but for this price range this is as good as it gets

review_body: We have 4 of these racks in our home now.  They are sturdy and space efficient.  Two of them are over nine years old and still going strong.

review_body: Shipped quick and cheap. Everything is great but there is a few scratches on the wood as well as the stain they used dripped and dried that way. Kinda bad quality.

review_body: This is in my dining room, fits perfect and goes with everything very nicely.  I followed the instructions for running cleaning with the vacuum exactly, which states clearly, do not use the rotor brush part of the vacuum.  The reason is because it could eventually pick up little loops.  First, the dining room is one of those rooms in my house that does not get much use, therefore the carpet is not abused.  My carpet is now getting those little loops.  For the price I paid for this I expected more.  If this carpet was to go into a room with a lot of actual activity, then I would not recommend it at all.

review_body: We are missing a piece for this. We only received 3 of part #4, instead of 4. As a result, we can't put the mid shelf into place, because there's nothing on the front to anchor it to. Please send us one of Part #4 as soon as possible. Thank you.

product_title: Lumisource Mimi Barstool, Set of 2
review_headline: Pretty good for the price but
review_body:
a previous purchaser is right re: there is only one right way to put these chairs together. It's easy to put them together incorrectly; then the screw holes won't line up, and you have to take them apart and realize the front legs should have gone in the back and vice versa.

I also bought these because my bar is a little too high for pneumatic bar stools. I was happy to find inexpensive stools that were high enough. The bright green is very cheerful and modern looking, too.

product_title: Celebrations Swiss Fir Prelit Tree
review_body: It's way smaller than I thought it would be (I underestimated how short 4' was) but that's OK because my girlfriend is Jewish and I have to ease her into Christmas anyway.

review_body: We just ordered 4 of these stools about a week ago and we are very satisfied .  Quick shipping, wrapped well and in good condition - easy enough to put together too (maybe about 15 min each), and so far very sturdy, and comfortable.  Someone else had commented on the size of the stool, but these seem like pretty average size stools to me, and are just as expected.  They are of good quality, especially for the price.

product_title: Signature Sleep 6-Inch Memory Foam Mattress, Twin
review_body: This mattress is a great deal for the price and very comfortable, but don't kid yourself - it is firm. If you like a softer mattress, look elsewhere. That said, I put mine in a wooden box frame, which has no give to it. I think it might be a bit better on a metal spring frame or a box-spring. Still, all in all, I like it and would recommend it to anyone who can't afford, or does not want, to spend too much.

product_title: Safavieh California Shag Collection SG151-1010 White Area Rug (9'6" x 13')
review_body: Love, love, love, love, LOVE this rug.  It feels wonderful in bare feet.  I'll stand on it just curling my toes into it.  It isn't shedding, but I haven't tried vacuuming it yet.  I have a good, thick, spongy pad under it, which I highly recommend; make sure the pad fits the exact dimensions of the rug - even if you have to get a larger one and cut it down - as the rug (with a thick pad) is thin enough to have a little "drop-off ridge" where it extends past the pad.  But it's not a "thin" rug.  I have a huge (8'x10' - ish) rug in beige; it goes with everything.  The "beige" is a lighter, paler shade than the brown-ish "beige" I imagine most people think of as "beige."  It's NOT brown.  My kids tromped around on it in bare feet too, marveling at how good it felt.

product_title: Furniture Repair Set
review_body: good for little easy marks. Used it on my computer desks and side table's! Works very well! would recommend to you!

product_title: South Shore Furniture, Step One Collection, Headboard 54"/60"
review_body:
I think for the expense and labor and overall look, I made out pretty darn well. Though it is particle board, and it's definitely obvious that it is when it arrives, the Gray Oak veneer is really lovely and subtle. And once assembled, the finished product looks better than a lot of particle board.
The head board arrived perfectly, with no dings or scratches, and was packaged very well for shipping. I really like that they include a furniture marker with the product - even though I don't need it for the headboard, I could use it for some exposed particle board on the nightstand, and it's nice to know in the future when I make that first scratch I'll have something right there on hand.
The headboard itself is sturdy and at a great height - I'm waiting for the platform bed to arrive next week, and after reading others' reviews I'm prepared to go to the hardware store to make it better/sturdier than the hardware provided. All in all, I love the look, and am excited for the rest of the set to arrive. :)

product_title: SilverRest Sleep Products California King 10-Inch Memory Foam Mattress
review_body: I have a bad back and this mattress has been great. We have had it for about 3-4 years and it's holding strong. It takes a little bit of getting used to and out of the package it has a small funk to it but it's gone pretty fast. I would recommend this if you like a firm but not to firm mattress.

product_title: Sauder Multimedia Storage Tower, Cinnamon Cherry
review_body: I for one did not read reviews and that screwed me in the end. Looks so much bigger. Heavy for how little it is does have lots of shelves but makes them small in between

product_title: Winsome 29-Inch Square Leg Bar Stool, Set of 2
review_body: Arrived in pristine condition and look great. Assembled perfectly, no wobbles or unlovely legs. They look much more expensive than they cost. Very sturdy only con is the seats if wider would be more comfy but then would not fit under my bar.

product_title: Romanoff Step Stool, White
review_body: Works very well.  Great product I was very pleased.  Great step stool a bit rough on bare feet on top though.  Need rubber on top or carpet.

product_title: Furinno 10005EX/BR Wall-mounted Storage Shelf with 2 Bin Drawers, Espresso/Brown
review_headline: I just can't even with this CRAP.
review_body:
I am tempted to just write \\"CRAP\\" 20 times and leave it at that.

I bought this bleeping piece of bleep in order to loft my computer monitor up to eye level for a standing desk. Based on the reviews, I knew this was a gamble, but couldn't find anything else that looked like it would fit the bill.

The good: the color matches the base cabinet perfectly. Also, nobody actually died in the assembly process, although the dogs did hide under the bed due to the manic profanity and untrammeled rage fumes blasting out of my skull.

The holy bleeping BLEEP bad:

I've built bookcases that took me less time. It would probably help if the individual pieces were labeled (A,B, C, etc) as they are on the schematic. I tend to be able to put things together intuitively, but BLEEP. People! PEOPLE. This thing is cheap cheap cheap- like, 19.99 is a stretch cheap. It's a pain in the BLEEP to put together. You basically have to assemble the entire internal skeleton before you anchor it on the bottom board- something that wasn't made at all clear in the instructions. Due to the asymmetry and lack of side support, those bleeping plastic pegs snapped on me- TWICE. Snapped off plastic pegs in a hole do not come out, and there are no extras. This P.O.S. calls for two tools- a Phillips Screwdriver and a mallet. I am convinced that the mallet is used to bludgeon the particleboard into debris, and then you use the screwdriver to shank someone in the eye. That is how angry you will get in the assembly process, so you will need to channel it into violence. Or swearing. Or both. I settled for swearing, and I am shocked that my neighbors didn't call the cops.

Oh, and now that I have it put together, I just noticed a crack in the top front corner; but now it's bleeping assembled, and therefore unreturnable. BLEEP!

product_title: Organize It All Providence Kitchen Cart with Basket
review_body: I chose this cart as it was the size and color I needed for a small space in my kitchen and it is working satisfactorily and looks very nice.  Was not pleased initially that the bottom piece to the drawer was warped when it arrived and started putting it together, but with a little patience everything went together fine and the drawer is working.

product_title: 6 ft. Impressionist Painting French Cafe Double Art Print Canvas Room Divider - 2 Sizes
review_body: I wasn't sure whether to get the six panel or the four panel.  I went with purchasing two of the four panel and it was perfect to creat a wall.  I love the colors.  They did a good job with these.  I was very happy with my purchase.

product_title: Juniper Chair (Set of 2)
review_body:
The chair is nice, it's far more blue than pictured but that's alright. The green and gold is much less. It's interesting how it changes depending on the light and it's a nice bold piece. It's a firm chair, a little low but nice over all.

However, it was packed so poorly that the legs were scuffed and damaged. I can repair it but it's a shame that it came out of the box with so many scuffs.

product_title: Recliner-Handles Sofa Sectional Couch Latch Interlocking Connector Universal Connector for Sofa Sectional Couch
review_body: Thank you sooooooo much!! It was a perfect fit for my sofa. :) Received the piece a day early. Sorry it took so long to rate this.

product_title: Lot of 25 Black 54" Polyester Home or Travel Lightweight Suit & Shirt Garment Cover / Bag
review_headline: Great garment bag at a super low price!!
review_body: This garment bag is great for either storage or travel!  It fits a suit or even a dress!  I can hang it up in my closet, or on the hook in my van!

product_title: Optimum Technologies Lok Lift Rug Gripper for Runners, 4-Inch by 25-Feet
review_body: I have a long wool runner shaped rug in my kitchen which is beautiful but unfortunately one of my cat's favorite activities is playing with it and leaving it in a huge pile in the middle of the floor. Not to mention when she takes off Looney Tunes style and leaves it accordioned at the other end of the room. I tried other rug pads but I needed something with holding power. I've had this rug gripper for 6 months and it's just now starting to loosen up a little at the ends (thanks, mostly, to my husband kicking it up with his huge feet). The rug stays firmly in place through cat play, vacuuming, everything. I'm a little nervous about removing it from the wood floor underneath. I pulled up a corner recently and it left a little adhesive behind but I'm hoping a good mopping will take care of that. Overall I'm very happy, this is exactly what I needed.

product_title: Coaster Traditional Jewelry Armoire
review_body: The space in the armoire is great for many types of jewelry items from rings to bracelets and necklaces. It is a nice compact size to fit in small area with the mirror on lid just about perfect for a person sitting in front of it to see earrings in reflection. If you have any small children or any animals in the house make sure to use the inclosed wall security strap.

product_title: South Shore Step One Platform Bed with Mouldings, King, Pure White
review_body: The product itself is great. It's sturdy and suites what we needed it for. 1 slight flaw was the B3 board (which is one of the platform boards the bed sits on) was stained incorrectly on the edges. The main irritation was the fact that it didn't come with any instructions! I had to get online and look through at least 10 different sites to finally find some instructions on how to put this thing together! And without them it would have taken quite a while to get it together properly!

product_title: Winsome Trading Winsome Wood Wine Cabinet, Walnut
review_headline: Missing parts and no way to contact manufacturer
review_body: While these appears to be a good product, we weren't able to complete assembly because they packed two left sides, instead of a left and a right. There is no way to contact an actual person to discuss the problem. They include a parts replacement form (which can't be a positive sign) and the only way to send it is through fax. There is no way to call or email to follow up on your request. So now we are left with the hope of a replacement piece. If no resolution is found I will seek remedy through Amazon, but am willing to give it a reasonable amount of time before doing that. Will update review when I have more to share.

review_headline: and the set looks great together. I recommend

product_title: Super-Bungee Chair Mini
review_body: This was the surprise hit of Christmas in this house! Super comfy, and a great place for my daughter to curl up with a blanket and read one of her new books. She has barely gotten out of it all vacation!

product_title: Winsome Wood Phone Stand, Espresso
review_body: Received two of these end tables in just a few days - We are using them as night stands. Love the look that they add to our guest room. The espresso wood matches nicely with our headboard and bed frame. My husband put them both together in one hour. I would definitely recommend this furniture to a friend. They look like we spent double the amount.

product_title: Canwood Whistler Junior Loft Bed
review_body: This product is really well made out of actual wood, easily assembled and is the perfect size for our 6 year old.  I am certain his next bed will be one in his dorm.

product_title: Big Joe Milano Bean Bag Chair Color: White
review_body: Bought this for my daughter for Christmas & I loved it so much I had to get an ottoman to match.It was alot bigger than I expected but very light to carry around from room to room!Love it!!

product_title: Winsome Wood Sasha Accent Table with Drawer Curved Legs
review_body: I gave it 3 star because I do like the table but I agree with the reviews that say it's poor quality. The holes where screws go are split so no telling if the whole thing is solid. It's harder to put together that it should be because things don't align well. The look is pretty and just like the picture so no complains there. I did not return it because it seems to much trouble but I will not order another one as I intended to do. Contrary to reviewers who think you get what you pay for, just because something is inexpensive, I don't think you should get poor quality.

product_title: Signature Sleep Contour 8 Inch Independently Encased Coil Mattress with Low VOC CertiPUR-US Certified Foam
review_body: I built a wood frame bed for my daughter who just graduated to a "big girl bed."  Read the overwhelmingly positive reviews of this mattress & decided it was the way to go.  In the description it says the length is 74" so I built the bed to fit 74."  Low & behold the mattress is 71.5" and there is a huge gap at the foot of the bed.  What a disappointment.  I'm pissed.

product_title: Wexford Petite Convertible Fireplace Black/Gel
review_headline: This will get a lot of use this winter!
review_body: Perfect size for my family room, and love the syle!  The gel fuel effect is so much like a real wood fire along with the crackling noise but without the smokey fumes!  I like the effect better using two cans and provides more heat of course than with the one.  As others have mentioned, you can see the can behind the fake logs.  However, after a little bit, I totally lose site of them since I'm enjoying the fire itself, so not a problem at all for me.  Assembly was easy, except for one step where you have to manually line up the final wood frame insert which does not have predrilled holes (I assume because it varies depending on if you are using the gel fuel firebox or the electric insert).  It is up to you to center it as best you can, but ended up to be not that big of a deal and looks like I centered it just right.  I have mine positioned in a corner, and the flap for corner usage is very sturdy.  The smaller size makes it possible to move it into other rooms as needed (lighter if you remove the heavy log first!)

product_title: Flash Furniture High Back Leather Chair, Black

product_title: Collette Woven Braid Circle Trim Cranberry/ Sage
review_body: This is a very high quality braid.  I am very happy that I took a chance and ordered this online.  The color is exactly as shown on my computer screen.

review_body: You get what you pay for.  It is very flimsy and unsteady.  The two pieces do not stay well together (top and bottom).  Will tip extremely easily.  I have nothing but Sauder products in my house and this is the first piece that I dislike.  Would not recommend this particular bookcase, but Sauder products as a whole are very good.

product_title: Skid-resistant Carpet Runner - Praline Brown - Many Other Sizes to Choose From
review_body: Very nice, good looking, practical and has some softness. Stays flat. Feels good on the feet. Neat looking. Decent delivery time.

product_title: Garfield With Good Morning Sunshine Mug Ornament
review_body: It is a wonderful, typical Garfield ornament and unlike any other I have seen. I love it. It now hangs on my tree.

product_title: Big Business Poster Movie 11x17 Bette Midler Lily Tomlin Fred Ward Edward Herrmann
review_body: who has not grown up loving this movie? It's sooo much fun and the print is very good when I framed it I kept it simple in a larger white frame because it set off the ladys and made them stand out.

product_title: Image Tree Wood Handle Rubber Stamp Set-Antique Typewriter Alphabet/Lower
review_body: Outside of my usual complaint that the letters are not exactly in the center of the stamp, this is a well crafted set. The rubber is deeply etched so there is little chance of ink printing from the excess rubber around the letter image. The wood handle blocks are long enough that they are fairly easy to hold. Just like a typewriter these letter can fill in with too much pressure such as the enclosed part of the letter "a" or "e". I'm fine with that because I like the kind of grungy look. I did make one modification with this set. I used a pencil to designate the base line of the letters "b", "d", "p", "q", "n" and "u". They are not interchangeable and this quick step saves tons of time while using the stamps.

product_title: Dexter Metal Headboard with Decorative Castings and Globe Finials
review_body: Very nice headboard.  Heavy metal,great color and classic style.  Blends nicely with our lamps and looks fabulous in our bedroom.

product_title: South Shore Fynn Collection Drawer
review_headline: Shockingly low quality (yes, I know it's just particle board)
review_body: I have no illusions about the quality and longevity of particle board, but we needed an inexpensive dresser quickly. In my experience, a piece of lower-quality furniture will at least stay intact while it's sitting in one place performing its main function -- I'm never surprised, after a few years and a trip or two in a moving van, when a bookshelf or coffee table bites the dust -- but this dresser set a record for falling apart. Not two months after we spent an entire evening putting it together, the sides seem to have imperceptibly bowed out enough so that the drawers never quite fit into their runners, making every time we need a pair of socks an ordeal of trying to wrestle a free-floating drawer back into one or both of its runners. If I'd known this would be the case, I'd have plunked down the extra money for real wood.

product_title: Home Styles 5530-28 Naples Vanity Bench, White Finish
review_body: Bench is Very sturdy. Love it.  Little bit more than I wanted to pay, but was well worth the money!  Very satisfied!

product_title: Dorel Home Products 13-Inch Pillowtop Pocket Coil Mattress
review_body: Good value for the money, not too soft not too hard, it took about 48 hours to fully expand, but were able to use it in the meantime. Came in a box.

product_title: Anji Mountain Bamboo Roll-Up Chairmat without Lip
review_body: I purchased this mat about 2+ years ago as I found the plastic mats didn't work well over carpeting.
