product_title: Winsome Wood Adjustable Laptop Cart/Table, Antique Walnut
review_body:
This small table has received many negative reviews, so I thought I would provide more details

PLUSES:
1) First, it made of solid wood, not plywood, which is rather surprising. It is evidently made in Thailand (according to the sticker).

2) It comes with stained wood plugs that match the result of table to cover over the visible hex bolts used to hold it together.

3) Assembly instructions are quite clear

4) I like the "old school" metal arm that allows you to adjust the angles. The table top can be tilted to different angles, but is most stable at 45 degree angles because of the way the wood top rests against the beveled arm.

CONS:
1) Some reviews have commented that it seems unstable.The problem is that the vertical pillar can shift slightly to the left or right of the cross shaft. This is easily remedied by adding two screws (you will need to drill these in yourself). I understand that this is not ideal, but it is a relatively easy fix.

2) The wood tension knob that allows you to elevate the table and hold it at different heights is not strong. Again, I think that this is an inherent limitation of this kind of design. A metal and plastic table or a metal knob would be stronger. The solution is to drill in holes at the heights you want to table to stand at, then stick a simple bolt through the holes to lock it to these heights.

3) The metal tilt locking mechanism is not super strong. True, but I think that the key is to avoid tightening it too much. Because it is sold wood, not plastic and metal, the tolerances are different. The table top does not sit rock still because of the hinge that holds it. Tightening the plastic knob beyond a certain point makes no difference because there is some inherent give in the hinge. Perhaps this leads people to try to overtighten it.

SUMMARY
It needs some tweaking, but is a good deal for the price. It is not a table for anything heavy. It is a good table for bedside reading. There is another table (http://www.amazon.com/Improvements-Adjustable-Bedside-Table/product-reviews/B005KR4NGK/ref=dp_top_cm_cr_acr_txt?showViewpoints=1) that seems inherently sturdier because it has four wheels on its base, but is also very poorly reviewed. In looking at these reviews, there are similar complaints (not locking firmly, etc.). Again, perhaps this is because of the wood design. The other table is more height stable because it has different holes drilled in to lock it to different heights and does not rely upon the tension knob.anything heavy. product_title: Ultimate Dreams Eurotop Latex Mattress
review_body:
I have been looking for a good bed for a little while now. I needed something comfortable, durable, and a reasonable price. I read that latex mattresses were highly regarded by heavy set people, and set out to look for one. Sheesh, they are pricey. I did find a helpful site called Mattress Underground when I was just about at the end of my search (I just couldn't take the old bed anymore) and read many favorable posts about this latex hybrid. It has one feature that really swayed me: The removable foam in the Euro Top! This feature means that the bed can be customized, PLUS I may get longer life out of the bed as when one top breaks down, provided the foam underneath is still good, I can just order a new top instead of a whole new bed! Also, if I get the level of firmness wrong on either side, or both sides, I can just order a new top for a small fee instead of waiting several years for the bed to wear out. I read it is a good value at $999.

I placed my order, and as noted by other users, was contacted by Chuck. I decided that a level 5 would be best, because of our unique sleeping situation.....I have a well over 6 foot, 400 lb boyfriend. I am 5'2" and 125 lbs. Our old bed was toooo soft. If he laid down on his side of the bed and I got just a little too close to the middle, my sleep was affected. Gravity would work against me. Even when I was overweight at 150 lbs, I just didn't have enough weight to smash my side down enough to where I wouldn't be affected. I would dream of our old Simmons which was much firmer than this most recent bed. I didn't feel my boyfriend roll over, and had none of the problems that our most recent bed had. The Simmons cleared me of just about all back pain, BUT, I am a side sleeper and it hurt my hips and shoulders if I stayed in any position very long. After a while of that too soft bed, I would have gladly taken that hip and shoulder pain right back. I told Chuck I wanted a medium firm bed as I wanted the most firm mattress available that could still be used by a side sleeper. He said a 5 would be the firmest he would recommend for a side sleeper. I wanted something firmer for my boyfriend, but he just said he didn't care, he would take whatever I got. Haha.

The process was very smooth. It shipped out Friday and was at my door Tuesday morning. I love how it comes packaged, so much so that barring any unusual circumstances, this is how all future beds that enter my home purchased with my money will be packaged. Lol. The long skinny box was way easier to lug up the stairs than a king size mattress would have been, especially since the stairs go about three quarters of the way up, turn and go up the final 25%. I had two boys carry it up there for me, and they had no trouble at all. They dumped it on the landing, where I proceeded to remove it from the box, and unroll it surrounded by my Christmas Eve crowd. It was about two inches thick in the plastic wrapping. I grabbed my scissors and went to town. I got it open, where it immediately started to take the shape of a very thick king mattress. I would say it hit 12" high just about immediately. I also laid back on it immediately, and it was already firm!

I did wait until Christmas day to move it into my room. We both laid down right next to each other after I got the sheets on, and would you believe it supported him? I would say he sunk in very little. There was no pulling me toward him at all. He is supported, my back isn't being twisted toward him, I am supported, and I don't notice any pain in my hips or shoulders. That being said, I haven't spent a full 8 hours in it yet. I will try to lay there a little later in the morning. I have slept on it two nights so far, and I have to say I am pretty happy with it. It does what I am told latex will do: Allow the heavier parts to sink in, but not too far while springing up into the parts that curve in and supporting them too.

I do feel like this mattress is indeed a great value, and in normal circumstances I would buy it again. In my case, I do kind of regret not going with the Bamboo Bliss sold by Dreamfoam's sister company Brooklyn Bedding because the Bamboo Bliss has a much stronger base foam that should be more durable. See, I posted in the Mattress Underground forum, and then pulled the darned trigger before Phoenix replied that I might want a stronger base foam considering my boyfriend's weight. This is a serious consideration that I missed because I got too flighty, and it is a consideration I would recommend other buyers to make. That being said, for most people, this mattress is a killer buy in my very early opinion.

I will come back and update every so often. If you want an update and notice I haven't been here for a while, just let me know and I will be glad to share my updated thoughts. If you have questions, I will be glad to answer.

Another note, if you are a member of the Mattress Underground, have posted at least once in your forum, and provide Chuck with your user name, I hear they will give you a super cool pillow. Make sure you mention it though, because I forgot and I sure would like to try that pillow :).

product_title: Roundhill Furniture 3-Piece Counter Height Dining Set with Saddleback Stools
review_headline: Works well in my space challenged apartment.
review_body: The dimensions of this dining set were critical to me. My apt is tiny with the kitchen and living area combined in one room. I needed something attractive that would mostly have just one person using it, that would work as a dining set yet look good among the living room furniture. This set is very compact with the stools stored underneath. It provides additional counter space, which is otherwise non-existent, when cleaning/preparing/cooking because it is counter height. It is well made, strong and sturdy. The padding on the stools is just slightly better than having a wood seat. How long are you going to sit on a stool without backs anyway? The few people who have seen it have commented that they like the table. I took the advice of others reviewers and coated the top with polyurethane for better protection. I think if you want it to continue to look nice (a selling point) then you will have to take care of the top. Another concern might be scraping up the rails on the stools or the low crossbar of the table with street shoes or boots. I won't have a problem with that but it's worth considering. While I think it would physically stand up to heavy use it will only remain looking good with gentler use and care. It has a clean, classy appearance that should work well for many. Assembles easily for anyone who claims to be able to care of themselves. The stools have many more screws and parts than does the table. Ships in one box about 3x4 feet. This was for me an economical solution to a pesky problem.

review_body:
I'd been sleeping on memory foam pillows for a couple weeks before looking into getting a mattress and memory foam is the way i wanted to go. Researching mattresses led me to believe it would be tough going around to local places trying to find the right one given all that had to be considered, fending off salesmen, traveling around from place to place etc.
So, i took a chance risking spending what, for me, is a hefty amount of money on a risk. Boy oh boy turned out so well. The steel holder for mattress was easy to assemble. The unpacking was a breeze. I just let the mattress decompress for two days.
I'm completely satisfied. It's a bit 'softer' than i anticipated but just fine forming nicely to my body. No scent or heat given off by this mattress.
I still, often, walk into the bedroom to just admire the mattress kinda like admiring a new car. Rather astounding how small the box is and how huge the mattress becomes.
I bought 3 1/2 yards x 108 inches hunk of fabric for the 'bottom sheet' (i don't use a top sheet). Fabric bolts come in 108 inch wide. This sheet hangs perfectly over both sides to 1 inch above the floor thus adding another dust skirt. I don't tuck in the head of mattress or sides. I do a hospital tuck on the corners.
It's a beauty. For me, well worth the risk. And, i have a hunch the thing would run a grand in a shop around here and i'd spend $50 and my time trying to find one.

- The keyboard slide rails are confusing. Keep in mind that the black capped end must face outward, and the two protusion/lip things must be on the bottom.
- The screws for the slide rails didn't screw in all the way. The srews are too big and the holes too small. I had to use power drill to get them in all the way. That was really a pain and waste of time!
- Dont tighten all the screws all way until you have the whole desk assembled. That way if you make mistakes you can easily unscrew and start over.

product_title: Sleep Innovations Shea 10-inch Memory Foam Mattress
review_headline: Good mattress (Sleep Innovations 10-inch SureTemp Memory Foam Mattress--Full Size)
review_body: Switched one of the kid's beds from twin size to full size, and needed a full-sized mattress.  Checked out mattresses at a local retailer and the kids loved the memory foam, but I did not care for the deceptive and pushy sales tactics of the retailer who was trying very hard to convince me that I was getting the "Black Friday" price if I purchased right then and there.  I don't buy things on a whim.  I research and read reviews of the products.  After researching and learning a little bit about memory foam mattresses, their pros/cons, and reading reviews for many different brands and models of mattress, I decided to try this one.  I chose this brand because the company's website looked legit, their memory foam is all made in the USA, which is supposed to ensure consistent quality of the product, and the reviews compared favorably to other brands.  The price is middle of the pack.  There are about a thousand reviews that tell you how the set up will go.  You cut open the bag, lay it down, and it expands over the course of a few hours, and smells like latex paint for days....  But the big question is, how does it feel to sleep on it?  The top few inches are a softer foam that you sink into a little, and it contours your body.  Below that, you have about 7 or 8 inches of firmer foam that give the mattress a firm feel.  Sinking into the mattress happens gradually.  It does create a little extra resistance if you try to roll over because you have to get your body out of the little impression that it has made in the foam.  If you have never slept on memory foam and are wondering if this is a firm mattress, the answer is yes, it is a firm mattress, but not like a firm spring mattress.  Closest spring mattress comparison would be a firm mattress with a soft pillowtop, although it is not really much of a comparison.  You have to sleep on this to see what it's like and if it's for you, not just lay on it for five minutes in a store.  I only slept on the mattress one night, while the kids had a sleepover elsewhere, just because I wanted to try it out.  I sleep on my belly, tend to roll around a bit, and slept really well on it.  The kids really love it.  I also have laid in it for a long time to read a book and it is extremely comfortable for that.  We have had this mattress for about two weeks and we have no complaints.  One last thought is that I would not hesitate to purchase a mattress on Amazon.  At the time, I felt like it was taking a risk because I was buying a mattress based only on the pictures, but the reality is that even if you buy from a mattress store, you are still not going to know what it is like to sleep on it for a whole night, or a whole week, or a month.  It is a gamble.  At least with Amazon, I know what kind of customer service I am going to get if there is a problem with the product.  Oh, and there are no pushy salespeople, and no price tricks where I am being treated like a fool.  UPDATE 1/2/2016:  Since my original review, we purchased another one of these mattresses in a twin size and that mattress is now a year old.  So the original mattress we purchased is 2 years old, and the second one is 1 year old and both are like new.  Used by children ~100 lbs each and showing no signs of wear at all.

product_title: Ultimate Dreams Eurotop Latex Mattress
review_headline: Almost a half year on this mattress, and still love it.
review_body:
I've been meaning to write a review for a while, but wanted to really sleep on the bed first. It's been almost half a year now (I bought the bed in June), and I must say, I'm very pleased with the bed, and with the customer service provided. Chuck is responsive and very helpful.

Like others here, I would recommend that anyone looking for a bed go to [...] and do your homework there. The admin in the MU Forum is full of helpful tips, and chances are your question has been discussed and answered already.

Final word of advice: If you decide to go the latex route, as I did (I've owned almost all other types of types of bed -- spring, water, air, memory foam), you're going to want to get a good foundation. When I originally got this bed, it seemed too soft for me, even though I ordered a 4 (I like firm beds with a little bit of give). I was going to exchange it (one of the benefits of ordering from Dreamfoam Bedding is that they make changing the firmness easy), but then I realized this was because I had it on a standard box spring. I once again went to Mattress Underground, did my research, and ended up getting the King Wood Foundation from Mattresses.net ([...] It made all the difference -- the mattress immediately felt firmer, and this firmness was consistent across the entire surface of the mattress, because the foundation supported everything evenly. And because I was a member of the Mattress Underground Forum, I even got 5% off my order! (If you join the MU forum, make sure you mention that to Chuck when ordering your mattress -- you'll get a really nice, free pillow out of it.)

So, if you're on the fence about buying a mattress online, fear not -- the quality of this mattress is top-notch, the customer service is superb, and you'll save a ton of money by buying it this way. Highly recommended.

review_body: Do not purchase this table. I bought this for my home studio and was initially excited to see it arrive in what I thought was good condition. Its basically not a chair you can spend long hours sitting in, which may be a good thing as it will urge you to get up and move around for a bit. However for my needs that is more of an annoyance than a plus and its not a chair I would recommend watching more than a single movie in for that reason, let alone working on the computer for any real period of time. The price is fair for what you get, but if you're looking for something you can sit in for longer periods of time than 2 hours at a stretch, I'd recommend something else.

Overall we are extremely happy with our purchase! We still keep going in our kids bedroom to look at them! This is one of the best purchases we have ever made.

product_title: All Natural Latex Non Blended FIRM Mattress Topper - 2 inch Thick
review_body: My first experience with a latex topper and so many confusing- or rather conflicting reviews ! When I decided on the firm there were no reviews on it only on all the other choices in firmness.  I like a fairly firm mattress and I am mostly a stomach sleeper. I don't like the feeling of  sinking in to a topper but at the same time I wanted something that was going to add some cushion to my firm mattress that is brand new and Not a cushion top. It's a tight top. When I first put the firm 2" topper on my new firm mattress I thought it didn't feel much different than he mattress without a topper. It felt about the same but a little more "give" to it. After sleeping on it for a couple of weeks the mattress and topper have broken in very nicely. It seems to have softened up to the point of being about perfect for my liking. When I lay on it, it feels really nice and cushie but still retains the support I love without any sinking in feeling. I can't say whether it's the mattress or the topper or both that has changed but now I am really loving it. When I lay on it now it says "Hello Rob I missed you-welcome back" I believe the firmness level choice has a lot to do with the existing mattress your using. That could change the impression of whether a topper is soft or firm to a good extent. This topper is a Dunlap type and are said to have a more firm feel then a Talalay type. That is why I went with the Dunlap in the first place although at first I almost thought it was going to be too firm. I sleep on the right side of a queen size mattress but when I move over to the left side to compare the feel of the mattress there is a big difference in firmness. I can get a real side by side comparison of before and after break in periods and this is why I say what mattress is under the topper makes a huge difference on how the topper will really feel to you. I believe that's why so many people have different firmness views of the same topper. Take a good feel of your mattress and decide if you would like add a touch of firmness or  softness to it but in the end the mattress will decide what you will end up with. That's my experience with latex toppers.our mattress and decide if you would like add a touch of firmness or  softness to it but in the end the mattress will decide what you will end up with. That's my experience with latex toppers.

review_headline: Very Good Quality and is NOT made in China!!!
review_body:
I ordered this for a bathroom shelf, and also ordered the baskets that go with it. The shelf comes in a long box, wrapped in paper, some styrofoam. The wood is beautiful, and of good quality, sort of heavy. Made in Thailand. The only problem I had was that the pre-drilled holes were too small. The screws they give you are a bit too big, but what I did was try to widen the holes (there are only 12) with a phillips screwdriver with a diameter a a little bigger- just twisting and turning- and it seemed to help. Says you need 2 people to put it together, but I'm a single mom and there's nobody to help me. I did it myself, improvising a bit by holding up one end of the shelf with a box under it, while working on the other end.
Once I put it together, I was so happy! I love this shelf, it's almost too nice to put in a bathroom, but it will give it such a lift. Oh, the wood is so smooth and beautiful. I'm so glad it's not made in China- Thailand evidently produces much better quality furniture. VERY HAPPY WITH MY PURCHASE.

product_title: Casual Home Breakfast Cart with Drop-Leaf Table
review_body: While the stools are nice and sturdy, the table isn't at all even after tightening every screw.  Don't use this table if you have a glass of liquid on top.  Beware.

product_title: Carolina Cottage Colonial Windsor Chair
review_body: I was looking for something to go with my farm table, something primitive. I seen these chairs and they were exactly what I was looking for. The price was very reasonably. I looked at some antique shops and similar chairs range $300+. I would highly recommend these chairs.

product_title: Zebra Pattern Room Divider
review_body: Love the way it looks but it arrived damaged and the hinges were falling or broken off.. Instead of having to pay s and h on return, I'm going to paint the cracks with black paint and get my handy husband to fix the hinges.

product_title: Sleep Innovations Shiloh Memory Foam Mattress
review_body: I read many reviews before we purchased the bed to replace our pocketed coil inner spring mattress. I couldn't believe that a mattress that was only half the cost could possibly be better than our current bed! The purchase was made due to my wife and I both having lower back and hip issues. It arrived and we opened the bag and allowed it to deflate on the box springs. Boy did it smell a lot like strong latex paint. Opened the windows and put a window fan in. Slept on it that night, the smell was still strong but we slept SO much better. No longer experiencing back or hip issues. It doesn't sleep hot like some said. Granted we have central A/C, but our room is the warmest room in the house. Nice and firm but gives just enough to be comfortable. I would buy one for everyone I know if I had the $$!! I highly recommend this bed to anyone sick of having issues with inner spring mattresses. We went through one a year until this, spending more each year!

product_title: Coffee Clutch Decorative Stacking Boxes
review_body: Really cute and looks great in my kitchen. Get tons of compliments on them too. Perfect for my kitchen decor

product_title: Sauder Edge Water Highboy TV Stand, Estate Black
review_body: After reading the reviews on this tv stand, I was a little nervous to order this item, but it was exactly what I was looking for.  I ordered it, expecting the worst.  It was delivered a day early, the packaging looked very sturdy, and like everyone else says, the box is very heavy.  There were two fairly minor dings to the surface of the boards.  Unfortunately, one of these is in the top of the stand, but towards the back so not noticable.  There were a lot of pieces to put together, but I found the instructions to be clear and easy to follow.  It did take about three hours total to complete the assembly.  And the finished product is very nice.  I think it's a very high quality, and looks far more expensive than it actually is, which was one of my main concerns.  I would recommend this tv stand to anyone in the market.  If you have the time and patience to assemble, it's worth it!

product_title: Comfort Research UltimaX Beans Refill, 100 Liters
review_headline: BOUGHT THIS SAME BAG AT WALMART FOR $12!~
review_body: This bag is pretty large.  It arrived in a plastic bag, inside of a box.  I bought 2 bags, because I was unsure of how much I needed to fill the Big Joe Lumin bean bag chair. It turns out, I only needed 1 bag to refill the bean bag. Now the chair looks good as new!

product_title: Furinno Efficient Computer Desk
review_body: I wanted a small laptop desk for my bedroom with an area for some storage.  This design looked like what I wanted, although I was worried about the quality/price.  I'd have paid more for this design with real wood, but I couldn't find anything else that looked like what I wanted.  I decided to try it.  I didn't expect much but am very pleased.  My husband was worried it might fall over if I wasn't careful, so he added a board at the bottom to stabilize the desk, and I love it.  I debated 4 or 5 stars because he added the wood, but for $30 and how perfect it is for my needs, I found it hard to knock off a star.

product_title: Frenchi Home Furnishing Wall Mirror
review_body: I love it, I actually looked like a hero to my dog, opening and putting together in less than 5 minutes. What I was so impressed with was for cost I was afraid I would look like an umpa lumpa when I looked in mirror. Nope mirror makes you look normal. No Gimmicks just a great deal. Love the wood. I plan on purchasing another I love it so much. Thank you for the fast shipping too.

product_title: South Shore Crea Craft Table
review_body: I purchased this product for my craft room and I was not disappointed.  It has tons of room for storage and the work surface is large.  I couldn't be happier.

product_title: Dexter Metal Headboard with Decorative Castings and Globe Finials
review_body:
I had spent months online and in stores looking for a new bed at a somewhat reasonable price. I found either pressboard horrors that required aneurysm-inducing assembly skills or lovely wooden beds that were out of my price range. I decided instead to keep the existing frame and just go with a simple, elegant headboard. After reading the reviews for this one, I went ahead and purchased it. Not to sound like I just joined the \\"Fashion Bed Group Dexter Headboard Cult\\" but man, the reviews were on point! Amazon, naturally, shipped the headboard quickly. Since I ordered a king-size (and I'm a petite 5-foot-nothing gal), the box was a bit cumbersome to maneuver into the house, but nothing terribly bad and certainly nothing I couldn't handle on my own (insert a haughty \\"hmpff!\\" here). The headboard itself is a beautiful dark coppery brown with bits of gold flecks in the paint; nothing gaudy that screams, \\"Hay y'all! I just came straight from a cheap big-box store! Who wants Cheez-Whiz and Thunderbird wine??\\"
Assembly was incredibly easy (sans the aforementioned aneurysm)and I had it up and attached to the bed frame within 15 minutes. The headboard is indeed quite sturdy, solid and stays in place, no wobbling or creaking. Don't ask how I tested this feature. Suffice it to say, my beau concurred that it was a quality piece... of furniture, that is.

Buy this, you will not be disappointed!

product_title: SEI, Espresso Nailhead End Table Trunk
review_body: I needed to upgrade from a lamp table with skirt.  This caught my eye right away and looks great in my room.  Shipment arrived in 3 days and I was able to put it together in about an hour.

product_title: Mohawk Home New Wave Rain Kaleidoscope Printed Rug
review_body: Wanted some rugs to keep the dog and cat hair off our new hardwood floors, wet paw prints, etc. These have worked out great so far. We'll see how they have held up after a year.

product_title: Coaster Round-Back Swivel Chair
review_body: I love it. It came promptly. was easy to assemble., looks great in my new bathroom. Not as comfy as the chair I had in there, but way more practical.

review_body: LOVE IT OS MUCH SO PRETTY THANK YOU OS MUCH JSUT AS I ORDERED TAHNK YOU SO MUCH SO PRETTY SO NICE

review_body: I was able to assemble the desk on the same day it arrive. Easy instruction to follow. It's a glass desk, so be prepared to clean this thing every other day. The keyboard tray is useless, just make sure you have a chair that can reach the height of the desk and you are good to go.

product_title: Flash Furniture Mid-Back Black Mesh Office Chair with Chrome Finished Base
review_body: I absolutely Love the color however the chair arrived and the box was in horrible condition. I am really surprised that I was not missing parts. Then the real test came when I went to start working from home and my butt hurt after just a few minutes. If I could return it I would.

product_title: Dorel Living Grannis Panel Headboard - Full/Queen
review_headline: not bad more than i thought.
review_body: I was surprised that it was actually wood and once it was together it seemed sturdy, only problem was one of the metal parts that you screw a bolt into pulled out of the wood but it seems to be ok.

product_title: Monarch Chrome Metal 48"L Bar Table
review_headline: Using as a high standing desk
review_body:
I'm using this table as a high standing desk, so I've not attached the bar hardware (glass hangers, bottle rails). Instead, the shelves are being used as storage/bookshelves. As a work desk, I think this item is great, and it works well and looks stylish with my iMac. I'm about 5'10" and the keyboard is a little above elbow-height for me, which I find comfortable for working.

The product was easy to assemble with no extra help. The quality is OK, although there was a little damage on the table top in mine. I don't know how easy returns/part replacements are because the scratch was small enough to cover with white nail polish.

My biggest warning is that it does need cleaning relatively often, because dust shows a lot on the glossy white surface, and fingerprints are very obvious on the metal.

product_title: Muv Stand-up Adjustable Height Workstation
review_headline: customer service not much help, but desk is great
review_body: This is a good, solid desk for the price.  My only complaint is that one of the holes in one of the metal pieces had not been drilled properly and so I could not assemble it.  When I called customer service they were nice but said they would send a new piece, but never did.  After 4 weeks, I took the piece to a friend who had the right tools and got it fixed myself.  Then putting it together was not easy - the directions are not easy to follow.  But now that it's together, I really like it and I find standing while working SO much better for me physically.

product_title: Zenith Products 9114W Tank Topper Space Saver, White, 21-5/8 x 25-3/4 x 6-3/4-In.
review_body: I have this over the commode in the master bath.  It's a bit small but works OK.  It could be just a tad better made as the doors don't close very snugly but then, no one sees it but my spouse and myself.  I bought this particular model because it had the little towel bar on the bottom and that is very hard to find.

product_title: Iron & Wicker Bakers Rack
review_body: This item fits perfectly in my kitchen.  It is well made and very sturdy - hidden storage space in the wicker drawers contains the clutter.

product_title: Coaster All in One Game Table/Bar Unit with Wine Shelves includes, Roulette, Blackjack and Craps
review_headline: Perfect for my space, and very affordable!
review_body: I was shopping for bars, and was quite discouraged at the cost of them.  I have never played any of these casino games, but this bar was one of the cheapest bar options I could find, and the games were just a bonus.  Assembly does require 2 people, and you have to pay attention.  Some of the boards were labeled with the wrong letter, but if you walk through the instructions and look how the pieces fit together, it shouldn't be an issue to figure it out.  Like anything else, you can nit-pick on small things, but for the price I think this is fantastic!  True, the wood bar top does not attach to the bar, it just sits on it so it can move around and slide quite easily.  I haven't found it to be a real issue or inconvenience.  Some of the cork inserts in the coaster inserts aren't seated perfectly.  Doesn't bother me, and no one has pointed it out when sitting around and using it.  The roulette wheel works great, lots of fun.  Yes, it's plastic.  But again, for this price, I think it's awesome.  The bar comes with everything needed to play the games, except some actual rules of play, which I easily looked up online.  Bottom line: it fits my space perfectly, it's very sturdy, it looks nice, the games are functional and can add fun to any group of friends hanging around, and I think this is a great score for the price if you are looking for a wood bar.

product_title: 2pc Home Office Writing Desk & Side Chair Set
review_body: Beautiful desk.  Awesome price.  The picture does not do the desk justice, as it doesn't show the world map on the top of the desk.  Very sturdy, easy to assemble, and gorgeous.

review_body: Easy installation - size is perfect for the space in my bedroom! Has a tinge of purple "look" which is awesome with my purple drapes!

product_title: DreamFoam Mattress Ultimate Dreams Latex Mattress
review_body:
I know a common complaint was that foam beds are too soft, and that you feel trapped as you sink into them too much. Also, my wife likes a hard bed anyway. So the decision to go with their "firm" level 3 bed was easy. This bed is firm, but you still sink just a bit into it and it supports you wonderfully. If you want an extremely firm bed, then go level 1. The cover over the whole mattress is nice and thick and high quality. The top cover is padded a bit with a bamboo material, and the bottom is sturdy and rubber-like to protect the mattress from whatever you have it on I assume.
I am extremely happy with this bed when I wake up in the morning. Currently it is just on my old box spring, but I hope to get rid of that, as it squeaks still when I move around. I want the full no, noise, no movement experience, hehe.
This bed has a slightly sweet smell as it airs out, not the harsh smell that many memory foam beds have. I researched just about every foam and latex bed out there, and the price on this one considering it is latex is unbeatable. I have said it before, but I am very happy with this purchase.

review_body: The hubs is a golf nut.  Needed a better way to display his treasures.  This case is wonderful.  Very nice construction...elegant, sturdy, unpretentious and simple.  Quite heavy!

product_title: Raised Extra Long Twin Air Mattress By Fox Airbeds Xl Inflatable Air Bed
review_body:
I've used a lot of air mattresses through the years, and this one is the best quality mattress that I have owned. Well worth the extra cost. It is much thicker vinyl than any I've come across. The one problem that I have is, that because of the thickness of the vinyl, it tends to be hard. Reducing the air pressure helps, but by doing that it defeats the purpose of the side rails, as they also deflate and increase the possibility of rolling off the bed. However, this can be avoided by using a thick pad, which allows the bed to be further inflated and still sleep comfortably. The size is accurate and very roomy. I've been using this bed every day for about a week and have had no problems with leakage. Overall, it is the best inflatable bed that I have owned, and highly recommend to anyone.

Revised:
Now, a couple of months later, I have to knock this mattress from a 5 down to a 4. The bed is still a good bed, but if used frequently like I have been doing, the sides seemed to have stretched out about 6 inches on each side. It doesn't seem to affect the bed, however, that expansion on the sides makes the bed take up a lot more room. I still recommend this bed, but you will have to allow for side expansion if used frequently.

Revised Again:
Now knocked down to 3 stars. In addition to the above, this mattress has had a tendency to develop leaks along the top seam line (the one that connects the frocked top to the mattress. This is an outside seam and so far I have had seven leaks - all from that seam. It's a real pain to fix. If anyone else has a leak problem it is probably from that seam, and difficult to locate. Once found, I have had success if fixing the leak using \\"Plumbing GOOP\\". Don;t use the attachment, but instead use a bead right out of the tube, and spread it with your finger until that area is completely covered. Let it rest a few hours before re-inflating.

product_title: Maple Computer Desk
review_body: Arrived in time and packaged well.  All needed screws, etc. were provided & directions fairly easy to follow.  The only thing I did not like was that the back was not completely "finished".  This would not be an issue if desk is up against a wall, but in my case the desk needed to face outward and toward an entry door and it looked unfinished and like pieces were missing.  Thankfully my husband was able to cut out pieces to cover the back of the shelf and made some "trim" strips so it now looks "finished".  It is a nice looking desk for the price and we selected it initially because it looked nice in the photo and was the perfect size for our small office space.  Just beware that the back is not finished so it will look best against a wall...

product_title: Boss Task Chair with Adj Arms
review_headline: Simple, sturdy and comfortable office chair
review_body:
After owning this chair nine months, one phrase comes to mind: \\"great design is when it goes un-noticed\\". This is a simple chair that works exactly as intended. This chair has few bells and whistles and nothing goes wrong with it. The seat is comfortable, the back rest does not create pressure points and it rolls without difficulty. The chair offers swivel, tilt and hydrologic height adjustment. The fabric is smooth and durable with an understated texture design. The lack of arms allows for flexible seating options (e.g., back to the side) and the ability to push it up to the desk for storage - perfect for limited and multi-use spaces. The base is a strong (polycarbonate?) plastic, which means there are no welds to break. The downsides to this chair are that it does not pump as high as some others and is not Cradle-to-Cradle design.

I bought this chair after buying one, in a similar price-point, with all the bells and whistles. That chair was uncomfortable, made my skin itch and required constant adjusting due to pressure points. That chair broke within two weeks and I had to ship it back to Amazon. I went with this simple chair and am happy with the purchase. I don't even notice it!

product_title: Zebra and Hot Pink High Heel Shoe Chair
review_headline: Looks just like this, but wobbly, pressboard falling apart, DISASTER
review_body:
The highly anticipated chair arrived dingy. There were chips of the OSB (top rate construction!) flaking from inside and sticking to the outside fabric. Yet, those nitpicky observations would soon be the least of my worries.

1. The \\"instructions\\" fail to note that the holes are not aligned, and are so poorly drilled that only one of the four would actually hold a screw.
2. That's assuming you can find -- and get to the \\"holes\\", as you will be working blind.
3. Say hello to contorting your arm (and a mighty thin arm it must be) through the raw-chopped slit in the fabric.
4. Note that you are likely to rip the entire back off the chair trying to grope around for all four holes, much less insert a screw in any of them.
5. I was now lying half on my back, with my hand getting splinters trying to feel the holes around the crumbling OSB wood.
6. At this angle, I could also see the chimp-worthy job of wildly shooting a few giant staples along the fold of the heel seam (no need for straight lines, fit or smoothness).
7. Finally, I jerry-rigged the beast so that the one screw was seated (!!) and one was loosely connected (the hole was drilled at an angle so that only a couple threads would catch and none of the others would hold). The others just fell out, so I gave up and righted the chair for a look.
6. It was so uneven, it looked like the result of a 20-foot tall party girl on a walk of shame after too much cheap booze and dancing, tilted and wobbling. I tried to sit down, but nearly fell off from the tilt -- and unseated that 2nd clinging screw.
7. Still trying to be optimistic, I carefully slid it to a rug, instead of the hardwood floor. No help.
8. I was ready to set it on fire by now, and it certainly would go up in flames in a heartbeat. I'd left a trail of OSB flakes behind me.
9. I've walked away to cool off. The thing is so heavy it would cost me a fortune to send it back, if that's even possible. I canonly dream of using it for target practice in a field. I would kick it, if that wasn't such a bad pun. I just hate it. If I had the energy to do a video review, I believe it could win Sundance, or at least America's Funniest Home Videos! (There may be something to that!)
10. I would give it a MINUS FIVE HUNDRED STARS if I could.
P.S. The bright red white and blue TAG that says \\"MADE IN USA!\\" made me want to cry. Is this REALLY what we've become? DO NOT BE LIKE ME: RIPPED OFF BY AN EXPENSIVE PIECE OF TRASH!

product_title: Miracle Desk Stand up Desk - Convert your regular desk to a stand up desk in seconds
review_headline: Inexpensive upgrade to a standard desk
review_body:
I've been reading a lot about stand-up desks and there are some Google employees in my building using them. They seem to like them, so I thought I'd check them out. The only problem is that dedicated stand-up desks are expensive and I wasn't sure I wanted to spend several hundred dollars only to find I didn't like one.

This add-on table-top desk is an excellent solution. I ordered two of them (for two desks I have) and the assembly was very easy (only a screwdriver was needed, all other parts were included). It's sawdust furniture (particle board), but of reasonable quality. Mine came with a little bit of glue on the finish of the desktop so I gave it one less star in this review for lack of quality. Otherwise, it's a very solid piece of particleboard furniture. I would have been willing to pay a little more for it to be manufactured in North America (I hate supporting China).

One word of caution: I'm a little over six-feet tall and have a 30\\" inch desk. I got lucky and this add-on table-top desk is the perfect height. I really got lucky because this desk is non-adjustable. Be aware of that and take some measurements before you order. The advantage of true stand-up desks is that they are often height adjustable. However, they are also ten-times as expensive. If you can make this table-top desk work, great!

Oh, and it's going to save me money on a light box, too.  I was going to get one so I could use it to transfer preliminary drawings to a better quality of paper for finishing. product_title: Sleep Master - 12" Gel memory foam mattress
review_headline: Good mattress, with a couple of quirks
review_body:
After years of sleeping on memory foam mattress toppers, I finally decided to take the plunge into a full memory foam mattress. Overall, it has been a pleasant experience. I do not \\"sink into\\" the mattress quite as much as I had anticipated, but it's plenty soft and I've woken up feeling well-rested and comfortable (If 1 is extra-hard and 5 is extra-soft, this is maybe a 3.5 or 3.75). It also sleeps quite cool - I really can't deal with sleeping hot (I keep the AC at 66 at night and use a thin microfiber blanket), and I've had no complaints about the mattress sleeping hot.

The sizing is a bit misleading - it does not feel a full 12 inches high, and I had a tiny bit of trouble squeezing it into an Ikea Malm frame (although it ultimately fit, and the tight fit may actually help the fitted sheet stay on the bed!).

Overall, I think this is a solid purchase and I'm happy with it so far. If I had to buy it again, I would look into getting a thicker model from Sleep Master, just because I think that it might help enhance the \\"sinking in\\" feeling that I like about sleeping on memory foam.

product_title: Malibu Mid Back Office Chair in Black Leatherette
review_body:
I was a bit hesitant when placing my first order as there are a lot of sellers of this Eames knock-off and there are essentially two versions of different quality that look very similar. I'm happy to report that this is the high quality version that is suitable for office use.

I had no issues with these chairs from this seller and ended up purchasing around 18 chairs for our creative office space.

I have one gripe about the quality of machining and manufacturing - the pieces don't exactly fit together perfectly. There are pretty big tolerances in where the base screws to the frame as well as the arms. In some cases you will really have to make use of the long bolts to tighten these pieces together and against their will. In one instance, I was not able to get a third screw on, as the holes were just too far apart. This might not be acceptable for most - but we were okay to live with them and it has so far passed the office test with daily abuse from clients and employees.

The leatherette is quite durable and can stand up to daily use - granted most of our team of So Cal employees are under 165lbs, it can handle full recline, wear from banging into the table and other chairs (the chrome plating is rather durable) and other expected office use.

I have a pair of genuine HM Eames chairs in my home office that I would say are not as durable since the aluminum is softer than the chrome used in these Malibu Mid Back chairs.

If you are looking for a very good replica for the Eames Aluminum Management chairs, these are not the ones for you. In my opinion they look nothing like the originals as the arms do not wrap all the way around and join each other, the base is much chunkier than the original, the sides of the frame do not have same \\"s\\" curvature and inward taper towards the top, and the base frame does not have the sleek \\"v\\" shape of the original.

If you are looking for a durable and modern lookingchair designed in the spirit of the original - then these are for you. Just keep in mind that these are incredibly popular so chances are the neighboring office may have a couple of these as well (as does my neighbor). You'll see them used a lot in TV shows as well in lieu of the originals.

product_title: Coaster Furniture Loretta 5 Drawer Chests
review_headline: Gorgeous chest of drawers, notwithstanding the delivery drama
review_body:
Almost took off a point for the delivery company (SAIA) drama we've had to go through these last two days just to get the chest. Just picture having the delivery company call you to schedule the delivery. You take a half day off from work to wait for it in the 1-5 p.m. window and it's a no show/no call. YOU have to call to find out what happened. THEN they decide to deliver the ONE single chest in a semi truck that drives into a gated neighborhood with narrow streets. The truck almost gets stuck going around a corner and there are broken tree limbs everywhere. Neighborhood patrolman comes huffing and puffing for us to go through the neighborhood for a 3/4 mile to pick up all the limbs. Ugh! I would like to point out that deliveries have never been an issue with DHL, Fedex or UPS or a myriad of other local furniture delivery or construction trucks that make it out here. And I know for a fact that SAIA in OKC has smaller delivery vehicles. Grrr...

Anyway, the chest came well packed. It is obvious Coaster Furniture tries to ensure no damage happens. The chest itself is well made, sturdy and already fully assembled. It has a nice contemporary look and a dark espresso finish. The inside drawers ARE unfinished, but I don't see this as an issue. It's real wood and not particle board. The drawer pulls are assembled to the inside of the drawer so you do need to unscrew and assemble them to the outside. Overall, I'm quite surprised and pleased at the quality of this chest of drawers. You can't beat the value for the quality. Did I mention the thing is already assembled? I was anticipating at least an hour to put this thing together! Instead we picked up broken tree limbs. Hah!

product_title: Home Styles Nantucket Counter Stool - Distressed Black
review_body:
I purchased two of these chairs, and both had problems. Each chair, as expected, must be assembled. The instructions were inadequate and it took some time to figure out which bolt went where (why do all three sizes of bolts have practically the same name?). The first chair was mis-drilled. The holes on the back legs into which the rung dowels were to go had been drilled two inches too high. I would have sent the chair back, except I was pressed for time to have some functional bar stools. So I re-drilled the holes (that's a 3/8-inch drill bit, for those of you who may come across the same problem) and filled the original holes with ebony-colored wood filler. After assembly, one back leg was visibly 1/4-inch shorter than the others and the chair wobbled. This was not a result of my retro-fitting the hole on that leg: my measuring tape showed that, sure enough, that leg was actually shorter than the others. I had to shim the leg with a footing to keep it from wobbling. After assembly, oddly, I noticed that there were three extra bolts and a couple of extra wood screws. Not complaining about that last part, but it does seem like a quality oversight. I went over the instructions and examined the chair again and there is no indication that I left anything out.

The second chair was not quite as bad, except that the wood screws were entirely missing from the package. I had to go to the hardware store and get replacements (1\\" #6 flat-head wood screws, for those of you who may come across the same problem). Again, there were two extra bolts at the end.

As far as comfort is concerned, the seats are a bit too hard and the backs are a bit too vertical to be particularly comfortable.

Conclusion: That's two strikes on this Home Styles brand chair and I advise all to avoid it. There are too many other options available and you shouldn't waste your time and money on this one.

product_title: Standee Classic Bamboo Stand Up Desk
review_body:
Several reasons why this is a 5-star product.

I researched several standing desk options, all of which I felt were pricey for a piece of furniture to hold up your desktop.

I have an L-shaped desk with one area used for work and one for personal.

I bought an adjustable Ergotron arm for the work area and it works fine. Price was high however. It does allow me to raise and lower the desktop when I want to sit down. Attached to the arm are two monitors, a keyboard and mouse.

I wanted something more reasonably priced for the personal desk area and I didn't care if it was non-adjustable.

Most of the standing desks you find stand either too high or too low;
are made of cheap fiber board with a low weight capacity;
or the desk area is too small to hold your monitor, mouse, keyboard, stapler, tape, etc.

The Standee is solid bamboo wood, so it's strong and light. The desk area is 30 inches wide by 20 inches deep. Vertically it raises my desktop by 14 inches.

You can buy a Standee at 10- or 12- inch heights. And they will soon introduce a 16-inch model.

I have a Dell touchscreen monitor that is heavier than a standard monitor; it weighs about 20 pounds.
After adding all the other usual desktop items we deal with daily, the desk is solid as a rock.

Assembly is dead simple with no tools needed. You can tell it is a high quality piece and well-engineered.

My only issue was color. Standee offers two options - natural and amber.
However, the amber model is not a finish color that Standee adds - it is naturally occurring darker bamboo wood.

On the Standee website, the amber looks much darker than the natural model. Amber would have fit better with my current desk.

The one delivered to me looks natural.

A quick call to Standee was a pleasant surprise. Jen was very helpful and asked I send her a picture of the desk.
I did this while on the phone with her. She showed the photo around the office and they could not tell if what I was sent was natural or amber. The box said amber.

Then she said they were expecting a shipment of darker bamboo wood next month and she would send me a new amber desk - and then I could send back the first one.

I found this to be excellent customer service by this company. Uncommon in today's world of RMA numbers and requiring the customer to first send back the item before you get another one.

I would highly recommend this item and will update this review later.

review_body: I chose this table for the color, size, and the drawer.  It was a little difficult to put together with the shelf.  However, when the instructions were reread, it was easier.  I am pleased with the table.

product_title: New City Brand New Contemporary Black Brown and Beige Modern Wavy Circles Area Rug
review_body:
I just was looking online at ideas for a rug under my cocktail table in the living room. When I came to this rug and saw the low price, I decided to take the chance. I thought it would be this chintsy, very thin rug...well it's not. It is 50% wool, so it is soft and has substance to it and looks way more expensive than the price. This modern looking rug is absolutely beautiful! It has this very modern swag and the colors are gorgeous. I got black and pomegranate pillows to match. When my girlfriends saw it, they wanted the information and they are ordering it also, that's how art deco it looks!

I read others saying about the smell. When I received it, the rug did infact smell. But it is from being wrapped up and it took 2 weeks for it to air out. I didn't do anything to the rug except vacuum it and the smell is COMPLETELY gone. I think people are putting products on the rug to get the smell out and they are not giving the rug a chance to let out it's gases/smell.

I would DEFINITELY order this product AGAIN! It came in 4 days and I absolutely LOVE it...can't take my eyes off it.

product_title: Sleep Innovations Shea 10-inch Memory Foam Mattress
review_body:
After an incredible sleeping experience on an expensive tempurpedic, we came home from a recent vacation and decided it was time to get a new mattress. We were sleeping on a mattress that was too soft and both of us were tossing and turning throughout the night. I am a light sleeper and every time my husband would move it would wake me up.

When this new mattress came, I was worried it was too hard. There isn't that cozy, sink-in feeling when you climb in to bed. But after the first week we both agreed we were sleeping so much better! My husband hardly moves at night now (and I can no longer feel it when he does), his daily back pain is gone, and we are more rested in the morning. It took me a couple of weeks to really adjust to the foam mattress feeling but I am so glad we made the switch. This is a great price and I see no reason to spend thousands on a more expensive brand to get the same results.

review_body: I am highly disappointed by this \\"artist\\" and their \\"hand painted\\" ceramics. The creative thought behind this \\"piece\\" is clearly a knock off of Sheila Wolk's Mermaid Metamorphosis. No credit is given to the original artist. Shame on you.

review_headline: Buy 2 for a pair!  These are AWESOME!
review_body: I recently moved into an apartment that has southern exposure. I'm also very sensitive to light when I sleep and need near total darkness. product_title: Flash Furniture High Back Leather Chair, Black
review_body:
Crazy good chair for a low low price.

I'm about 6 foot, 135 pounds. Very scrawny person. I sit in front of my computer all day every day.

The chair came in some crap box but all the parts were wrapped up good, and the components are strong and heavy so I wasn't worried. Assembly was easy as pie (except theres always ONE stupid caster wheel on every chair that refuses to go in, but I got that sucker in eventually). After I got it done, it was AMAZING. Firm but cozy butt and back cushions let the chair melt away into the background while you're reading or on browsing the web or pwning some n00bs on your favorite multiplayer game. This chair leans a good distance back and it is able to pick my feet up off the ground (very comfortable). The armrests are a little wobbly but thats because they are adjustable, though the part where they attach to the chair is rock-solid. Also, the armrests are SO SOFT, my elbows are like uguu so amazing. I took em off though cause they get in the way guitar playing. Everything on this chair works smoothly and perfectly.

It does have stitching all through the butt and back though, so when the padding becomes flat through use (it is inevitable after a few years of heavy use with any padded chair) you will probably feel the stitching as little lines throughout the chair, but I don't see this thing going flat any time soon. Also the chair is heavy, but it's not like you're going to be lifting it often. The chair does get a little warm, but that just means you should turn up your air conditioning.

This is an AMAZING chair for the price. Just go and get it. Way better than any staples crap in the same price-range.

1. Redefines the concept of firm. Typically I preferred medium to soft mattresses but had heard that as you get older you should go with a firmer mattress. The foam layers add a softness over the firm, the sensation is literally like melting into the mattress but with the underlying firm layer, really offering the best of both worlds. A side benefit of the firm was unexpected. I am middle-age, at that point in my life where I can pull a muscle just rolling over in bed or getting out of bed. The firmness of the mattress offered more resistance that makes it easier to roll over or get out of bed.

When the temperature gets to about 74 and above it can be a little warm for me because I do like to have a sheet and blanket on top. Just the other day I was taking a nap and when I got up noticed the temperature was 80 degrees. I was very surprised because I had slept great and wasn't hot and can only attribute this to the AirCool technology.

product_title: Crown Mark Devon Chair Side Table
review_headline: You can tell it was made in China
review_body: Check this item carefully before assembly if you decide to risk this purchase!! This is definitely a case of where you get what you pay for.  Both this item and the similar but less expensive Crown Mark Pierce Chair Side Table (non-marble top) were damaged on arrival (chipped corners, divots, etc). First I was asked by the vendor to send a picture of the damage, then I was offered a partial refund. Eventually I was issued a full refund without any instructions to return the product so I kept it.   UPDATE:  After 3 years I still have it and it's holding up ok but I wouldn't spend more than $25 to buy a product of this quality.

product_title: Dorel Asia Toddler Bed
review_body: This bed is a very nice toddler bed.  Putting it together is easiest when you have an extra set of hands, so be sure to ask for help.  The hardest part of putting it together was installing the slats for the bottom of the bed.  I had maybe 2 slats that were cut a little short, so the pegs did not quite fit into the side rails.  I noticed that it did not fit like it should when I tightened it down the first time.  So, a word of advice.  When putting the pegs into the wooden slats, stuff them half way with toilet tissue.  This will insure a tighter fit when your tightening it up and save you a lot of frustration.  That was the only modification I had to make to this bed.  No biggie.  My one gripe (which is why it got 4 out 5 stars) was the color.  I ordered the espresso, and it looks more like a light cherry.  Could be a screw up, or it could be someone color blind.  I expected something darker than what I received, but it's not a big deal.  Our crib was the same exact color, so I'm not concerned.  But I would definitely suggest this bed to any parent looking for a good deal.

product_title: Winsome Wood Quilt Rack, Walnut
review_body:
There isn't a single solitary piece of wood drilled in a straight line to the narrow skinny brittle piece of wood a screw is supposed to go in nor deep enough for the screws, Not even half the depth of the screws is drilled. I had to buy additional bits for an electric drill driver to put these screws in and put the piece together, such as it is... product_title: LUCID 14 Inch Memory Foam Mattress - Triple-Layer - 5.3 Pound Density Ventilated Gel Memory Foam - CertiPUR-US Certified - 25-Year Warranty
review_headline: Quit reviewing and just buy it already!!!!
review_body:
Seriously, if you're like me I researched and researched until my entire computers history was taken up by memory foam mattress reviews. I was so nervous purchasing a mattress on the internet that I've never tried out. There's an awesome website I would encourage everyone to go to if your considering buying anything sleep related. It's called sleeplikethedead.com.

I've now had this mattress for two weeks and so far I absolutely love it. I can't wait to go to bed at night. There are some minor drawbacks that just come with the fact that it's memory foam.
1. It does get a little heated for me. I'm already a warm sleeper but with this mattress I have to sleep with a sheet.
2. I fall asleep very easily on this mattress however when I change positions at night it wakes me up because it's difficult to maneuver out of the body impression you've created. Hopefully after time my body will adapt to this.

Other than those two things this is a fantastic mattress for the price. So please, stop reviewing after this one and just purchase it. You won't be disappointed.

review_body:

All the parts & hardware are labeled nicely.
I would recommend this heater, but for a smaller room. It looks a bit lost in our front LR.

We used this fireplace this morning (it was cold! outside!) and it warmed up our chilly LR to a comfy temperature in only 15 minutes! Great heater!!

product_title: Catnapper Cloud 12 Microfiber Power Oversized Recliner
review_headline: Worst recliner ever.  Manufacturer defect on leg destroyed our floor.
review_body:
We bought this chair in Late July. The stuffing in the back of the chair was literally falling down into the base and had to be replaced by a repairman from the store we got it from. A few weeks later, another part of the back did the same thing. The back springs can now be felt because of this and the stuffing they "fixed" it with made it worse as that section is very stiff and hurts your back. This was very comfortable for the first few weeks but feel flat in both the back and seat. Instead of feeling cushioned, you feel the coil springs the sales clerk bragged about. Ouch! Also, we aren't big people, so the wear shouldn't have been an issue especially since this is obviously made for a larger sized adult.

That isn't the worst part. There was a manufacturer defect on one of the plastic feet protectors that came on the chair. It had a sharp piece of plastic sticking out on the bottom we weren't aware of. Since the feet glide on the floor easily, the bad leg put a large gouge and scratches into our beautiful hardwood floors. The store we bought this from refuses to take responsibility even though we bought the extended protection plan that was supposed to cover these types of issues. This chair is barely six months old and has become such a big headache that we just went and bought new furniture to replace this chair and plan to donate it. Now we have a sore back and a damaged floor from buying this overpriced junk. Do yourself a favor and buy something else.

review_headline: Don't Buy It-I would rate it as Less Than Zero, but that's not an option
review_body:
Anyone who looks at this would think that it had 3 drawers. Well, guess what. It only has one drawer, the small one. The middle slot has a false fascia that makes it appear as if it has two drawers. What it has is a pull down front with a slide out for a computer keyboard. Hello, if I had wanted one of those I would have ordered one. Now the instructions, when you actually open the box, clearly show three drawer fronts. Once you open the assembly guide, there and only there, does it say that there is only one drawer and a keyboard slot.

Finally, have these people not heard of laptops. I don't know many people who actually use a pull out drawer like this, but when they do, its specifically identified in the specifications. Keyboard pull outs does not a computer desk make. What a shame. I will spend a fair amount of money fixing this train wreck, because I'm not interested in packing it back up (it weights 50 pounds) shipping it back, only to hope that I am reimbursed. Shame on you. If this sounds strident, so be it. I have not been this irritated about a product in a very long time.

product_title: Catskill Craftsmen Butcher Block Workcenter PLUS with Drop Leaf
review_headline: Good product but not worth the money
review_body:
This product costs (at the time) nearly $1000.00 and I got it on sale for $689.00. Based on several factors which I'll explain I feel that this item should be around 400 dollars or less.

First the GOOD things. For as large as this workcenter is and as much assembly is required I have to admit they really nailed all the hole alignments. Everything fit together perfectly which usually is not the case. Once together it feels sturdy and my wife enjoys using it, so it's a good product. It looks good especially after we cleaned it up and oiled it.

Now for the bad. Maybe I misread the advertisement but I was under the impression that this was a solid hardwood piece, it is not. Most of this unit is hardwood veneer over some type of compressed wood or plywood, it is not solid hardwood. Also, some of the construction methods used leave a lot to be desired. For instance, the bottom of the unit simply sits on pins that are not even fastened into the wood. All of the pins in my unit fit very loose (maybe due to humidity levels I'm not sure). Also, the hardware and how it's arranged NEEDS to be thought out better by the manufacturer. Maybe instead of just throwing all the hardware in a bag they should use labeled separate bags for each type of hardware so it's not confusing. I'm used to building things and I know what screws are what but for a novice this would end up being a point of frustration. Also, several screws were missing in my kit and I had to use what I had on-hand, this should not happen. In fact more hardware than is needed should be supplied in case you drop and/or lose a screw. Also, the finish on this wood is pretty rough, rough enough that I took 600 grit sandpaper across the whole thing to smooth it out. I tried wiping it down (saw dust residue was on everything) and it was so rough that the wood was grabbing the towel and it wouldn't slide across the surface.

I think what I'm getting at is that for the money paid for this item I should not have noticed these types of issues. If I had to do this over again I would either insist on paying less money for this item or I would spend a little bit more and just buy something Amish made that I know is solid hardwood and ready to go. Hope this helps.d for this item I should not have noticed these types of issues. product_title: Flash Furniture High Back Black Leather Executive Office Chair
review_body:
Its a cheap chair. But, for the price its a good value.

The box arrived intact but the contents were poorly packed. A piece of the structure had rested against the lower upholstered part putting a dent in the foam that wont come out.

The top has a zippered cover. The zipper pulls are sewn to the chair. The zipper itself has split open on one small part; the two rows of teeth separated from each other. If it splits open more I may try cutting the threads holding the zipper pull tab and rezipping it.

The color is a very, very dark brown. At first I thought they sent a black one until I saw it under sunlight.

Its easy to assemble, comfortable to sit in, and has has these features: tilt the bottom, raise and lower the chair, raise and lower the backrest, and tilt the backrest forward and back. You can lock the back tilt, or if you pull the lever for the backrest tilt all the way up it stays in that position and the back moves freely, using spring tension to hold itself to your back and allowing you to lean back into it, pushing it all the way down when you lean back. There is some knob on the bottom also to adjust a tension but I didn't investigate what it does. I guess it adjusts how strong the back tilt spring is but I don't know.

The arm rests have a height adjustment and can be left off the chair if you prefer not to use them, or can easily be removed later.

The metal parts of the chair are thick and the welds are decent. The black paint is smooth. The caster part of the chair is plastic. The plastic wheels are silent and roll easily.

For the price I'm happy with it. 1 star off for shoddy packaging.

product_title: DynastyMattress- Therapeutic Deluxe 10" with Cool AirFlow HD Memory Foam Mattress with High Quality Visco-Elastic Memory Foam, with FREE Pillow!
review_headline: OK but not what I expected
review_body:
I read the many rave reviews on memory foam mattresses and, living far from mattress stores, I made the assumption that it would be easy to get used to the differences. My mistake.

So I'd advise you not to buy a memory foam mattress if you've never tested one. Trust me on this, it's nothing like an inner spring mattress, very slow to respond to pressure. Once you're in it, YOU'RE IN IT. The support and comfort are there but everything happens in sloooow mooootion. Sunk into your personally sculpted shape, it requires more energy to get up too.

Second note: If chemical smells bother you allow one week or more for the mattress to release the foam's chemical gases before sleeping on it. It takes two weeks or more before the smell is completely gone. Had I known I would have planned for two weeks.

review_headline: This is the one I was looking for
review_body:
[[ASIN:B006TILUBU Alera Etros Series Petite Mid-Back Multifunction Mesh Chair, Black]]I love this chair/ It is the correct size for me with so many options to adjust for personal customization. I am a senior woman 5'3\\" and weighing 120 pounds. I worked for many years in a computer room on any number of chairs that were not to my size or comfort. Every office chair I have purchased for my home use is 'man size'. Just try searching for women's or petite chairs and their won't be many. There are only a few reviews for this item on Amazon but you will find many great reviews for it if you simply search.

This chair works for me, and works beautifully. The height adjustment is generous from low to higher than most of this type of chair. All of the other adjustments make the chair personal and comfortable to your satisfaction. It did take me several times of getting up & down to do all of the adjusting just the way I wanted it. Two people would make all of the back adjustments easier, especially the backrest up/down and also the lumbar adjustment capabilities.

I could not slide the seat back and forth but my son came to my rescue and got it to move once quite hard and after that it was just fine. It is a heavy, sturdy chair and the mesh is nice and tight. The seat is a tad firm but I suspect it will soften up with use or I will add a cushion. I did not purchase this item here at Amazon even though I first found it here. That was because to my amazement I found it quite a bit cheaper searching around the web.

The assembly instructions are pictures with text, the parts are few with much of the chair already assembled. It took me less than a half hour because if you've assembled one, they all go together the same way. It rolls nicely and I sit 'well' in it. The arm's could be a more padded & softer for my taste but that is mostly my fault because I generally lean on my elbow. I highly recommend the chair, especially for someonemy size and wanting to adjust seat height, lumbar and backrest height. It is advertised as a 'petite' chair so I can understand that a good size man would not have praise for it. It does it all for me!!

product_title: Kitchen Serving Utility Cart Stand w/4 Tiers Storage Area & Drawer
review_headline: Reasonably sturdy wuth some significant flaws
review_body: As one would expect with mail-order flatpack furniture, the instructions and pre-drilled hole alignment leave much to be desired.  Assembly took around an hour with two people, with at least a quarter of that spend on troubleshooting the drawer.  For future purchasers, be sure of the alignment of the drawer pieces before snapping them together, because reconfiguring them afterwards is a non-trivial task.  The parts were all accounted for are arrived undamaged in the box.  The seller even took some additional precautions against damage during transit by layering more cardboard on the box corners.  The final product is serviceable but not incredibly sturdy.  Its a shame the manufacturer went with particleboard for the wooden components, especially the drawer front, as it detracts from both the appearance and stability of the assembled cart.  As other reviewers have mentioned regarding similar products, the power outlet built into the frame is not grounded so cannot be used with most models of microwaves.

I bought mine in the fall of 2011. Already now within the last year the chair already has problems:
1. The chair makes all sorts of pops, squeaks, groans and cracking noises everytime I move around in the chair. It is quite disturbing to my wife who can hear it anywhere in the house.
2. The back rest attaches to the seat via a large metal bar that clamps to the base. It never holds it's height but always slides all the way to the bottom.
3. Worst of All, and unforgivable in my opinion that marks this chair as a piece of junk: The bottom cushion went completely flat. If I make my fist int a ball and push down on the seat cushion, I immediately hit the wood support base. I'd estimate that the cushion is physically about 1/2 inch thick now.

Luckily I had a warranty on this and I got my full money back. I'm looking into purchasing another chair again. They should stick to making beds. But the quality of their chairs makes seriously question the quality of their beds if the cushioning fell flat so soon.

review_body: I inherited a used mattress when we got married 3 years ago, and this was the first new mattress we have gotten for ourselves. I was in a minor car wreck in 2009 and each year I notice more and more damage to my spine, especially my neck. Along with a good neck pillow, this mattress helps so much. When you lay down, the bed absorbs the pressure from the height difference between different points of your body as you lay flat. It's like sleeping on a cloud - you lay down for the first time and instantly realize what all those commercials are talking about when they refer to pressure points because for the first time ever you're not feeling them when you lay down (despite the fact you never knew they were there with your old mattress.) If you've never had something or tried something you obviously don't know what you're missing out on since you've never had it and it wouldn't be a bother to you, of course...but once you've tried it you can never go back, and I'll never go back to a traditional mattress.

product_title: South Shore Axess Collection Desk
review_headline: Good product, hard to assemble, sent flawed parts
review_body:
Bought two. Put one together ok. Instructions suck. I am an engineer, and find IKEA instructions a breeze to follow. Instructions on this desk suck. Pictures are horrible, and the naming conventions for parts are unnecessarily confusing.

Trying to put the second one together, I found one part broken. Another major part (C1) was a just a slab, with no holes for screws! I emailed them and they sent the parts. Took almost 2 weeks. Then I found out two parts are missing! Why can't they do any QA before they ship? Wait a minute...after a lot of frustration, I found out they just mislabeled two parts...P should have been labeled D and G should have been labeled B! Learn your alphabets!

Desk is good overall, but heavier than I expected. The slab for the shelf under the drawer has nothing holding it to prevent horizontal movement. Bad design, but not a big deal. I will find some of way securing it so it doesn't fall on my foot. The shelf on the desk would be more useful if it were just a bit deeper and the back support was a bit taller.

Overall, a fair product at a fair price, but QA issues are a big deal, so I won't be buying this brand again. I also saw some good choices in IKEA for lower price after I had already bought this one. I have bought IKEA a lot (probably 20 furnitures so far), and never had issues with parts a single time.

product_title: Summer Breeze 6-Drawer Dresser
review_body: I purchased a bedroom set consisting of the chest, dresser, and bedside cabinet. As much as you hear of all the gripes and moans of buyers. The rule of thumb is you get what you pay for. This is no different to most furniture out there, the only difference for the most part is you save money by putting it together yourself. My reason for this review is to help all those who worry and moan about these pieces. I suggest to you ALL to use glue on all the dowels and where wood meets wood. secondly and most importantly throw the backing board out in the trash and take a wee trip down to home depot or lowes and ask one of the really nice guys to cut you a piece of 1/8" hardboard to the size you require. This will cost you max $7 and will make the whole piece of furniture ten times stronger. The cardboard backing pieces that come with these flat pack furniture are useless and throwing them out and replacing them with hardboard makes the piece more ridgid and sturdy feeling. Just doing these 2 steps will make the pieces of furniture last alot longer and easier to move. I hope this helps you :-)
