review_body:
This is an awesome office chair. Personally, I prefer a high-backed leather chair, 'executive' style, but if you're going for a more modern / sleek look, this is the one you want.

COMFORT / FEEL:
- as with many of the newer generation of office chairs, this has a taut mesh back which allows for breathability while providing uniform back support. This is good -- but I prefer a contoured and padded leather back. The armrests are a soft plastic foam instead of padded fabric -- again, nice, but not my preference. The seat, as well, is a nice fabric with firm padding... you guessed it, I appreciate its quality and comfort but prefer countoured, padded leather.

FUNCTIONALITY:
- pretty simple here. No superfluous bells and whistles like the adjustable lumbar support tabs or various tilt knobs/dials that plague a lot of modern office furniture. You have a tilt control and lift control built into a single lever. Adjustable armrests will be appreciated by users with smaller/large than average builds.

LOOK / STYLE:
- no doubt about it, this is a stylish chair in the contemporary office fashion. Muted gray/black contrast with chrome to give this chair a very modern look while staying clean, and not flashy. The chrome wheelbase really makes this thing pop vs. lower-end office furniture with the dull black plastic ones. The mesh back is in keeping with the contemporary styling. This isn't my personal choice for office furniture styling, but it is very nice.

ASSEMBLY:
- this was easy. Took me around 10 minutes. It's heavy, but simple to assemble.

BOTTOM LINE:
- I tend to prefer the high-backed leather office furniture, but have to admit this is super nice. If you're looking for a classy, contemporary office chair, look no further than this.

review_headline: Pretty, But Platform Fell Apart Within Minutes
review_body:
One positive about the bed, two negatives. A friend just helped me put it together yesterday.

The fabric and design are pretty and stylish. Looks great. The color looks more taupe to me than ivory, but at least it's a light taupe.

Negatives:
The instruction sheet aspired to the depths that seem to be the new standard for assembly-required furniture. The diagram provided was teeny tiny. That might have been OK, but the verbal description of the steps was abysmal, as well as missing two or three steps entirely. There is still one of the missing steps that I haven't figured out how to do, involving two rather important looking brackets. Gulp.

It was late in the evening when assembly was complete, so I immediately made the bed and got in. Not two minutes later, several slats of the hardwood skeleton that makes up the platform simply fell off. I hadn't barely moved. The bed has 30 wooden slats, 15 for the left side (from the left side rail to the center support) and 15 for the right side (right side rail to center). The skeleton is engineered with a series of cheap plastic caps that are supposed to hold the wood in place on each side rail and the center support. The slightest movement and the ends of the wood just slide right out of the caps and onto the floor. OOPS! I'm going to try screwing the caps onto the wood. If that doesn't work, it's going to mean a trip to Home Depot to buy wood slats that are sturdier and fit the full width of the bed. More time and expense == not good.

product_title: basyx by HON VL403 Managerial Mid-Back Chair with Loop Arms for Office or Computer Desk, Brown
review_headline: Attractive - Easy To Build - Nice, Comfortable Chair
review_body:
[[VIDEOID:e64a08649a5b8add251ac8b24b2e9d5c]] How difficult is this chair to put together? Not very difficult, as you can see in the video.

The most important thing to remember is to leave the bolts attaching the seat to the arms loosened until you have the chair back bolted on as well, then tighten them all down at that point. If you tighten the bolts on the seat part first, you will not be able to attach the seat back without loosening them up again.

The one-page instructions are "caveman style" with few words and very simple to follow, but this particular assembly point is not mentioned in them. This was the only thing that slowed my chair builder down in the entire 15-20 minutes it took her to build the chair.

The chair is extremely comfortable (as in, falling asleep in it type of comfortable) and quite attractive and as you can see in the video very stable even when it is put to the most important test of all, the Stability Standard Centrifugal with Shifting and Uneven Mass Test (SSCSUMT) better known as the beloved but stomach churning "spin test."

We are very happy with this chair and look forward to using it for many years. I'm sure many chairs of this type and in this price range have similar quality and choosing one is a matter of taste in style and design, but we can confidently say this particular chair is both easy to build and has solid construction if these are important criteria for your selection.

review_headline: Not a Firm You Should Do Business With
review_body:
Just after ordering this mattress, but before it arrived, it was pointed out to me by a more knowledgeable friend that the "5.5" in its title, which I had assumed was its foam density, was ambiguous in that nowhere was that so formally stated.

I had assumed it, of course, signified its density. What ELSE could it possibly mean? Density is critical to know for performance and comfort. So I endeavored to contact this company. They are elusive and this proved difficult. I could NOT come up with a phone number for them, despite my herculean efforts to do so, which included going beyond what they provided.

The sole means was by e-mail controlled by them. So, I asked, TWICE. THEY never bothered to answer.

My surmise is that the "5.5" in their title is deliberately meant to give the FALSE impression that their foam is more dense than it is, and that they deliberately refused to answer my quite straightforward question because they dishonorably did not wish to reveal the TRUTH of this.

DON'T BUY FROM THIS COMPANY.

review_body: This rug certainly does the job.  It is easy to clean and protects my hardwood floor from sparks from the fireplace.  I wish I had gotten a different color; the charcoal color doesn't blend in with the floor color as well as I would have liked.

product_title: FURINNO 11180GYW/BK Simple Design End/Side Table
review_body:
This product is as good as it gets for a corner table.

Real cheap but high quality.. i would recommend it as its real easy to assemble as well...

product_title: Solar Floating Lamp with Butterfly
review_body: I love these solar floating lights. You just have to be careful to take them out of the water when you are not enjoying them.  If you leave them in water all the time, they rust inside and water gets in and ruins the connections.

product_title: Comfort Products Commodore II Executive Big and Tall Chair - Black
review_headline: Lasted a while, but wasn't up for the task
review_body: I bought this chair for work, so granted, it was used for 8 hours a day, five days a week. The gas cylinder gave out in less than a month, and the connection between the chair and the base was compromised after close to a year. I am a big guy, but within the capacity listed for the chair. The chair was reasonably comfortable, but ultimately I would not recommend any chair using gas cylinder technology for big people. Sorry, this chair didn't do the job.

product_title: Signature Design by Ashley
review_headline: Contemporary Slated Square Living Room End Table
review_body: The product was packed really well and very easy to assemble.  The tiles were packed in each own box.  Nice table.

product_title: Winsome Wood 4-Shelf Narrow Shelving Unit
review_body:
I wanted something to display a collection of YinXi clay tea pots/cups in the corner of my diningroom. This worked out pretty well. Even with the side crossbars for added support, visibility was adequate and there is no fuss in cleaning/dusting vs. a glass panel cabinat. It is reasonably stable, thank goodness, since I am still trying to kept the kittens from using it as climbing tower. Hopefully that novelty wears out soon with them.

Assembly was only slightly troublesome, as the instructions weren't fully clear in a few small steps. But all worked out in the end.

product_title: Solid Wood Espresso Twin Bed with Drawers
review_headline: Perfect first bed for our 3 year old
review_body: Great color, size, easy to assemble (took two of us about an hour), nice drawers for storage. Only downside to the drawers is that they don't attach to the bed frame, so they sit and roll on the floor. We're worried about our bamboo floors getting scratched, so we will be putting down some carpet matting underneath. The drawers also don't go all the way to the other side of the bed, but that isn't a problem for us.

product_title: Malibu Coffee Table
review_body:
We were thrilled with the coffee table after searching months for the necessary dimensions needed for our sitting room. Product is well made, easy to assemble, packaged very well, glass inserts are good quality and nice colour of tint. The table has casters that are hidden and make it easy to simply roll around when hoovering the rugs. We have some heavy books on the bottom shelf and there is no bowing or problems with rolling the table.

It's a five star in all categories!

product_title: Sleep Innovations 10-Inch SureTemp Memory Foam Mattress With 20-Year Warranty
review_headline: A little firmer than I was expecting
review_body:
I was a bit skeptical about buying a mattress on line and spent quite some time (months) researching, reading reviews and visiting brick and mortar stores to lay on memory foam mattresses. I was eventually won over by the price and the overall satisfaction of the majority of people who purchased this mattress. Well, it's a bit more firm than I expected, but I've gotten pretty use to it. I do wish it was a bit softer though. I don't hate it, but I honesly can't say I love it.

Just A Quick Update: I'm growing to appreciate the firmness of this mattress more as time goes on. I can't wait to get into bed! :) I had guests over for Mother's Day and one of them slept in my bed. She loved it!

product_title: Spine Book Tower
review_body:
This is one of my favorite purchases on Amazon, and I have bought hundreds of things. The tower and it's plate-like shelves were packaged well for shipping. If I remember correctly, each level was placed in it's own piece of plastic to prevent rubbing up against others and scraping the metal. It was really easy to put together, but you need to start from the bottom. Also, I didn't realize until I opened up the box that the shelves are all the same size. For some reason, I thought they decreased in size as they got closer to the top, but that's not the case. The shelves are quite sturdy, I have a number of textbooks and journals on them right now, and they haven't moved. It's actually taller than I imagined it would be, which was a pleasant surprise.

I would absolutely recommend this tower to anyone! It's great for storing books/magazines if you don't have a lot of space. I love it!!

product_title: Reader's Night Stand
review_body: I initially saw this product in an airline magazine and debated about ordering it. As others have commented, the assembly was a bit tedious. But once it is assembled, it functions well. I've had mine now for two years, and it's held up beautifully. Also, the one I have is made from real wood--not particle board--and is relatively light to lift. It has provided a great solution for the piles of books and magazines that had tended to accumulate at bedside. Also, it is just the right size to hold a lamp, alarm clock, and a few miscellaneous items that I like to keep next to the bed.

product_title: Boss Leather Plus Posture Task Chair
review_body: quality is not bad for the price. Very easy to set up. You can choose to buy the chair without the arms.

product_title: South Shore Libra Collection 3-Drawer Chest
review_body: Its short, but it (seemed) easy to put together. (My boyfriend put it together while I watched). So far I have had no issues with the dresser, and for the price, I got what I needed. Its great for kids or inimate items for adults. I would not recommend this for jeans, or larger chlothing though.

product_title: LUCID 16 Inch Plush Gel Memory Foam and Latex Mattress - Four-Layer - Infused with Bamboo Charcoal - Natural Latex and CertiPUR-US Certified Foam - 25-Year Warranty
review_body: My previous bed was a memory foam mattress from Costco. I think it was 10 inches thick. It gave an ok night's sleep, but I would wake up sore and want to get out of bed immediately. As I did last time I toyed with spending several thousands on tempurpedic but decided to give this one a try based on the strong reviews. I couldn't be happier. This mattress reminds me of a luxury hotel I stayed at once where the bed was massive and extremely comfortable. I instantly felt the same with this mattress, a different experience entirely to my previous bed. I think the extra thickness is important, I'm glad I didn't go for the thinner Lucid mattress. It did take about 5 days for the odor to dissipate. I enthusiastically recommend this mattress.

product_title: Monty Python And The Holy Grail Poster Poster Print, 36x24
review_headline: Camelot is such a silly place.
review_body: What's not to love? I got this for my son and was happy to see it taking up a prominent place on the wall in his college apartment.

product_title: Dorel Home Products X-Loft Bunk Bed
review_body: I was limited on space in my daughters room so i decided to change her whole room around. This was one of the best purchases I have ever made. The bed is very sturdy and easy to assemble. It took me less then 1 hour to put together. Of course have all tools ready to speed up the assembly. I will recommend this loft bed to all my friends !!!

product_title: ACME 04625 Solid Hardwood Dining Bench, Country Cherry Finish
review_body: The bench looked great initially. It was very sturdy. However only after a few weeks the buttons became loose and the material on the buttons came off. We are going to have to fix . Very disappointed.

product_title: Safco Products 1926CY Muv 35"W Adjustable Height Computer Workstation with Keyboard Shelf
review_headline: Torn between 2 and 3.  The height adjustment is just the shelf, not the top
review_body: So, I'm disappointed in that aspect.  I wanted the top to be adjustable height.  It's not.  I don't care about the drawer.  It seems an unnecessary feature and also a fair bit of work if you actually do want to adjust.  Otherwise, I like Safeco Products and I'll buy them again, but this one isn't my favorite.

product_title: Signature Sleep 6-Inch Memory Foam Mattress, Twin
review_body: Bought this for my new trundle bed when grandchildren spend the night.  But I had to try it out myself too. For a 6" mattress I was very pleasantly surprised at how extremely comfortable it is. Definitely recommend this mattress.  I'm 6ft tall & weigh 196 and have had back surgery, so if it's comfy for me, I know my grandchildren will sleep well too! That "new mattress smell" was completely gone in two days.

product_title: 10 Inch Thick, 4 Pound Density Visco Elastic Memory Foam Mattress Bed With Gel Made in the USA
review_body:
This mattress is great!
it feels really comfortable, especially when i put a liner on it. At first i wasnt used to it b/c i had a spring mattress all my life but now i have no problems with it

product_title: Walker Edison Soreno 3-Piece Corner Desk
review_body: Once you actually figure out how to put it together, it's a very nice, sturdy desk. But the instructions that come with this thing are in no way close to what you actually should do to assemble this desk correctly. For example, please done put the cups to suction the glass to the desk facing downward. Unless you intend to mount the glass upside down!

product_title: Walker Edison 42-Inch 4-in-1 TV Stand with Removable Mount, Cherry/Black
review_headline: Exquisite Stand - Exactly what I wanted, used for several years now and still love it
review_body:
I don't place \\"gushing\\" reviews often, but this is going to be a very positive review.

This is a great stand - met all my expectations, and exceeded them. I got it on sale for around $170 here at Amazon, and got $3.99 one-day prime shipping as well. Was a steal (though the FedEx guy didn't like me too much that day, LOL).

I was a \\"helper\\" putting it together (building things is not my forte) but it was pretty straight-forward. It was very well packed, not a nick or anything anywhere. Very nice quality feel - did not feel like the fiber-board imitators I have seen do this design since. (You can get a version at Wally World now that costs about as much as this one and is much more cheaply made.) Took about two hours, and although the person who did the majority of the putting together was handy they had never done a TV stand/mount for an HDTV it was a very modest challenge.

I can't over state how \\"quality\\" this item feels - it's not terribly heavy, but feels extremely solid. I have no quams about stacking up equipment on both shelves. The dark wood is great for a more traditional look, but the black glass gives it a very modern accent. The two together marry into what is one of the most attractive pieces of furniture I own (equal only to a \\"map library\\" coffee table I have).

The movement possibilities of the mount were enough for me; if it had a few more inches of swing I wouldn't mind, but I'm in a small space so it spans the viewing areas well enough. I like that I can slant it to one side or the other without any modifications, and if I want a move it up and down or change the angle the little levers are easy to access and re-tighten after.

Cable management was also a breeze - I really look forward to adding or changing systems or components now instead of dreading it because it's so easy to hook up one thing or unhook another. Wondering how I was going to get it in the mess of cables was always stressful - so easy now. The back \\"grate\\" that holds the TV up is a grate - perforated. So I could see the cables behind it. Two sheets of black construction paper and a minute later it was solid black. I just slipped it behind and you cannot see a thing. The grates are perfect size for attaching or hanging things as well (like a center speaker, like I did).

Cannot recommend this enough - great product, been living with it for several years now and not only do I still enjoy looking at it, I have gotten more compliments than I can count. A+!

product_title: Atlantic Gaming Desk - Not Machine Specific
review_body: This is one of the best desks i have bought i was worried about how sturdy it would be but its not a problem very solid desk

product_title: Stackable Wall Cabinet
review_body: I Loved it

product_title: Powell Antique Black Cheval Jewelry Wardrobe
review_body: my wife loves this piece.  it holds all her jewelry on the inside and the mirror is adjustable to a couple different angles.  the assembly took a half hour.  very nice.

product_title: Best Selling  Alfred Brown Leather Storage Ottoman
review_body:
I looked at a lot of ottomans online before purchasing this one. I really didn't want to pay as much as this ottoman costs (about $300). However, I'm very happy with my purchase. The pattern on the top of the ottoman matches perfectly the pattern on the recently purchased sofas I placed the ottoman between. It looks expensive. It's a large piece, able to hold 4 bed pillows and a large quilt. The top is two pieces and opens from the middle.

I would recommend before purchasing any ottoman that you get your tape measure out and measure the spot in your home where you intend to put the new ottoman. I noticed ottomans come in a wide variety of sizes and I imagine it can be costly if you have to send one back.

My one negative is that this ottoman was not made in the USA.

product_title: Chapman Dining Table in Caramel
review_headline: defective design, bad material, and rude
review_body: I bought the Golden Tadco Chapman 8-pc. Counter-Height Dining Set, which has the same design, just taller, from Costco, for over $1000. It has been a nightmare. Problems with original package:  1. table top    - one bottom/side corner was crushed, splitting the paint over it    - one side of the leaf is damaged, because the hinges weren't installed correctly  2. bench side strecher    one of them is missing a pre-drilled hole    [..]    Problems with the second shipment:    1. product_title: Edvard Munch Four Girls on a Bridge Art Print Poster
review_body: I love it, framed it is perfect in my living room --anyone who is familiar with munch, this is one of his best

product_title: Spa Sensations 6'' Tight Top Spring Mattress -Twin
review_body: I was upgraded to a 8\\" bed due to 6\\" bed being out of stock. The way it was packaged made me skeptical but now that the mattress is out of the box and in use, I'm quite please with my purchase! I would recommend this mattress to others.

product_title: Coaster Home Furnishings 9 Piece Counter Height Storage Dining Table w/Lazy Susan & Chair Set
review_body: This table is exactly as described and is perfect for our family of 8 we love being able to fit all of us at one table!  We love it!!!

product_title: rEvolve Swiveling Portable Chair with iPod Speakers, Black
review_body: Much sturdier and well built than most camping chairs, it should last a long time and get well used! Even the bag is a solid construction.

product_title: Carolina Cottage Refectory Table, Natural
review_body: This is a great table and I love the fact that it opens up to seat 6 people.  The top finish is delicate and can scratch easily, so be careful.  I always keep placemats on the table and use a tablecloth when serving dinner on it.  I would recommend this product.  Well made and heavy.  One negative:  would have like to see a thicker polyurethane finish on the top to protect it better.  Other than that, it's great.  It is a very light colored wood....... the color or pine (unfinished).  It is not oak colored.

product_title: Handy Living Transitional Rounded Arm Chair With Ottoman
review_body:
A nice piece of furniture for less than $400.

Please be aware that the colors are not exactly as they appear in the photos displayed by Amazon. The blue is indeed a slate blue, as it says in the description of the item. The photos make it seem darker than it is. The light color is not white, it's cream. We're happy with the colors but they sure look different in those photos.

Also be aware that the design looks very crisp in the photos but the edges of the pattern are a bit faded. I've included a photo to give you a better idea.

It's a nice size: the seat is about 2 feet off the ground and the back extends another foot and a half.

The chair came about a week after we ordered it and it was easy to assemble; just needed to screw the feet on the chair and ottoman. It's not the comfiest chair ever created but I find that new furniture usually needs a little wearing in before it reaches peak coziness. The overall construction of the chair is good as far as I can tell. If you're looking for expert craftsmanship, you probably wouldn't be shopping for chairs online anyway...

I looked around and couldn't find a better deal for a chair + ottoman.

product_title: Niall - One Direction Lifesize Cardboard Standup
review_body: Color and proportion great. My 10 year old loves it - Niall looks just the same as he does on you tube.

product_title: Celebrations Swiss Fir Prelit Tree
review_body: Tree looks smaller in person.  Cute for a very small area.  Had to put mine on top of a table so it could be noticed.  On the positive side, it is full and a nice color.  Not meant as your primary tree unless you have very little extra space.

product_title: Fritz Willis Vintage Pin Up Girl Art Poster Retro Print
review_body: Another of my favorites... along with Hildebrandt.  I framed and sealed this one for protection.  The original appears done on canvas and what I would give to have it....alas, not that well heeled financially.  Thus I settle for a well done reprint, and very happy with it.  A man's work shop needs some enlightenment to help with those stalled creative thought processes that occur for no apparent reason when trying to figure out obscure angles and the best method of joining wood..... recommended to all who enjoy the works of Master Willis.

product_title: Kitchen Trolley Ceramic Tile Top Cart
review_body: I was pretty sure of what I was getting before I placed my order so was not surprized when it arived.It works perfect for me. I put my phone,I pad and any outer chagers in the drawer and the trolly sets right under a plug in so they are always close at hand.This is not a real sturdy little cart but perfect for my needs. I have it at the end of the counter in my kitchen and it matches my iland perfectly.If you don't plan on moving it around all the time loaded with a lot of heavy items, it will hold quite a bit.

product_title: Stand Up Desk Frame with 29x57 Surface – Adjustable Standing Desk with 5 year limited warranty (Silver Frame/Black Top)
review_body: Pure awesomeness. Best desk ever. Don't even think about it, just buy it. It is truly worth every single penny.

product_title: Hand Crafted Queen Bed
review_body: The bed looks great.  It took a while to put it together and then I finely sanded then sealed the wood.  It took about 5 hours total, working by myself for most of the assembly.  The wood looked good and I simply adjusted the pieces with larger veins so that they were not visible (my preference).  I was a little worried about the bed sagging in the middle (some other websites recomend a center stabilizer) so I went to my local hardware store and purchased a leg, which I cut to the proper height and screwed into the center support, in the middle.  I think it is worth doing this to avoid issues later on.  Also, with a full size boxspring, the bed is really high. I am ordering a low profile box spring to get the bed back to a normal height.  All in all, Great bed - especially for the price!

product_title: Padded Butterfly Chair
review_body:
Just what I was looking for as a casual chair for the grandchildren.
It's very comfortable and looks good in the media area.

product_title: Michael Jackson Wall Sticker Decals Art Mural T420
review_body: This wall art is beautiful! it really captures Michael Jackson!  This was one of my daughter's favorite xmas presents!  Fantastic!

product_title: Adult TriFold Hide 'A Mat Poly Cotton
review_body: Do not buy this if the intended use is to sleep on it.  IT IS HARD AS A ROCK. I envisioned some kind of mattress foam when I was purchasing this, but this thing is made of something that feels like styrofoam.  I would not sleep on it, nor would I ever make my guests sleep on something like this.

product_title: Mason Cocktail Table with Casters Cherry
review_headline: Cherry Wood Table is beautiful for the money
review_body: The color is beautiful...dark rich cherry color.  Darker than picture.  I like that.  After we put it together, one of the drawers front panels weren't connected to the side.  You couldn't see it when the drawer was closed.  Could've fixed it with wood glue.  I sent email to seller and they said at first they don't have parts but sent not one, but two extra drawers.  Very satisfied with the table.

product_title: HON 1870 Series Bookcase
review_headline: Well built, easy to assemble, strong, American Made
review_body:
Amazingly, order arrived the very next day (Washington, DC area). Package weighed 109 lbs and is long (about 7.5ft), so I unpacked it in the hall and took the parts down to the basement for assembly. No scratches or damage. Assembly instructions not immediately visible (they are inside the folded panel that will unfold to be the back of the bookcase-a note taped to something else where it would tell you this would be nice), I downloaded a set of instructions off the Internet. Assembly took about 45 mins including unpacking. All holes accurately and completely drilled. Extra parts were included, but nothing tricky to the assembly. You need a Phillips head screwdriver and a hammer. Using a portable drill with a Phillips bit to screw in the anchor pins a great help for speed and saving your wrist a lot of work that I highly recommend.

Good basic unit. Shelves fully loaded with heavy (lots of pictures) books show about 1/4\\" of sag in the middle once loaded for a few days.

product_title: Folding Shopping Cart - VersaCart Transit Utility Cart - Transport Up to 120 Pounds (Water-Resistant Heavy Duty Canvas)
review_body: I bought on of these for my self about three years ago and have always loved it.  I noticed my mom was having a hard time taking groceries from her car to her house.  She is so happy with the Versa Cart - another smart purchase.

product_title: Furinno 10006EX/BR Multipurpose Storage Cabinet with 3 Bin Drawers, Espresso Finish
review_body: product says three draws, but draws are made of canvas. This would have been OK if they were honest about it. I hate deceptive descriptions.

product_title: 12" Gold Plated Metal Ornament Display Tree
review_body: I ordered this product to display jewellery items. Unfortunately it arrived scratched so it was unusable and I had to return. The paintwork is very delicate/thin so it should be packaged properly. The product looks exactly as it is pictured and is very pretty otherwise.

product_title: Bronze Finish Half Circle Back Adjustable Metal Swivel Counter Height Bar Stools (Set of 2)
review_body: After waiting for them to come it was worth it. Looks nice. Very sturdy and comfortable. I would recommend to anyone. Them seem like they will last for a long time.

product_title: South Shore Annexe Collection Work Table and Storage Unit Combo, Mocha
review_body:
If this desk didn't arrive so damaged, I think I would really like it. I would have to put the blame on both the shipping company AND on south shore because it definitely wasn't packaged well enough to handle shipping, but it also arrived with a huge taped up tear in the box, as well as other little tears that didn't even have an attempt made to tape up. The laminate on top of the particle board is chipped off in a lot of areas (more than I care to count), and has a crack on the underside of the desktop.

The desk is fairly easy to put together (assuming all the pre-drilled holes have been completely drilled out). One of mine was not, so I had to employ my chiseling skills which are unfortunately not up to par, but I was able to chisel enough so the desk could still be put together, even if the bolt sticks out more than it should. There were also two holes that were drilled completely through the desk top, when they were clearly just supposed to be drilled halfway (as the rest of the holes that held the same hardware were). Speaking of that hardware, I think the holes drilled for it were a bit too wide in some areas, which leads me to believe they may cause the desk to come apart at some point. However, right now the desk feels sturdy, but I have it on carpeted flooring, so it may seem different on a hard floor.

I also think the desk is a little bit longer than the dimensions state (bookshelf to legs dimension).

Again, if the desk wasn't so damaged, I would really like it. However, once it arrives in that state and you pull all the pieces out and see all the damage, it would be nearly impossible to package it all back up to return (and I can't imagine what the shipping would be; this desk is beastly heavy). I read on the review of the black desk like this that a customer used permanent marker to fill in where the laminate had chipped off, I don't think that's really plausible here, but might look better than just exposed particle board.

product_title: OZOFire Bio-Ethanol Liquid Fuel for Fireplaces 12pk of 1 quart bottles
review_body: Good product, does not smell like most. It is a bit expensive for what you get.  It does not last as long, and burns quickly. A bottle maybe last for 2.5 hours, some we had in the past burned for 3-4 hours at least.

product_title: Skyline Furniture Walnut Hill Storage Bench in Gerber Fabric
review_body: I am very pleased with the item overall. The color is exactly as shown and the item appears to be very sturdy and robust. Also, the lid has a soft close so I believe it wouldn't smash little fingers if it closed accidently on a child's hand. The only nit I have is that the covering on the underside of the bench top is stapled on and all the staples are visible. I may cover the edge with some nice binding tape to make it look more finished. It took me months of looking before I finally found a bench in bright yellow that was narrow enough for my room. I'm using it as an ottoman/coffee table. I intend to Scothgard it before I use it.

product_title: Sauder Sewing Craft Cart, Cinnamon Cherry Finish
review_body: The table is the perfect size!  It's an excellent, easy to put together, easy to work with table.  When I open the box I noticed one piece was damaged as well as one of the plastic bins. I called the customer service number and the replacement parts were shipped out that day.  Would recommend to anyone!

product_title: Sleep Innovations 10-Inch SureTemp Memory Foam Mattress With 20-Year Warranty
review_headline: Great Value for a memory Foam Mattress under $500
review_body:
First thing I want to mention is I own a 10'' King Tempurpedic mattress which I paid $2,400 for in 2009.

The reason I purchased the full size sleep innovations memory foam mattress and not another Tempurpedic was price. This full size memory foam mattress went into my spare bedroom that could only accommodate a full.

Comfort compared to the Tempurpedic
My wife and I were both very curious how this product stacked up agaist our $2,400 bed so we each spent a couple nights on this mattress over and we were both pleasantly surprised with the comfort level. I like to sleep on my side and my wife likes to sleep on her back. This bed was actually firmer than my Tempurpedic (I bought the firmest model at the time). I still feel like the Tempurpeic forms more to my body than the Sleep Innovation bed and I sleep a little better. The major difference between both of these products is the build quality the Tempurpedic materials are of a higher standard and they feel better to the touch. The other difference is price and for the price this bed is amazing. I cant give this product a five star because of build quality but as of right now this mattress is a great buy good bang for your buck. Like I said earlier this is in my guess bedroom and I do not sleep on it I just slept on it a couple nights to compare it to my Tempurpedic and I was impressed and so was my wife.

product_title: Sleep Innovations Shiloh Memory Foam Mattress
review_body:
So prior to purchasing this mattress, we had a pillow top. The pillow tops are terrific at first, but after a few years my husband and I experienced terrible back pain due to the indentations that are left in the pillow top. So after hearing terrific things from friends and family who had gone to memory foam mattresses, we wanted to make the switch. I was set to order from Tempurpedic but my husband just could not make the financial commitment and not have a guarantee that we would sleep better. He searched on Amazon and found this mattress which had very good reviews. For 1/3 of the cost of the Tempurpedic, we decided to try it.

I was also in awe that we were ordering a mattress from Amazon! I mean how would this go. But the mattress comes in an air tight package. The package weighs a lot (about 100 lbs) but you get it to your bedroom before opening. My husband put the mattress on the bed and then undid the packaging and it slowly inflated to its normal size. I gave it at least one night to air out but my husband slept on it the first night and did not notice any odors or anything. We both notice that our sleep has much improved. I tell everyone about our new mattress that we purchased on Amazon at this amazing price.

product_title: 3 pcs Espresso Finish Wood Coffee & 2 Occasional End Tables Set
review_body: excellent three piece table set, i love it, goes well with my living room funiture. i would recommend this to my family and friends.

product_title: LUCID 14 Inch Plush Memory Foam Mattress - Ventilated Gel Memory Foam + Bamboo Charcoal Infused Memory Foam - CertiPUR-US Certified - 25-Year Warranty
review_headline: Best mattress for a little girl
review_body:
My wife and I wanted to get our 7 year old daughter a new memory foam mattress. She kept complaining about how hard her spring mattress was and would always get in bed with my wife and I. product_title: RTA Home and Office LT-020 Clear Glass and Aluminum Laptop Stand with Casters
review_body:
First, thanks to the many tips here for assembly from other reviewers.

Item received quickly (about a week early in fact). In only took about 10 minutes to assemble.

1. Snap the wheels in the base (takes a little force, but not too bad)
2. Attach the Lever to the glass top (4 screws and washers with included Allen Wrench)
3. Stick the pole in the base and top.

DONE!

I don't know if they tweaked the design, but I found no small parts that needed a magnifying glass (from another reviewer).

I did not need a mallet or block of wood (another reviewer)

One idea I had after reading another review was to install the lever pointing out the back of the unit instead off to the side where your knee might bump it.

I have plenty of room for a 12 inch laptop (tablet), Blue Tooth Keyboard, Mouse Pad and wireless mouse with room left over for a cup of coffee. If you had a full size laptop, and used the built in track pad and keyboard you should also be fine. There won't be room for extra papers, etc, but I'm sure you could mount some sort of paper holder on the side with a clamp if you wanted to.

It is very sturdy. I think it will last a long time.

My only nit (very minor) is that although the overall unit is nice heavy chrome, there is a decorative finishing ring that covers where the legs meet the pole that is chrome colored plastic. I'm sure it will be the first and probably only thing on it that breaks. For the price, a metal ring would have been nicer.

Overall, I give this unit a 5. I would have done 4.9 if there was such a thing for the ring.

review_body: I operate a cigar blog so I keep larger quantities of cigars on hand than the average smoker. I own 5 other humidors but this is one of two that are this large. The price tag got my attention so I finally bit the bullet and ordered one. It is an attractive humidor but if you are a cigar nut like I am, you know that having an attractive box means nothing if it doesn't hold humidity. I seasoned this one for 24 hours before checking to see if the humidity inside had stabilized. I used the "salt test" method to calibrate the hygrometer ( it can be done but is not technically adjustable.) To be sure it was calibrated and the box was at my desired 70% RH, I placed a known accurate digital hygrometer inside for a few days. It doesn't seal as tightly as some of my more expensive boxes but it does hold humidity, and that's what's important. I have a child in the house so I was actually glad the glass was plexiglass instead of actual glass. The kicker for me was that the lower section has shelves instead of trays. This is great for storing or aging boxes of cigars you don't plan to open for awhile. I plan to order some humidity beads but went with a 300 cigar crystal gel humidifier for now. So far everything is great and the craftsmanship is excellent for the price. I am satisfied and would recommend this to anyone with a growing cigar hobby that is in need of more space, or as an aging humidor for unopened boxes of cigars.

review_body:

The chairs are really sturdy even more than what they are rated I would think and all of mine were easy to assemble. I would use ratcheting tools though because the wrench provided takes a little extra work but then again they aren't selling wrenchs. Even though I like the looks of a rush bottom better, I choose the solid thinking it would be easier to keep clean around food and children. Also, curious children like to pick at rush bottoms and stick crayons through them. Now as far as quality of the finish. I noticed most of the parts were sanded properly but a few were not completely. In other words a rush job. I am not familiar with the type of wood but if you must match oak then you should buy oak. The reason I think some chairs are not the same is because of the sanding. Parts of the chair could be rough thus being more pourous and taking in more finish leading to a darker look. Other parts of the chair which are sanded super smooth will be lighter. If you received the oddball chair I would send for a replacement and I am betting you will be satisfed.
I think you will also find they are comfortable and roomy to sit on. The nuts and bolts of the chair is the plus. No glue joints to fail.
I gave this four stars because it is as good as you get for this type furniture and do not expect any more. If I wanted a $5000 set then I would have made different choices.

product_title: HON VL610 Series Swivel Task Chair for Office or Computer Desk
review_body:
But for the aggravating seat tilt this review would have been 3 or 4 stars. Not 5 because in spite of looking good, the quality is not there.

Pro's: Good looks, fit and finish look good; the pneumatic cartridge seems to have a little more range than other chairs. Extremely easy to assemble: It takes less than 5 minutes to put it together.

Con's: Well, it is tilted! The cartridge enters in an angle to the frame at the bottom of the seat! So the result is that one side is about 3/4 of an inch higher/lower than the other! You seat and most of the times feel like you are falling to the sides, or leaning forward too much (or backwards, the only position I can live with it). If I seat and push myself around (I mean pivoting in a circle) my body tilts up, down, right, left. 3/4 of an inch is very noticeably.

No mistakes were made during the easy assembly, yet, I took it apart and back together again to make sure it was not me. It was not me.

I am a watchmaker, and need a simple, small, quality chair, regardless cost. It's been proven very difficult to find something with these characteristics. Thought this would be the one. Unfortunately it wasn't. Will have it replaced for another one after coming back from vacation, and update this review, for good or bad.

product_title: Simpli Home Warm Shaker TV Media Stand for TVs up to 52"
review_body:
First off, I can't give a review on this other than the shipping process and how Amazon has worked to resolve the issue.

So here is a history of the what's happened to me so far...

I order the product on Deceber 30th and get an estimated shipping date of January 2nd, which comes and goes so I check online and the ship date now shows Janary 4th. Ok, it's right before the weekend so figure I'll take Thursday night and put all my movies and cds from my old entertainment center into boxes, bring up an old rickety bookshelf to put the TV on, have the dvd player and PS3 for my son put on plastic milk crates to keep it the air flowing over them, etc. and I'm really looking forward to finally getting something nice for my TV.

Weeeelll, that's not exactly what happens. When I get home on Friday, the piece hasn't arrived yet, and I notice that it says \\"there was an exception to the shipping process\\" in the tracking code, and my package hasn't even left the depot yet in South Carolina (I live in Wisconsin). Well, color me mad, but I'm like problems happen, Amazon has been good to me, yada yada. Well, it's late, but on the move to Illinois so things are good and I should be getting it soon.

Well, the weekend arrives...nothing... I check the package and it's in Illinois, and the ship date has been changed to the 7th (I had signed up for text alerts, by the way, and didn't that, either) so ok. Monday arrives, no package. Ship date is now the 8th and no text or email alerts. Tuesday arrives, no package and tracking number shows package is still in Illinois...huh? Ok, well I guess they feel it will still get here on time...uh, no...Tuesday after work, nothing. Wednesday, nothing. Thursday I get an email (and a text, yay!) stating my package was delivered to the wrong warehouse in Illinois and is already BACK in South Carolina! At this point I'm like what the heck, but I really want this piece so I'm sure they'll get it figured out.

By the end of the day on the 10th, I get a message that package is already being loaded for departure and on its way back to Wisconsin..on the 12th it's in Tennessee, on the 14th it's in Hodgkins Illinois, on the 15th it's in Madison, WI and about 15 minutes from my house. Woohoo! ... and then I get an email (and text) that the package may have been damaged in delivery and to call Amazon if there are any problems. Uh, ok. So you're going to deliver it anyway? Alright, but if it's damaged, you better not charge me to send it back! I guess after the text and email, someone realized it might not be a good idea to deliver a damaged product ,and I get an email and text showing the package is being sent back to shipper.

So at this point, I'm like what do I do now? Does Amazon refund me? Do they ship out another product? I mean, what am I supposed to do, here? Well, they did text me a number to call when my package arrived, so I call it. Any idea what happened next? I get an automated attendant saying that this is no longer the customer service line for Amazon and that I have to go to a web site address, put in my phone number, and then someone will call me back \\"immediately\\". Ah, well guess what, I'm at work. I don't have a direct line and I can't get a signal on my cell.

So...I Google the customer support line, call it, and finally get through to someone who says I have to wait until the package comes back to the warehouse, wait a few days to have my money returned to the account, then can do a search for the new product and re-order if I wish. What? Why on earth would you make someone go through all that. You already have my money. Just ask me if it's ok to ship another one. They can see it was never delivered so it's not like I could pull anything on them, and then I don't have to go through all this.

To make a long story short, they won't do that and to my dismay, the price of the item has gone up in price, so if I want to re-order I'm going to have to pay more to get the same item four to six weeks AFTER it was supposed to be delivered.

Amazon, in every other purchase I've had from you, you've been great....in this instance...you've sucked and sucked badly.r I'm going to have to pay more to get the same item four to six weeks AFTER it was supposed to be delivered.

product_title: DynastyMattress New Cool Breeze 12-Inch Gel Memory Foam Mattress
review_headline: Best nights sleep I've ever had!
review_body: My husband & I were looking for a new mattress because our had to go. We did some research online about the types of mattresses out there before we went to look in the local furniture stores. We decided we wanted a gel memory foam mattress because of lack of motion transfer. So we head out to find a mattress and barely any of our local stores had a gel memory foam mattress. We did lay on one and liked it, but didn't want to purchase the ONLY gel mattress available. We were hesitant when we started looking online to buy a mattress. We really wanted to make sure it was what we wanted and try it out before buying. We found this mattress and because of the great price and the return policy decided to give it a shot. I am extremely glad we did! We both slept so well on this mattress from the first night! I would recommend not using it for a day or two after you get it set up. There was a chemical smell and it did take a day or two for the mattress to fully expand. The chemical smell is gone. Heck my husband didn't even notice it. I only noticed it the first night or two we slept on it. I usually don't write reviews but I just had to. If you are looking into a gel memory foam mattress and are worried about purchasing before trying it out, I would recommend giving this one a shot.

product_title: Sleep Innovations Shiloh Memory Foam Mattress
review_body: I have a very skeptical husband. When I told him I wanted to get this mattress he made sure I knew that if it didn't work out I was going to eat crow. We've had this mattress for almost 2 months and it has been great. It gets the skeptical husband approval. I actually sleep for hours at a time without waking up, which is something I haven't done in years! This doesn't seem to get that hot. I'm warm blooded and it usually doesn't take much for me to over heat. We've had some hot days since we got it and I haven't been bothered by it at all. It's a great start to break into memory foam to make sure we like it if we ever intend on getting another one (more expensive version). It is on the firm side, but my husband and I prefer it that way. I purchased the 10 inch for my kids and it seems like theirs is softer. The temperature of your room will also determine how firm or soft the bed is. It may seem firm at first but once it warms up it gets softer. I now am on the hunt for the perfect pillow. The pillow that worked with the other mattress does not work with this one. All in all it was worth the hassle with the husband!!

product_title: SPACE Seating AirGrid Latte Back and Padded Padded Mesh Seat
review_body:
The positive: This chair seems to be first class, heavy duty, quality made. Assembly was pretty easy, and not time consuming.
The negative. As other reviewers have noted, this chair is not generic for most people, it is made for BIG(like me) people. If you are under six feet tall, buy a different chair. The arm rests are not flat, they are concave. This means if you are sitting at the computer, working, your armrest has to be pointed directly at the mouse, or you're arm will move out of the groove, then start rubbing against the edge, and start hurting. I fixed this by wrapping a very thick foam pad around the right armrest, which worked, but looks incredibly tacky. The seat is very hard. To solve this problem, I placed a two inch piece of foam on the seat. That didn't work because now, even fully extended, the armrests are too low, and the back support is in the wrong place. Using a one inch piece of foam was a good compromise, as now the back support and armrests work, and my butt is only slightly sore.
Two month update: After sitting in this chair for close to two hundred hours, my rear no longer aches, but the armrest still causes my arm to hurt, even with the pad. I guess I'm going to have to make a custom made armrest cover. I also notice, from time to time, the seat drops slightly after sitting in it for several hours. Not a lot, but that worries me that the hydraulics are not top drawer.
Final notes: If I had to do it over again, I would sit in any chair I was going to buy first, then go online and read any reviews I could find, and if I was still impressed, buy it where ever it was the cheapest.

product_title: Etna Sofa Side Table (Black)
review_body: The deliver to address label was incomplete, so this item made it to its' destination, but with no person's name on it, it sat for awhile unclaimed. Instructions didn't help me, I put the table together essentially just using my handywoman skills and a power screwdriver. On the leaf design part of the table, one of the leaves was really messed up, had a chunk of metal on top of it.  I couldn't leave it on there because it was very unattractive, but when I tried to remove it, it took part of the leaf design off and left unfinished metal in that area. I thought the top was going to be actual wood, or laminate which would have been fine.  The top is actually a paper material with a wood grain appearance wrapped around a piece of mdf (I think that is the correct material name).  And it is not done well.  On one side of the top, you can see the edge of the paper.  So that means I always have to use a coaster and I won't be able to clean the top with a wood cleaner or 409 because the top would not do well with any type of moisture.  Maybe a Lysol wipe every once in awhile won't ruin it.  I would have been at fault if I had expected much more for so little money.

product_title: LUCID 14 Inch Plush Memory Foam Mattress - Ventilated Gel Memory Foam + Bamboo Charcoal Infused Memory Foam - CertiPUR-US Certified - 25-Year Warranty
review_body:
I've wanted a memory foam bed for a long time now, so when I saw this for 80% off I couldn't resist. Turns out that's not a special sale, and it's always 80% off. I can't find anywhere offline or online that it sells for its list price.

The bed is as soft as any memory foam on the market because of the plush top layer. You'll sink into this thing like a marshmallow. I was looking for something plush, so that's a plus for me, but if you like firmer beds beware. Unfortunately, you sink so far that you may need to buy a thinner pillow just to keep your neck from being angled up. The softness also becomes firm rather abruptly, though I'm not sure if that's happening at the \\"comfort layer\\" or the \\"support layer\\".

It does have a slight smell, but it's more pleasant, mild, and citrus-like than other new memory foams I've been near. I let it air out and expand for two days next to an open door (which it recommends), and it still had a hint of the smell when I started sleeping on it (and still does). The smell isn't awful by any means, but you might want to leave a window open in your bedroom if you have a sensitive nose.

One thing I wish was different is the thickness. The high-density base is thicker than I could ever need, since I'm only 135 pounds. If you're heavier, you'd probably get the benefit of its support, but not me. It just seems wasteful to have this 14 inch thick mattress when I'm only using about 7 or 8 inches of it.

So yeah, it's a good buy if you want something softer and you want to stay on the cheap side. If you're really splurging though, get a Serta. They make the best memory foams around, period.

product_title: HON Lota Mid-Back Work Chair with Mesh Back for Office or Computer Desk
review_headline: Nice but with some annoying flaws
review_body:
Assembly: First order of business is to pop the casters into the base. Sounds simple, but I had to fight to get them all in. Some slid in easily but others were a war and would not go in to the same depth as the others. First indication of less than precision construction. Then the arms go on. They are well labeled which is R and L so no chance I'd gotten them on wrong. The R arm went on easily but the L arm again was a battle. The holes in the arm, seat base and plastic seat base cover all seemed out of alignment so it was nearly impossible to get the bolt to go in straight without stripping. I notice one other reviewer had a similar experience. I did not have any trouble connecting the back to the base. It's a little awkward, but if you work at the corner of a table with the back hanging down to the floor, it can be accomplished.

Appearance: The chair is HEAVY which bodes well for durability. It's shiny & sleek look is ruined by the fact that the seat (Charcoal) and the back (black) look like they are mismatched parts from two different chairs. I can't imagine why you'd design a chair like this!

Functionality: The seat is SUPER firm and flat without any contouring. I'm not sure it will be suitable for a full day's use. The back is comfortable, seems to provide enough support in the lumbar area and would be suitable for a fairly tall torso. It can tilt back or lock in one of three fixed positions. The arms are height adjustable but don't go low enough to fit underneath a desk.

Deal breaker #1: The arms have more than just a height adjustment. They can slide further forward towards your knees or towards your back by about a 2\\" range as well as pivot out away from or in towards your body to accommodate your personal likes. Seems like this would be a great customization feature and it would be, IF YOU COULD LOCK THEM IN PLACE when you had them where you like them. But they move when you aren't trying to move themand feel wobbly since they don't lock in place. Let's say you were standing up and you wanted to move your chair by pulling on the arm. You're very likely to have the armrest change position before the chair starts to move in the direction you're pulling. Not only is this annoying, but loud since the armrests make a clacking noise when they adjust. This would have been so easy to avoid. All you'd need is a little button that had to be pushed to unlock the armrest so it could be adjusted and leave the arms solid and immobile unless the button was depressed.

Deal breaker # 2: When the back is locked in the upright position, it almost feels like you're leaning forward. When it is locked in the middle position, you're definitely not sitting up straight. I'm not a fan of the unlocked setting where it tilts back depending on how much you lean back but I'm going to have to get used to it because the other options are not gonna work for me.

Long story short, this is a decent chair, but you might also want to consider Basyx VL712MM10 VL712 Mid-Back Mesh/Fabric Swivel/Tilt Chair which not only has none of the annoying drawbacks of the Hon chair but currently costs about a hundred bucks less.

EDIT: I took the arms off entirely and like the chair more now, especially how it can now actually fit tight to the desk when pushed in. The seat cushion is still too firm for my tushy.

product_title: Sarah Peyton Convection Cooled 8-inch Firm Support Memory Foam Mattress
review_body:
I am writing this to let anyone who may be interested know that this review is from a customer who needed a new bed. Some of the details you may consider: It ships rolled up and tightly wrapped in protective plastic & it must be unrolled within something like 24-48 hours of delivery.

It needs a good 24 hours to air out and regain its full loft. Then it's good to go. It really conforms to the body well and supports crucial areas like hips, back, shoulders, etc. It cost a little more than standard comparable mattresses, but with the cooling technology it's a good idea.

Overall it is very comfortable and sits well on the existing box springs from before. Honestly it probably does not need the box springs, but it is on a log bed so the support is necessary.

I look forward to many good years of comfortable sleep so long as it performs like it does thus far.

review_body: This mattress was supposed to be with a 3.0 lb density for the memory foam, however it feels cheaper than that. I'm 6ft, 190lb and getting out of this mattress after an hours sleep means you'll have to push yourself away from the mattress, which is not you may want after a good night's sleep. The edges are quite comfy to get into and away from the mattress, however if you sleep anywhere even close the center, you'll feel yourself slowly sinking in. I've used this mattress for 3 weeks and a return request has been placed with Amazon. If you sleep still, don't move around and like to be surrounded in dough like comfort, go for it. review_headline: A tool I cannot live without!
review_body: I do a lot of quilting.  I have many gadgets I cannot live without - the ones that make things faster and easier (June Taylor's Shape Cut Plus - fast Strip cutting. Until I started reading mixed reviews about the Perfect Piecer, I had no interest.  I watched the Jinny Beyer video on this tool to see what it did.  It was added to my list of things to try.  I bought it last week and have since completed two quilt tops.  Both with Set-In seams and Mitred corners; 16 Mitred corners - all PERFECT the first time!  No unsewing and trying again.  The set-in seams on the blocks were equally easy.  If you are unsure about how you might use this product, visit the Jinny Beyer website and watch the video.  I've added this to my list of \\"Must Have Tools\\"!  My quilting friends will likely get these for Christmas!!!

review_body: This futon is super comfortable! It was also pretty easy to put together. My only complaint is it sometimes locks up and won't lay flat, but is easily fixed with a screw driver - part of the mechanism just catches occasionally.

product_title: Sauder Edge Water Panel TV Stand, Estate Black Finish
review_headline: Solid build quality - looks elegant when constructed
review_body:
So we have a projector with a screen mounted just over all our consoles and media PC and receiver, but we were using an old coffee table for the longest time. I'd wanted a solution that fit in with the other furniture (dark colour, check!), something that had ample storage (2 nice drawers, check!), and something that fit all my existing components (large cupboard, check!)

The construction was very simple. My main complaint here is the box told me to flip it upside down, then the instructions were all the way under all the pieces. It would have been nice if the instructions were on the "bottom" of the package, or the top of where I was opening. No matter, I like to sort things before constructing anyway. Some of the steps presumed you guessed at things, so for instance it didn't tell you EVERY piece to install; it just assumed that you'd notice this hole needed this piece of hardware and you'd put it in everywhere. There were some extra pieces at the end for what I presume is the inevitable "lost piece" so that was nice.

NOTE: When you're assembling, make sure to verify which way the pre-slotted holes are facing. We put ours on upside down, so the holes are misaligned with the shelves.

Once assembled, it was very solid. On the bottom in the middle there's an additional leg support so that heave equipment won't cause sagging. Also, while it looks like there are 4 drawers, there's only 2. The drawer has enough space to hold a Microsoft wireless keyboard on a slight angle but still close properly. The only problem with the final product (and we really should have checked this before purchasing) is the depth wasn't quite sufficient to keep our receiver with all cables plugged in, so we had to cut off the rear panel just behind the receiver. It sticks out a little bit, but all our cables can actually attach now.

We've used it for about a week now. The glass doors are an absolute must since we don't have to get up every time to turn on the equipment. All our remotes now have a home when we're not using them, and our centre channel speaker is mounted at a much better height than "the floor". And since it's a real stand and not a coffee table, it keeps the cats from getting behind and chewing at the cables.

Overall, I'd rate this product very high for the price. I'm trying to avoid purchasing MDF furniture, but once it's in place you can't even tell!p every time to turn on the equipment. product_title: Easy Fit Box Spring Foundation
review_headline: Decent foundation but not enough boards to go across the middle
review_body:
I bought this foundation based on the overwhelming number of people who recommended it and/or mentioned it in their review of their memory foam purchases.

The good: For the price this is a decent foundation. It's secure, it holds the memory foam mattress, and it was easy to put together. The wood is solid and study.

The bad: The worst thing here is that there just isn't enough slats for a memory foam. The gaps between the pieces of wood are far too big for a memory foam. I had to go out and buy more wood to lay across to better secure my mattress. Anyone who says there is enough wood hasn't done their homework on the requirements of memory foam. Some of the wood was warped which doesn't effect performance but I still thought I should mention that. Assembling this foundation will require drilling out the holes to avoid splitting the wood. I believe those holes should have come pre-drilled.

Overall: I would recommend this mattress to friends if they are comfortable with tools and there is a hardware store nearby. Otherwise, no. The price is excellent.

product_title: Tri-fold Hardwood Futon Frame - Full Size
review_body:
At first I was a little concerned that this Futon would not meet my expectations, but after putting it together I have to say this is one durable and flexible little couch. My two dogs could not be happier, now they have a place to lay down with their dad or to be able to sleep next to me while I am chilling on the couch watching TV or playing a Game.

Sturdy frame if put together correctly. Wood could be stained or painted if you wanted to take the time before you put it together. Looks to be easily taken apart for transportation. The relaxed portion of the front helps with moving on and off the couch, and also for just relaxing with your feet up. Even with a Futon mattress on, it is easy to lift the ends and move them around.

I have not tried physically moving the couch as one piece, but will be in the near future. Especially, since I need room to play on the Kinect system with. If you are a student or an apartment liver, then this excellently priced Futon frame is for you. Doesn't take up much space, not to bad to sleep on, and makes for a nice fit in the area where you view TV or sleep.

The frame from back to front, if folded would be 2 feet. With my mattress it is around 21 inches, but the futon mattress I have is thicker than most.

Moving the couch is pretty easy. I do worry about the legs crunching on me, but so far it is still holding sturdy and I move it two to three times a week so I can work out in my apartment living room. The only down side is the mattress does slide a little, so you may need to use some velcro or something else to tie it to the frame of the futon.

product_title: TMS 24-Inch Arizona Sadde Stool, White
review_body:
I ordered one of these saddles, in white, to go with two white round seat counter stools I had ordered to go with a kitchen island. I could not decide which style I preferred, so I got both. Now that I have them both, I can tell you I far prefer the saddle stool. Here's why:

1. Much more comfortable than the counter stools, to my surprise.
2. Much easier to install--while both were made in Malaysia, the holes and screws fit together perfectly for this one, much more of a struggle for the counter stools.
3. The rubber wood has a little give, enhancing comfort and feel.
4. Price very reasonable, and can order one at a time, don't have to order two.
5. The saddle comes with rubber floor bumpers on the bottom, whereas the counter stools didn't. These protect the floor against scratches and a grating sound.

The one con with the saddle is that it takes up more room than a round counter stool, so you can't comfortably fit quite as many of them in the same space. But all in all, a great buy.

product_title: Atlantic Furniture Lexington Writing Desk
review_headline: Better than I hoped it would be.
review_body:
It's rare that I purchase an item that exceeds my expectations. Usually the stuff I buy is either what I think it will be or poorer quality, so I feel like this particular desk deserves a review.

This desk is solid wood, NOT the cheap pressed board veneered junk that you find everywhere these days. It is quite sturdy and well constructed. I wouldn't try to put an elephant on it but I loaded it up pretty good with books, computers, a lamp, and other miscellaneous office clutter and it's definitely solid construction.

It comes in three parts: The top is one fully assembled piece (including the drawer) and the legs come in a separate package, as do the cross brace pieces.

Something that really surprised me was that the drawer has several non-adjustable compartments (one large one in the back and three smaller ones in front) and is lined with green velvet. It may put some people off that the drawer has these compartments but I liked it. If I had one complaint about the desk, though, it's that the drawer cannot be pulled all the way out. It only comes out about a foot and then stops, even though the drawer itself is nearly 2 feet deep. There's enough room to get in there fairly easily but I still might play around with it to get the drawer to come out to its full depth.

In all, I was very surprised at the good quality of this desk and the neat little things that you don't see in the pictures (the green velvet desk drawer is REALLY nice IMHO). Construction only took about 30 minutes and as an added bonus, my cat is thoroughly enjoying playing in the box that the desk came in.

I'm more than satisfied with my purchase.

product_title: A Family Movie Poster (11 x 17 Inches - 28cm x 44cm) (2010) UK Style A -(Johan Philip Asbæk)(Jesper Christensen)(Lene Maria Christensen)(Anne Louise Hassing)(Coco Hjardemaal)(Gustav Fischer Kjærulff)
review_headline: Of Death and Dying: A Family
review_body:
Yes, this space is for a poster that advertises the film A FAMILY ('EN FAMILIE'), but this rather exceptional film is available 'on demand' now and is well worth researching. It is a small Danish film that explores the intimacies and delicate threads that hold families together. It is quiet, contemplative, and pulls the viewer into the film to the point where every member of this family is someone with whom we can closely relate.

The film opens in a very unique manner: black and white snapshots give the history of the Rheinwald family, beginning with the great grandfather who walked form Germany to Denmark carrying a sack of grain through the gradual creation and building of a bakery always run by family, a bakery that becomes the purveyors of baked goods to the Royalty of Denmark. Once the story begins we meet the elder chief of the bakery Rikard Rheinwald (Jesper Christensen) who despite the past year of being on chemotherapy for lung cancer has survived and remains the driving force behind the successful family business. Rikard has two daughters by his first failed marriage - Ditte (Lene Maria Christensen) who owns an art gallery and has a live-in boyfriend Peter (Johan Philip 'Pilou' Asbæk) who is an artist, and the younger daughter Chrisser (Line Kruse) - and lives now with his girlfriend Sanne (Anne Louise Hassing) with whom he has two more children, Line (Coco Hjardemaal) and Werner (Gustav Fischer Kjærulff). Ditte has been offered a prominent position with Gagosian Gallery in New York and she and Peter plan to move there.

When the letter from the hospital arrives stating the Rikard has no more lung cancer the family celebrates; Rikard marries Sanne and all seems well. An unexpected physical development occurs and leads to a diagnosis of inoperable cerebral metastases. Rikard, feeling defeated, hates hospitals and insists on being at home instead of a hospice. He informs Ditte that as his eldest child she is the one to inherit the Rheinwald Bakery. Ditte is severely conflicted. She and Peter have made significant decisions about their relationship and Ditte must choose between following her father's mandate or living her own dreams. The manner in which this family is affected by the gradual demise of the patriarch is deeply touching and realistic. In the end this story explores every aspect of the meaning of family - birth to death - in a manner that allows the audience to understand the actions and motivations of each member.

The cast is exceptional, with the performances of Jesper Christensen and Lene Maria Christensen being particularly sensitive. Kim Fupz Aakeson wrote the story and screenplay with writer director Pernille Fischer Christensen. The moody interiors as captured by cinematographer Jakob Ihre remind us of the paintings of Danish artist Vilhelm Hammershoi. This is finely wrought little film that is one of the most tender views of family on film. Hopefully Amazon.com will make this stunning DVD available soon, or better yet, offer it in the Amazon Instant Video format. It is well worth the wait. Grady Harp, July 11itte is severely conflicted. product_title: Catskill Craftsmen Stainless Steel Butcher Block Cart
review_headline: Great--Now That The Assembly Odyssey Is Over
review_body: This is a really nice kitchen cart--very sturdy and good-looking.  Worth the money, I think; we're using it for a microwave cart and have moved all sorts of small appliances to the shelves and off of our counter.  Priceless!  All parts are of good quality and I'm very happy with it.    HOWEVER, it took me a couple of weeks to get this together.  This is why:    First, Amazon sent me only one of the two boxes.  Rather than send me box #2, they made me send back the (very heavy) box #1 and sent back two boxes. That took several days of missing the UPS man picking up and dropping off.  When it arrived, both shelves were bent so badly that they were not usable--it speaks highly of the quality of steel that I wasn't able to pound out the warping with a mallet.  So I followed the instructions on a flyer in the box and called the company directly instead of Amazon for replacement parts.  The company rep was extremely helpful and friendly, and the (free with free shipping!) replacement shelves arrived soon after.  It's a shame to have to throw out such nice steel shelves!  I wonder what is going on in the Amazon warehouse, or it they could have been packed better, or what?  As I said, it's very hardy steel so it would have been a pretty serious calamity to cause the kind of damage my first set of shelves had.      I wish I had tested the bolts before I called the company, though.  I was very excited to finally start assembling this cart (and get the now-3 boxes of heavy clattery things off my kitchen floor) and was therefore very disappointed when I had to stop assembling it when the locking bolts provided did not fit into the square holes in the legs.  I went to the hardware store to get some replacements rather than wait for more bolts in the mail.  What was interesting was that not all of the bolts I got at the hardware store fit, either, even though all were ostensibly the same measurement.  One more trip back to the hardware store to get all 16 bolts fitting.  So somebolt manufacturing concern out there is making bolts slightly too big, and Catskill Craftsmen may want to look into this or make sure that the holes become bigger, too.      Once I had all of the parts, assembly was very easy.      After all of this, I'm happy with it, but I don't know that I go through all of this again.  Or maybe I would.  There is a dearth of high-quality kitchen furniture out there.

product_title: International Concepts BJ6TE Mission Tall End Table, Unfinished
review_headline: Better to refinish an old piece
review_body:
This product line is made out of rubber wood that is cut into very small pieces. Not only the smaller bits, even the tabletops are made from these small strips of wood, pieced together. Some of them are inadequately sanded, others have small pits. Pieces with very different grain are butted together.

In places you will encounter the remains of an especially stubborn wood glue (that won't accept stain), including corners where it is difficult to remove, or even flat surfaces where you might not notice the thin coat.

The result is that the surface is poor for finishing products, and it's basically impossible (at any reasonable skill level, maybe any skill level) to finish these pieces and cover up the fact that they are made from small bits of mediocre wood. Unless you want to paint it.

Also, one of the three items from this line that I ordered came without the assembly hardware. Amazon couldn't send the hardware separately, so I had to send the whole 49 lb. table back. The original box was of poor quality and was destroyed by UPS on the inbound. So it was quite a pain to return.

You'd be much better off to find an used piece of furniture and refinish it.

The back of the desk is open so that I can place it in front of the baseboard without blocking the heat source and the glass inserts in the side panels gives it a more open feel and enhances the elegant design so that it looks like a custom piece of furniture. product_title: Ergonomic Kneeling Posture Office Chair w/ Wheels
review_headline: Works, as long as you don't use it very much
review_body:
This started out as a good chair that did what it was supposed to do in terms of helping my posture during 12+ hour long days at the desk. My desktop is around two inches taller than normal height and this helped raise my eye level to a better placement. I actually prefer this over \\"normal\\" chairs now because the form factor is smaller and more accessible and it's virtually impossible to slouch even after long periods of time, and my back doesn't feel as strained at the end of a day of sitting. If you do a significant amount of back-and-forth between sitting and standing this is also much better than a conventional chair.

For a review of kneeling posture chairs in general I'd say go down to an office supply store and test one out. They can make a big difference at the end of the day and this chair in particular had the angles well defined and at first the build quality looked good. However, I said \\"did what it was supposed to do\\" instead of \\"does\\" for a reason. Within a few weeks of its second anniversary of use I noticed that I was slouching in the other direction - laterally. This is a very strange sensation which I thought was possibly caused by an inner-ear disorientation or some other odd malady on my part, but quickly found out it was the chair (see next paragraph). The top seat of this chair is welded to the post with only two contact points. My body is quintessentially average at 5 feet, 9 inches height and weighing 150 lbs. and I never used this chair for tasks such as propping up a car or other less than normal tasks. I had somehow managed to begin shearing the welded contact points between the seat and the post over two years with nothing but the \\"brute force\\" of my body using it as a chair, causing the seat of the chair to tilt sideways in either direction depending on my weight distribution without being so pronounced as to point to the chair, at least at first. Heck, didn't realize my own (dead weight) strength...

A word of caution to anyone out there that begins to have a similar experience - DO NOT CONTINUE USING THE CHAIR. If you've already made the purchase inspect the contact points on the seat regularly and discard the chair if they look worn. I waddled around for a week discovering how crucial a biped's tailbone is for walking and standing when the shearing strain hit the tipping point and I landed flat on said tailbone because the chair disintegrated as I sat down on it for the last time.

As of this review, the list price on this is over 200 USD. I consider this to be in the durable goods category, which means I expect at the very least three years of use out of it and if the vendor expects $200 I expect quite a bit more than that. In my opinion, this is a shoddily built chair that can't take normal use over a reasonable amount of time. Am I asking too much?

review_headline: Can it really be this good? So Far it is!
review_body:
