Still wonderful. When I sleep I'm another bed, say traveling, all I can think about is my perfect mattress. Hopefully whatever they've upgraded to is at least as good. The price has gone up a fair notch. I still love mine, over 5 years later. Perfect!

UPDATE: Over a year later and I long to come home to my memory foam mattress after trips on the road staying in hotels or even at my GFs house with her fancy king mattress. I love it still...only problem is that a majority of the time i sleep in the same exact spot and i fear I haven't worn it evenly. I will test this theory soon. So far so great. Totally worth the money over one year in i feel like i've already recouped the cost. I snore super loud and my GF says I barely do at my place.

Ok, I'll be fair...im typing this at work after just having unpacked the thing this morning. So i haven't even slept on it yet. Just like the others, i was not so sure about buying a bed sight unseen and online...but just like the others i trusted these amazingly positive reviews. I nearly bought a nice simmons mattress from sears, but i just felt like this was the way to go. I have owned a tempurpedic mattress that my ex kept when we split. I actually think I'm gonna like this one better to be honest.

It seems a little softer. The process was super easy and cool. Ontrac delivered it and brought it up the steps to my apartment. i just dragged it to the bedroom and dumped it out of the box, laid it down in the boxspring and cut the bags open and bam, i've got a cloud to sleep on. The quality and density seem perfect and i'm shocked to say i think this may be the best buy ive ever made, and im good at finding quality deals. I plan to update this review after a few days, weeks and again in 6 months. but for now, i cant see any reason why someone who wants a tempurpedic would regret getting this instead and pocketing the difference. I used the money i saved to buy an awesome new computer. THATS how much cheaper this is. ~$350 for this kind of bed is crazy cheap, i could not have done better at any mattress store.

It really is exactly as advertised. Only downside, now i have to get rid of that abomination that has been abusing my back for the last year or so. It's too soon for me to really give an honest apprasial but i had to chime in that so far, i'm so very happy i just did it. reserving the 5th star for down the road.

review_body: My husband and I purchased this for our son for Christmas, he absolutely loved it, however it is extremely large! product_title: Baxton Studios Natural Wood Nelson Bench
review_body:
This item is an exceptional value and looks as good as expected.

product_title: SilverRest Sleep Shop Luxury Grand 14-Inch Memory Foam Mattress
review_headline: Nice bed/ not the grand bed
review_body: Ok so I have had this mattress for about 10 days now. At first I hated it but that's because I am not used to memory foam. It feels pretty firm at the beginning and your posture is not good and you sleep on your back it will hurt your lower back for a while ( again if you are not used to memory foam). but after a while I think it works to straighten your back and make you sleep comfortable. So now it is more comfortable. I sleep better on it but I still wake up in the middle of the night. Why? I don't know..Maybe the smell is still there specially when you dig your nose far into it...  is it the Grand-bed. I know a lot of you would like to think so because of how much cheaper it is than grand bed. It looks similar it is one inch lower. and guess what IT DOES NOT HAVE the 8lb foam layer that the grand bed has ( HD foam). When I tried the grand bed I could feel that layer giving this luxury foam feeling that this bed is probably too cheap to use. but 6 inch of 5 lb memory foam isn't bad either. This bed will conform to your body after a while and become like concrete.Don't even think about turning.  Ok now if you workout a lot and have some veins or if you usually wake up with lazy arms because of restricted blood flow this bed will probably make it worst because of how it conforms to your body exactly and pushes down on your veins.  pillows: use a flat one even if your used to thick one otherwise say welcome to neck pain  overall: this bed is nice and luxurious. The corner edges however never really expanded correctly ( there seems to be a grove between white top and brown bottom but that didn't bother me much, i am not a perfectionist. if you are it may bother you  I like this bed a lot but I still wake up in the middle of the night probably due to smell ( 10 days gone but if you stomach sleep you can still smell it and over time it will wake you up)  Anyway I am giving this 3 stars for now and will update as I keep trying it

product_title: Baxton Studio Azzo Plastic Mid-Century Modern Shell Chair, Set of 2
review_body:
Update: after about 6 months, I am still happy with these chairs. They do creak a bit and have sagged when people a bit heavier have sat in the chairs. However, I don't know if they are just \\"giving\\" because the hardware if flexible, or if they are moving in ways they shouldn't. But, so far nothing bad has happened, and they are comfortable and look good!

I'm happy with these chairs, especially for the price. I'm sure an expert could identify them as not being the \\"real thing,\\" but to most eyes they are indistinguishable. The wooden dowel bases look very nice, and look like good quality wood.

They were very easy to put together. Overall I'm happy that I bought these, and they look very nice in my dining room!

I'll be interested to see if, like a previous reviewer indicated, if they hold up over time.

product_title: Boss Black "No Tools Required" Executive Leather Chair
review_body: I've suffered from a bad back for years and am always looking for a comfortable chair that won't aggravate my back, and this is it. review_body: I typically don't write reviews unless i'm extremely disappointed in a product or completely thrilled with it. This TV stand is one i'm thrilled with. review_body: This is my third of this style organizer bins that weve had and this is the first to NOT have the notches on the bottem of the bins so you can sit them ON the bars instead of slanted. product_title: Safavieh Lyndhurst Collection LNH221A Traditional Multi and Ivory Area Rug
review_body: Have had this rug for almost one year.  From the very beginning, the rug would not flatten out no matter what we tried. I note that I haven't had any bunching issues with the wool area rugs that I have, so I think that it is due to the polypropylene material. It feels far less substantial than wool and is noticeably thinner.    The colors do look good and the pattern is nice. However, I definitely cannot recommend this rug and would not buy another rug made of polypropylene.

product_title: Anji Mountain Bamboo Roll-Up Chairmat with Lip
review_body: I purchased this product so that my chairmat would blend more nicely the wood floors in my officer, rather than the lame clear plastic chairmats. While the mats are truly some of the best I've used, they are a little pricey. But, I was willing to cough up the cash for both the visual aspect and the quality. review_body: This is a solid piece of furniture, especially given the price. It's more of a burgundy color, which matches my cherry wood desk perfect and leather chair. It has sturdy hinges on the top to provide ample space for magazines, remote controls, books and/or throw pillows. I didn't need to use the feet, becuase it made it bit tall for my office chair. It's a refined piece and for the fifty dollar price tag, you cannot miss.

product_title: Crown Mark Dentil Chair Side Table
review_body:
This table deserves at least four stars, maybe five...but it was made in China and that fact wasn't mentioned anywhere. I would pay more to purchase an item that is made here in the States. Yes, I know it's difficult to find everything you need that isn't made in China but maybe we're part of the problem. I considered shipping it back as soon as I saw the \\"Made in China\\" label on the outside of the box but I didn't. I really wanted this table since it was exactly what I was looking for so I kept it. Maybe that makes me a hypocrite but I do wish I'd been made aware of the fact that it wasn't made here before I ordered it.

The table is fairly well made but not as good as the other reviews make it sound. The stain isn't evenly applied, one of the legs has a gouge in it (although it's at the top and not overly noticeable) and the way the shelf is attached isn't well designed. product_title: Furinno 11158EX/BR Coffee Table with Bins
review_body: I was looking for a decent coffee table and took my chances on this one and I gotta say, I enjoy it very much! Assembly wasn't too bad and I was overall satisfied with the results! It's a little smaller than I thought but other than that it's perfect for a little place.

product_title: Flash Furniture High Back Ergonomic Task Chair with Adjustable Arms - Black / Gray
review_body: I have back and neck problems, so when it was time to look for a new chair, I was willing to spend good money to get something that worked for me. As much as I love Amazon, the fact that you can't try things out ahead of time means certain things, you're taking a chance on. Shoes, clothing, and now chairs are all things I realize you should try FIRST.    I assembled this item immediately upon arrival. It wasn't comfortable, but it was more comfortable than the chair I'd been using. I figured that over time, I'd find some combination of adjustments that would work.    Nope.    I had this for 4 months, and by that point, sitting at my computer for more than 30 minutes meant I needed painkillers. I ended up going to Office Max and buying a new chair, and I threw this one away. The lumbar support isn't adjustable, and the seat rises up in an odd way that isn't adjustable either. The whole chair ended up forcing my body into an awkward position, and no amount of fiddling with the levers could fix it. I don't think I'll ever purchase a chair again unless I can sit in it ahead of time.

product_title: basyx VL712MM10 VL712 Series Mid-Back Swivel/Tilt Work Chair, Black Mesh
review_body:
This chair appears to be of high quality, and it is very easy to assemble. The only tool you'll need is supplied, and the hardware is clearly labeled. The arm rests are labeled with both an \\"L\\" (or an \\"R\\") and an arrow that points to the front. The front of the seat cushion is also labeled in big red letters. Assembly went without a hitch.

The seat cushion is ample and rather stiff. I expect that the stiffness means that it won't go flat too soon, and it's not uncomfortable at all.

I prefer a fabric chair like this one for the ventilation--leather is just uncomfortable for me. The arm rests, however, are a type of rubber. Nicely padded, but with no fabric covering, and they just feel sticky. This presumably won't be a problem if you always wear long sleeves.

The other aspect of the arm rests that I don't like is their position. They just feel totally wrong to me, no matter what height I adjust them to. I finally removed them completely, and then I was much happier with the chair.

(I'm considering putting the arm rests on the wrong way around [L on R and vice versa] to see if that works better for me. There is nothing about the construction that would prevent this [and yes, I did check that I had them on correctly the first time]. If that improves matters, I'll edit this review.)

Like another reviewer here, I am a large person. The chair height adjustment was fine, the seat comfort was fine. Without the arm rests, the chair seems OK for me. Even if they had just covered the rubber padding, that would have been a big improvement.

product_title: South Shore Axess Collection Bookcase
review_headline: Finished, item looks great!  Had complications though...
review_body:
I must admist that I was extremely excited to receivethis bookcase, and couldn't wait to put it together. I'm quite experienced with putting things together from out of a box at this point (behind the toilet shelves, pantries, etc). This however, was a bit complicated-especially since it came without instructions.

I'm not knocking any stars from this particular seller, or the product itself due to that. In fact, I contacted the seller who immediately e-mailed me instructions, as well as mailed them to me-and fairly quickly at that.

Well, there are quite a few pieces that go with this-make SURE you don't lose them! I took everything out of the box, waiting looking for the instructions-and while I was waiting I had to ensure the parts didn't mysteriously disappear while I was waiting. My fiance and I are doing some remodeling, so I didn't want him to see the screws, nails, etc-and think they were free game.

Oh-keep in mind that this is VERY HEAVY! Once the instructions came in (7-10 days later) I put it all together in about an hour. Probably a bit long-yes, but I'm pregnant and have no desire to move quickly at the moment. Things get done when they get done at this point : j

I purchased this bookshelf to go along with the rest of the bedroom set-and to have a place to hold our extra books, maagazines, and knick knacks. Looks great, does the job perfectly-and actually somehow managed to match the bedroom set VERY WELL! For the price, you can't beat it. I would recommend having someone help you-as I'm sure the project will go so much smoother with a helping hand. It doesn't look cheap like I thought it would-and I have had no issues with it looking \\"out of place\\" whatsoever.

Would highly recommend-and definitely purchase again if I should need another one.

-Hannah

product_title: Night Therapy Weekender Elite Folding Guest Bed with Bonus Storage Bag
review_headline: Great value, light-weight, but sags a bit
review_body:
We bought this item as a temporary bed for guests coming at our place. The package arrived via FedEx on time with the bed neatly packed in a zippered cover with the mattress covered with a plastic bag. No assembly is required - just remove the bed from the zippered cover, unclip the ends, and the bed folds open along with the mattress - just a one person job. The mattress was too soft for comfort though and the bed sags a bit (even for a person weighing about 120lbs), since it's only held by springs connected to the iron frame. An iron cross-bar in the center of the frame might have added more support to the lower back. Otherwise, the bed is light-weight, and can be re-assembled and stowed away in a mobile frame by a single person.

All in all, we are satisfied with this inexpensive, light, sturdy, and utility bed for temporary use - which could have been made less saggy with additional cross-bar support for the lower back.

product_title: Flash Furniture High Back Ergonomic Task Chair with Adjustable Arms - Black / Gray
review_body: OK....here goes. Bought this chair October 2010, It's now June 2011 and the chair is broken. I use it Monday-Friday for the duration of the time I'm in the office.....some days only 3-4 hrs. The piece that looks to be broken is the plastic sleever over the shaft. This causes it to lean now to one side.....not very comfortable!  I'm 6 foot, 185 pounds...wouldn't think that would break a chair!

product_title: DynastyMattress King Celebrity 13-Inch Pillow Top 5.3LB Memory Foam
review_body: I will Say Shipment Was Fast. I got the mattress rolled up and vacuum sealed, layed out on my box springs and watched it take form (about and hour). The Smell Not bad at all, I do Not Realize why people complain so much about that as it was not an issue for me. Does have a scent of latex but nothing to extreme. This will be my third night of sleeping on it and the quaint smell of latex was gone after the first night. COMFORT: I am not used to memory foam mattress's this is my first. Seems firm at first then you begin to  form with into the mattress which creates a problem if your used to rolling around or switching positions while you sleep, then it feels like your lying on a hill as your body indintions are still in the mattress. I guess i will get used to it, not sure yet as I came from a 2500 dollar beauty rest to this. other than feeling liike you lying oon a hill when you rotate or somone lays next to you its really comfortable when you stay in the same spot!  My only thing is i hope it last and doesnt start caving in like some cheaper brands have been known to do. I have only read one review where that has happend with this mattress. Ok thats it for now i will try to update again down the road. but value wise i think its worth it for now. Really wish i would have bought the 14in for 1000 but o well.........

product_title: Soft Suede Luxe Bean Bag  Bigfoot Footstool
review_body: We bought these for our bonus room and we really like them.  They are just the right height for relaxing on the couch.  We haven't had to wash them yet, but so far so good.

product_title: Winsome Xola Coffee Table with 2 Drawers
review_body: I own the end table in this same model and liked it, so i ordered the coffee table to match. The coffee table is so much worse its unbelievable. The edges were worn looking straight out of the box. It has a knot in the wood right on top of the table with cracks. On one edge it has a crack where there aren't even any knots around it. The edges of the platform on the bottom are rough and all chipped up like as if they used a saw with large teeth to cut it. The holes for assembly didn't match up, so i had to drill them out a little more too. I'm hoping to return it, but I threw away the box when I assembled it so I'm not sure that I'll be able to. I have Amazon Prime so shipping was fine and I received it in 2 days. Do not buy this table.

product_title: Grip-It Ultra Stop Non-Slip Rug Pad for Rugs on Hard Surface Floors
review_body: We bought an over sized area rug (9.5 X 13.5) and couldn't find a non-slip pad for it.  That is until we searched on Amazon (love this site).  It works great for a rug that big and we actually had to trim the pad slightly to fit under the rug.  No local stores carried anything this large and the smaller pads they did carry we more expensive than this item.  Very happy with this purchase.

product_title: Winsome Wood Black Coffee Table
review_headline: I would have rated this a 5 Star
review_body: I received this product scratched on the table top. I love the table, but wish it wasn't sent with a big scratch on the top of it

product_title: Winsome Wood Breakfast Bed Tray with Handle Foldable Legs
review_body: I have generally had poor luck with Winsome products because of poor construction and iffy customer service. However, this tray is designed and built well and performs just about as well as could be expected. The price was also a very good value. Buying through Amazon gave me some assurance that I could easily return the tray if the previous problems cropped up again.

product_title: Ikea Lack Side Table with Extension Legs
review_body:
The item's assembly is \\"idiot\\" proof. It does take a bit of screwing to get the legs in. If you calculate what shipping is from IKEA.com, you wind up paying the same, except it ships a lot slower than via Amazon Prime. True, it is just $8 at IKEA but I don't have a car so I need it shipped to me, and shipping via IKEA is very expensive! It costs much more than the item itself!

It was easy to assemble, and took me about 15 minutes. It is also a very sturdy table. I would purchase this again!

product_title: Beechwood Toy Chest by Lipper
review_body: We bought this for our almost 1 year old son.  I like the size and storage capacity.  It is nice looking, and good enough quality for the money.  It has the no-slam lid to prevent little fingers from getting crushed, and air holes on the back side for any children who might decide to climb in and close the lid.  My husband said it was easy to assemble, except that the pre-drilled holes for attaching the lid were off line ever so slightly, so the lid is not perfectly square on the toy chest when it is closed.  It still closes just fine, and functions for what we need.  You have to look pretty closely to see that the lid is not perfectly square on the chest.  It's also sturdy enough to use as a bench seat.  The frame is made of actual hard wood, but the front, back, and side panels are not real wood.  Our son hasn't destructed it yet, and as long as he doesn't kick in the front or sides when he's older, I think it will last just fine.

product_title: Yu Shan Mission Desk with Hutch, Walnut Finish
review_headline: Surprisingly nice piece of furniture for the price
review_body: Well, I was worried...it looked like exactly what we wanted, and the price was good, too. But some of the reviews seemed to indicate 1. it was hard to put together, 2. it would arrive damaged.  But, it arrived intact, and it was surprisingly easy to put together.  I've put together lots of this type of stuff over the years, and although IKEA stuff has better instructions (usually), this was really well labeled.  I was especially impressed that all of the screws, dowels, latches, etc, were each in their own individual nicely labeled bags. This is way better than most, that have all the hardware in a couple of unlabeled bags, and you have to figure out which of the 5 different size screws is the one you need for the next step.  Read through each section of instructions BEFORE you start assembly, it will go fine, even easy.  Took me a little over an hour.  Quality: Surprise! It is mostly real wood.  The finish is actually quite good.  The color isn't quite as reddish as in the illustrations, it is darker. But, it still looks nice, especially with the other Mission furniture in the room.  Negatives:  The enclosed allen wrench is really cheap and stripped out quickly on me. No big deal for me, I have tools. But, it might be a small issue for some.  Also, a couple of the larger screw holes were kind of messed up, and the plugs didn't cover them completely. I debated calling the company for a replacement set of legs, but it isn't that noticeable.  Anyway, Yu Shan doesn't sound like a company that should have \\"Mission\\" style furniture, but it works!

product_title: South Shore Vito Collection TV Stand/Storage Unit, Black
review_body: I purchased all 5 pieces of this furniture for my bedroom and love them all.  Purchased at a great price and free shipping!!!  There are a lot of parts and it does take some time to put together, but if you follow the instructions it is very easy to assemble.  Everything was very sturdy once assembled, the drawers slide in and out very easily and it looks great.  There were a couple of pieces that had been damaged in shipment but it was very simple to go online and order a replacement at no cost.  And the parts were shipped quickly and protected very well.  I have no complaints with any of the pieces and would recommend to any one.

product_title: STRUCTURES by Malouf HIGHRISE Folding Metal Bed Frame 14 Inch High Bi-Fold Platform Bed Base and Box Spring
review_body: Simple to set-up. Screws used to join lengthwise frames aligns only one-way. Best if placed on wood or carpeted areas as it may have a tendency to move especially if your weight is around >250#'s. Received item within a week. Amazon is a great online shopping experience.

product_title: Alden Lap Desk - Flip Top w/ Drawer & Foldable Legs
review_body: Overall height of the table is too low, legs wont fit under it.  table legs are loose and shaky.  Otherwise a beautiful looking table with nice wooden finish.  Also it took almost a month to ship.

product_title: SEI Black Steel Wall-Mount CD Rack
review_headline: Pictures aren't consistent re: actual shape
review_body: When I opened the boxes (I got two), I was impressed by the sturdy and sleek design plus easy install. Problem is how they look on my wall - they are not full triangles but a skinnier version - looks kind of odd/shrunken.  One of the photos shows this but the other three made it look like they were more like actual triangles. For small walls/rooms might not be such an issue. For me, hoping I can adjust to the look.

product_title: Canwood Alpine II Loft Bed
review_body: We are in the middle of putting this together, and a foundation leg A2, piece B and piece F, the holes are not correct on them. On the leg, some of the holes are supposed to be all the way through and two of them are not. There are two holes that appear to go all the way through but do not match up by over 3/4\\". Extremely frustrating when trying to put the thing together. The pilot holes on B and F were like pins and had to be drilled out a little more to make it functional. This bed should not and is not hard to put together, as long as the holes are all the way through! We are not beginners for these kinds of things (we easily put together bunk beds last weekend), but you have to at least have a quality product to put together. 3 of the pieces are also bowed. I suspect they are bowed because our box arrive soaking wet on the bottom (no it was not out in the rain on our porch). Hopefully they will take better shape once they've had a chance to dry out in the finished product.

product_title: Zuo Director Office Chair
review_body: I purchased this same chair back in 2007 and it lasted 5 years.  Loved the chair so much that just bought it again this year.  Some may think that 5 years is not a long time, but this chair was used excessively and is likely the most utilized peace of furnitre in my home.  Very sturdy chair and seems to be good for your back as well.  I have modern taste when it comes to furniture and it has a very modern appeal.

product_title: South Shore Furniture, Popular Collection, Double Dresser, Natural Maple
review_headline: Looks nice but takes a lot of effort to assemble.
review_body: This looks very sharp for a bureau but the material is particle board except the two side boards which take the majority of the weight.  If any weight is over the design weight and is put inside the drawer, it would be difficult to repair because of the way it's constructed.  Real wood can take a beating yet still be repairable.  It took my wife and I 3 hours to assemble.  For a group of students with a tight budget, this would be fine.  For us, we don't have time to assemble.  I guess that's why it's cheap - no assembly.  These originate from Vermont and then fly all over the country before arriving at our house.  Don't intend to get this on the estimated date.

product_title: Linon Ardmore Kitchen Nook Set
review_body:
I was a bit hesitant to order this as I had read that this set was not very sturdy. I would agree that it is not really a heavy duty family heirloom piece of furniture though. However, for the price it is very good and I'm sure we'll get many years worth of use out of the dining set. I think it is actually quite sturdy; just be sure to tighten the bolts/screws quite well. It took my wife and I close to (2) hours to put this together and the instructions are very easy to follow. It looks absoultely beautiful in our small kitchen and can easily fit 5 adults quite nicely. People have suggested using a power drill/screwdriver. I would tend to disagree with this. There is the possibility to over-tighten the screws, thus causing damage to the pieces. I used a conventional screw-driver and I had no problem putting this together. As for the storage in the benches; it is pretty much only useful for dish-towels and other linens. This is fine for my family's needs though.
Overall, I definitely would recommend this corner nook. We actually replaced an $1100 Room and Board small dining table and chair set with this unit and I could not be happier with the new look and more space in our kitchen.

EDITED 7/15/2013..... Decreased Star Rating Down to 2
After having used this item for less then 1 year; the single bench split in half and the table top scratches so easily that I'd liken the softness of the \\"wood\\" to butter. So.... we got rid of the table and broken single bench pieces. The \\"L\\" shaped seating bench we did keep and it is nice. Once again, it is not the most durable item, but it is holding up well.

product_title: Lapp Topper Vinyl & Plastic Lap Desk (Navy Blue) (5"H x 23"W x 16"D)
review_body: Just ordered my third lapptopper. As a long time wheelchair user (paraplegic), I thought I'd died and gone to heaven when I first found this product. I use it daily as an eating tray, laptop computer desk, to pay bills, and everything else that calls for a flat surface, including garden tools when I dabble in my flower beds. I take it along when I go out to a buffet and load up my plate, including dessert dish. The only part that has worn out is the vinyl on the bumper pad, which cracks and splits with time and usage. The person who invented this tray should be knighted!

product_title: Poundex Leaning Bookcase Bookshelf, Dark Espresso Brown
review_body:
PROS: easy to assemble, looks great, much cheaper than the hundreds of dollars for similar models at other stores
CONS: stability questionable, weak

Overall, I am satisfied with the bookshelf - it is a compact, stylish piece of furniture for a great price. However, I made the mistake of putting heavy books on the 2nd to the bottom shelf, and the uneven weight distribution caused the screw to crack a bit, and now it tilts. It's great for everyday paperback novels, light picture albums, and I even put a printer on the very bottom shelf, but stay away from heavier items. Also, as a renter, I don't love that in order to fully secure it you have to screw in hooks into the wall. At the right angle, the two legs will be enough for it to rest, but I'm definitely hoping there aren't any large earthquakes anytime soon.

product_title: Premium-Lock Rug Pad 3' x 5' - Provides Extra Cushion, For All Hard Surfaces, Heavier and Thicker than Most Rug Pads
review_body: I have purchased items similar to this in the past, and I like this brand better than many I have seen.  The pad is more substantial than most, and it works well to hold my rugs in place.

product_title: Way Basics Eco Storage Cube Plus
review_body: These are great and serve the purpose, but I think for the price that they are a bit flimsy and cheap looking. Very lightweight, which is great but also adds to the cheapness. I was disappointed. I thought because I was paying a little more than average, that these would be awesome.

product_title: Sleep Innovations Shiloh Memory Foam Mattress
review_headline: Accident victim able to sleep in bed instead of recliner for first time in 7 years!
review_body: I was in a bad accident almost 7 years ago and had C-spine injuries. Since then I have also developed fibromyalgia. The constant pain has been so bad that I have been unable to sleep in a bed since the accident. I've slept in a recliner instead, which has only worsened my posture by pushing my head forward and hunching my shoulders forward and inward.    I've thought about buying an adjustable bed with a memory foam mattress, but they cost thousands of dollars and I had no way of knowing if it would work for me.    I read the reviews of the Sleep Innovations 12-inch Sure Temp Memory Foam mattress and decided to try it. At this price, what did I have to lose? I ordered a twin size, thinking I could always use it as a spare bed if it did not work out for me. Shipping was amazing - I ordered late in the afternoon and it arrived the next day in a large, heavy box. My husband and son carried the box upstairs. Son is young and strong and says he could have managed it himself, but it was definitely heavy. Anything larger than a twin would need two people, no question.    We set it up on an existing older box spring and left it uncovered to air out. There was a mild chemical odor, but not too bad at all -- nothing like the smelly memory foam topper by another company we bought some years ago and had to return after airing it out for almost a week!    By that night I was ready to try it. I had also purchased a Sleep Innovations contour memory foam pillow, so I put that down with the larger contour side under my neck. I've never had a foam mattress before, so it was startling to feel how different it is from an inner spring mattress.     There is a squishiness, but at the same time it supports, so as I lay on my back I felt more like I was floating rather than sinking down into a valley. I had once tried an inflatable air mattress and that was awful -- it was hard in spite of being filled with air, and it had a rolling motion that made me feel almost sea-sick. The foam mattress compresses under the heavy parts of the body without disturbing the rest of the mattress.     In the reviews some people aid they felt that the foam made them too hot, and others said it was okay. The Sure Temp technology is supposed to be better than the first generation of memory foam mattresses. Having never had a Tempurpedic, I can't say whether the Sleep Innovations is cooler, but I found it to be comfortable. There was a little warmth, but with my fibromyalgia, that is a cozy feeling ... when I was sleeping in the recliner I used a thick sheepskin-like pad in both summer and winter.     Due to my injuries I have been unable to tolerate any pressure whatsoever on the outside of my shoulders, so lying on my side has been out of the question. With the Sleep Innovations I can still only tolerate a minute or two on my side at the most, but I have noticed that when I do try lying on my side there is far less hip discomfort.     I expected that if I were able to tolerate lying down on the Sleep Innovations mattress it would be only for a few minutes at a time and I would have to gradually build up. To my amazement, I was able to sleep undisturbed for 3 hours the very first night. This may not sound like much to you, but for someone who has had to sleep propped up in a recliner for nearly 7 years, it was like a miracle.    I have experimented with using different pillows under my knees -- my hip flexors are very tight after being in the V-position of a recliner for so long. After a few days I was able to sleep all night in a real bed! I am still in chronic pain and wake during the night, but I can see so much improvement after only a couple of weeks. One big thing is that I am now breathing better -- I had not realized how much the recliner was compressing my diaphragm. It is amazing to be able to lie down peacefully and take really deep breaths. I can also feel that my neck is being gently nudged in the right position --- the contour pillow cradles my neck in somewhat the same way my traction device does, but gently, without the rigid, ungiving sensation. My chiropractor, acupuncturist, and massage therapist are all very happy. I told my chiropractor that I finally feel as I am working with him to improve my alignment, instead of against him by hunching up in the recliner.    This review may not be relevant to those of you with normal necks and backs and good health, but I hope some other accident victims and fibromyalgia sufferers will find this to be helpful. As others have commented, a foam mattress is not for everyone -- my husband prefers a firm innerspring mattress.    But for this \\"princess\\" who cannot tolerate even the pressure of a \\"pea,\\" this mattress has been a real blessing! As I lie in bed at night saying my prayers, I smile like a little child and say with delight and wonder, \\"Look, Lord! I am lying down in a real bed!\\"

product_title: WE Furniture Home Office Deluxe Wood Storage Computer Desk - black
review_body: I am not sure what the last reviewer was talking about.  Yes, this did take time to assemble, but that is what i expected with this price and convenience of online.  This desk is finished nicely and should last a long time.  i am happy with this purchase and would recommend this item to others.

product_title: Herman Miller Classic Aeron Task Chair: Tilt Limiter w/Seat Angle Adj - Lumbar Pad - Fully Adj Vinyl Arms - Standard Carpet Casters
review_body:
I was hesitant to purchase a nearly $1,000 chair online without the opportunity to test it first. And the Herman Miller Aeron chairs I sat in at client sites never blew me away. They always felt to small. After doing some research I discovered that Herman Miller makes three different sizes of chair A=small, B=intermediate, and C=Large. So based upon all the positive buzz around this chair, and advice provided by my chiropractor, I took a chance and bought the biggest size (C) - I am 6'1\\" and 210. I made a good decision.

It is not the type of chair that you sit in and go aaahh. Not plushy, and soft, and oversized. But after sitting in it for 2-3 days, up to 8-10 hours a day, I noticed that my back was not stiff, my legs not stiff and crampy. I also purchased the aftermarket headrest on Amazon (not a Herman Miller product, but still great quality) and that made the chair even better. It is incredibly comfortable and highly adjustable (spend the extra dollars and purchase the fully loaded Aeron chair so you get all the adjustment options). I saved big by purchasing the chair on Amazon as compared to other retailers who charge up to twice as much. Plus you get the full 12 year warranty from Herman Miller. I found it about $100 cheaper from an online retailer, but it only had a 30 day warranty.

I have been seeing a chiropractor for the last 10 years to straighten me out from nearly 20 years of spinal abuse from playing football and rugby. This chair has absolutely helped in this regard. He noticed that I have been holding my adjustments better, and we both attribute it to the herman Miller Aeron chair.

product_title: Boss Executive Leather Budget Chair
review_body: This chair is easy to assemble, I did it myself and I am definitely challenged when it comes to putting things together.  It is pretty good quality for the great price.  It is very comfortable and looks great too.

product_title: Autumn Walk WoodWick Dancing Glass Scented Candle
review_body: I bought this candle last year at Cracker Barrell, and Pretty much burnt the whole thing last fall. I loved it so much, that I was hoping to get a new one this year. However, was upset to find out woodwick does not carry this smell anymore. Hoping to see them bring this one back. So enjoyable.

product_title: South Shore Axess 4-Shelf Bookcase, Soft Gray
review_body: this bookcase was great and more than I had expected! It is sturdy and looks great in my daughters room. For the price a great purchase.

product_title: DynastyMattress 8-INCH Thick Wood Box Foundation for memory foam, latex, and air mattresses
review_body: I have only owned this box frame for a month,but so far I have no regrets. Assembly was easy and it arrived quickly.

product_title: Ukid Lindsey Round Wood Table and Chair Set, Soft Pink
review_body: Very well built, easy to assemble and a nice light shade of pink.  My daughter loves it and the finish is durable.

product_title: Winsome Wood Foldable 4-Tier Shelf, Natural
review_headline: Perfect solution to your space problem
review_body: I am a bookworm and love my collection of books. But my home has shortage of space and hence I find it difficult to properly arrange and maintain my books and magazines. Then I explored online and read about Winsome Wood Foldable 4-Tier Shelf. I opted for it and yes can say, it has proved to be very helpful and economical solution for my storage problem. It is very compact and attractive looking too.

product_title: Coaster Lakewood Indoor Rocking Chair
review_body:
The pros of this chair:
1. The look of the chair is nice
2. The chair is easy to rock.
3. The chair is comfortable to sit in

Cons of the chair (and why it is ranked so low)
1. The stiching of the chair is poor quality and pulled away within a month of use (and pulled away in parts that are not direct contact like the back of the chair).
2. The pre assembled parts of the chair are nit well built and broke within the first five uses. These are not parts that you assemble before use, so they are not parts you can correct or tighten.
3. Because the pre made parts are poorly designed, extra stress has been put on the remainder of the chair you assemble.

The bottom line is that you should save your money and purchase something else. The chair creaks and the parts are pulling apart and this is all a poor engineering design. The inability of the preassembled parts to stay assembled and the poor quality of stiching will simply make you unhappy that you made this purchase. If you plan on using this even moderatly we only purchased to rock a baby) it will disappoint.

product_title: 4 Black Metal Finish & Oak Finish Wood Side Dining Chairs
review_body: i did not buy these as I found a set for 90 dollars close to home. So this is not one that should be in my review pile, but thanks in any case. I am sure that that they would have been fabulous chairs if I did.

product_title: Inflatable Bubble Ottoman - Garden Green
review_body: I chose this Bubble Inflatable because it was priced right, the color was right and it goes on a newly enclosed porch with some other fun furniture. It was exactly as I expected. Heavy vinyl like a pool float. It took a lot of air to inflate so I used an air compressor to partially inflate it and blew it tight by mouth. Perfect for kids and small adults. It does have a weight limit but, it will primarily be used as an ottoman for a Rockasan chair. Love it.

product_title: Broyhill Furniture Junctions Storage Coffee Table
review_body: Knowing the name Broyhill, I assumed that this would be a quality piece. When the shipment arrived I was surprised at what I found. The construction seemed to be almost entirley of oak and the base seemed to be solidly made. However, the top, which was oak, had completely separated from the base during shipping. Being fairly handy I had hoped to find that the top had just slipped out of track. Not so. All of the screws that attached the 2 piece oak top to the tracks, had completely pulled/stripped out. Not one remained. So, this piece must have a basic design flaw that will not allow for much pressure on the sliding top panels. I had to return the table in 3 pieces, which is the way it arrved.

product_title: Furinno 99736DBR Basic 3-Tier Bookcase Storage Shelves, Dark Brown
review_body: Oh Bookshelf, you didn't build yourself. You just didn't, did you, Mr. Bookshelf?  Now you're holdin information for other people to look at.  You're like a shelf of data!  And you know somebody musta, you know, put the shelves and the back and stuff on you before you became what you were.  And you don't know who that was & that makes you sentimental over the holidays. Mr. Existential Bookshelf, bless your heart.  I didn't do it.  Nobody knows who built you Mr. Bookshelf.  Oh snaps.

product_title: Twin Mission Captains Espresso Trundle Bed
review_body: I purchased this bed for my spare bedroom and to duplicate the sleeping capacity , it arrived on time and in perfect condition , quality is excellent , easy to put together the color is very much like the picture shows.. very comfortable there was only one thing it was not very good , the knobs on the drawers they are not very good. they came off first time I tried to open the drawer so I had to glue it in order to make sure they would  not going to come off  again , other than that , was very good I would recommend this item and the prices is very convenient as well

product_title: Black Metal Kitchen Rack with Wine Storage
review_body: Great addition to our kitchen. Moderately easy to assemble, stylish and sturdy for the price. The shipped product a little heavy/bulky for one person, so have a helping hand available. Took about a half-hour to set out the parts and assemble. Love the way it compliments our kitchen and provides a decorative means to store our wine and wine glasses.

product_title: Sleep Better 2-Inch Extra Firm Mattress Topper
review_body: I bought this twin foam topper for my Labradors beds. He has two. I cut it to size and worked out perfect. Wonderful for his beds and saved money. Buying an foam/orthopedic dog bed is expensive. This is a great alternative. I recommend!

product_title: Leggett & Platt Consumer Products Group Adjustable Bed Edge with 9 Rug Rollers and Brake Locks Frame
review_body: This bed frame did not even last 6 months (used by 1 medium sized person).  A key welding point broke and as a result all of the legs on one side collapsed.  Manufacturer will not permit returns/refunds after 30 days. Do not waste your money on this item!!

product_title: Flash Furniture Mid-Back Leather Swivel Task Chair
review_body:
I've owned a very basic cloth static position office chair for years, I finally decided I'd upgrade. I settled on the Eco friendly black leather chair from Amazon.

First off assembly is very simple with no tools required (an Allen wrench for tightening the screws is included) I assembled the chair in less than 10 minutes, with no need for directions...very straightforward.

The look of the chair is awesome, very plush feeling and the leather is a nice matte finish...not that shiny plastic leather look. The comfort level is also very high, with lots of cushion both on the seat of the chair and back. I noticed you don't \\"stick\\" to the seat like other leather chairs I demoed at big box stores.

After purchasing this chair I almost feel spoiled, the height and rocker motion are excellent when your at a desk for long periods of time, coming from a standard low back office chair to this was more than worth the 80 dollars spent.

If your looking for a great value, pick up this chair its sure to dress up any office, home or away!

product_title: Lorell Executive High-Back Chair, Mesh Fabric, 28-1/2"x28-1/2"x45, BK
review_body:
I work in an office environment so I am use to some fairly good office chairs from Steel Case (Leap Chairs) so I didn't expect anything like that, but I did expect something better than what I could get at a office store.

One of my main requirements is that the chair either did not have arms or had arms that could be detached. This chair has simple screw on adjustable arms which made me happy.

The chair has three adjustments: height, back support tilt, seat tilt. I found the back support and seat tilt kind of funky (seat tilt isn't too smooth of an adjustment and you will need to re-adjust the back tilt).

The chair has a smell which reminds me of my Tempurpedic mattress when I first got it. The smell in my Tempurpedic went away after a few weeks, so I'm waiting for a few weeks but I can see how some people can be turned off by this.

product_title: Coaster Home Furnishings  Gabriel Modern Window Back Counter Height Bar Stool ( Set of 2 ) - Cappuccino / Tan Microfiber
review_body: I ordered four of these chairs and they came with a few very small dings in them. you can't really tell when they are at the table any way. And now that we have had them for some time now they more than likely have a few more dings. They are very good quality and still very stable. Highly recommend.

product_title: Bench Faux-Leather Storage Ottoman, Black
review_body: decent buy but i wish i would of seen dimensions first. its pretty small. roughly 31\\" x 16\\" x 16\\". and the sidewalls are made of condensed particle board. i could be greedy, but quality and size don't match the price in my eyes.

product_title: Sleep Innovations 10-Inch SureTemp Memory Foam Mattress With 20-Year Warranty
review_body:
I have had insomnia for years and years. It was worse when I started sharing a bed with someone. We both twitch in our sleep and wake eachother up. Sometimes we would struggle through our day with 3 hours of sleep.
So I decided enough was enough, and memory foam would be worth a shot. We aren't rich, so I wasn't about to spend over 1500 for a mattress.
I fell asleep within the first few moments I got into this bed. I woke up feeling RESTED. I can actually have deep sleep now. I don't feel it when my boyfriend gets up or twitches. He says he can't feel me either.
Aside from not feeling much movement, it's damned comfortable. I'm partial to softer mattresses, and was afraid that it would be too firm for me after all. Somehow, the firmness is really quite relaxing. Although its firm, it moulds to my body. My limbs no longer fall asleep and no matter how I lay, I can fall asleep. I am so shocked that I actually got this for under 400 bucks. I am extremely happy with this bed.

product_title: Safco Products 5335BL Scoot Double-Sided Book Cart
review_body:
After reading all the previous reviews, I ended up buying this book cart because the price beat everything else on Amazon. I still don't regret it exactly, but I think there's a couple things to clarify:
1. Assembling the book cart is a somewhat involved process, but certainly not as bad as the other reviews make it out to be. It took me and a friend less than 20min with an electric drill to screw in all the parts. The thin metal shelves are very easy to damage and the corners can get bent out of shape if you're not careful, but if you're at least somewhat capable working with power tools, it's not a tough project (btw, if it takes your handyman 1.5 hrs to put it together, then I think you got fleeced, just sayin).
2. Where this Safco book cart disappoints (and the reason I only give it 2 stars), is that the design is very flawed. 'Samuel K. Jones' hit it right on the spot in his review: this cart is NOT capable of holding 6 shelves full of books. The silver end bars are sturdy enough, but the only thing connecting them together are the flimsy thin black shelves, which bend and flex like crazy. I only put 3 shelves worth of books on it, and every time I push the cart the whole thing angles forward. On turns, it does the same thing. I don't expect this product to hold up if used often. All it would've taken to make this cart amazing is to have included in the design a crossbeam of some sort to firmly secure the two ends together, instead of relying on the weak shelves. Every time I use it, it feels like i'm pushing a cart made out of recycled aluminum pop cans and not steel, that's how weak the support is.
That all being said, the cart looks nice and if you don't plan on moving it much, then go ahead and get it! But if you plan on loading it up and rolling it, better look elsewhere.

product_title: Sleep Innovations Shiloh Memory Foam Mattress
review_headline: Not as great as everyone says...
review_body:
After sleeping on a spring mattress for 24 years I decided to make the switch to memory foam. As most people would be, I was a bit unsure about buying a mattress online as there was no way to lay on it, roll around on it or just test it out in general (especially a bed that comes in a BOX!). However, the price was great and so were the reviews so I figured I'd give it a try.

Let me start off by saying that I tried other memory foam beds in stores. The tempurpedic cloud was absolutely mind-blowingly comfortable, but with a $6,000 price tag there was no way to justify that. I tried out the bob-o-pedic \\"firm\\" memory foam bed and loved that one as well. That mattress was around $1,200 but extra for delivery and every little thing, so again, I decided against that.

After all the positives with the memory foam beds in stores, I decided to give this one a go. The mattress arrived a couple of days later in a box about the size of a mini fridge, maybe a little bigger. Queen size weighed around 100 pounds and I managed to lug it up 26 stairs (I'm a 25 year old female, weighing 140 pounds so if I can do it, you can too!). Getting it out of the box was not a problem and allowing it to expand didn't take all that long either (so far, so good!). I decided to sleep on it that same night.

The second I laid down, I couldn't believe how HARD the mattress was. I mean HARD (not \\"firm\\" as they tell you). Think of laying on a carpet with no padding and that's the sort of hard I'm talking about. I would throw my phone onto the bed and it would literally thump. Needless to say my first nights sleep was really uncomfortable.

A month later the mattress has basically stayed the same. It has softened a bit, but not enough to make a huge difference. Please believe the reviewers that say this mattress is hard--I overlooked those reviews due to the overwhelming positive ones, but it really is unbelievable. I have never felt a mattress this hard before, even months after breaking it in.

With that being said, I decided not to send the mattress back. My first reason for keeping the mattress was because it would be nearly impossible to send back. There is no way of getting it back into the original box and with the mattress being a queen sized and around 90 pounds, it would probably have cost as much to ship back as it was to just buy the mattress outright. So how did I fix the problem you may be wondering?! Memory foam mattress toppers from Target! I bought a 1.5 inch memory foam topper that was on sale for $40. This memory foam was so soft and inviting and definitely helped the bed tremendously. This is on top of the egg crate I had bought first, which made no impact on the \\"hardness\\" of the mattress. Then I thought I would like it even a little more soft, so I bought ANOTHER 1.5 inch topper from Target, again (the same topper as the first). So now that I have 3 more inches of soft memory foam, and an egg crate, my mattress has FINALLY reached perfection. I sleep better than ever.

Suggestion: If you decide to buy this mattress anyway, save yourself some money and buy the 10-inch mattress. Buying the 10 inch allows you to add extra toppers and still have the deep sheets fit. My sheets fit up to 18-inch deep mattresses and with the 12 inch mattress and extra 6 inches of toppers, my sheets just barely fit!

Really think long and hard before you buy this mattress!

product_title: Skyline Furniture Surrey Headboard
review_body: I absolutely LOVE this headboard. I got it in black and it's even more beautiful than I thought. It really makes my whole room. Setting it up was fairly easy. But it's only an inch or 2 and you can't see t because of my pillows anyway. Other than that I have no complaints. product_title: KidKraft My Sweet Vanity
review_body: My daughter is 5 and I wanted something for her to be able to 'work' in her room.  She loves to play that she has homework besides all the drawing she does.  I searched a lot of vanities and finally decided on this one.  It was a little smaller than I had visualized but it's just about the perfect size for her.  The quality is excellent. The vanity is very sturdy and my daughter LOVES the 'tuffet' - the stool.  It's poofy and it's all girly enough for her. product_title: Elegant Home Fashions Dawson Collection Shelved Wall Cabinet, White
review_body: This cabinet is very nice.  My only concern is that it is quite heavy and I don't know if the screws/anchors provided are really adequate to hold the weight.

product_title: Sleep Innovations 10-Inch SureTemp Memory Foam Mattress With 20-Year Warranty
review_headline: great purchase, but has mild smell
review_body: Firstly, I had a cheap $150 spring mattress and I was sick of it. I didnt want to spend $2000 on a tempurpedic (I wanted a major upgrade :), so I read the reviews for this one and decided to buy it. Shipping delivery etc were great! The mattress expanded right away and we could lie on it. Felt perfect. It has some smell and so while my husband and I slept on it, we left our baby to sleep in a different room. You read things about how hydrocarbons are released from memory foam off gassing process and I was concerned about exposing my 4 month old to chemical fumes. We let it air out for 5 days and still there was a persistent odor. I would not be worried if i didnt have a baby. Even after 2 weeks I can still smell the stuff, but very faintly. I have moved it to our bedroom with our baby. Hopefully it is not toxic! Oh, but it feel heavenly to sleep on it!

product_title: Ikea Poang Chair Armchair and Footstool Set with Covers (Machine Washable)
review_body: I bought this for my daughter's nursery.  Its perfect for nursing her at night.  The right height to get in and out of and fits with a Boppy perfectly.  She prefers the light bouncing motion to rocking.  The footstool is a little large, but comfortable.

product_title: 30mm blue turquoise chip bead necklace 18"
review_body: This is an understated, statement necklace (oxymoronic, but true). It is simple yet has such a great effect once it's on. I was expecting a chunkier feel, more like a cluster of turquoise; instead its more like three rows of turquoise but it works really well. I lays perfectly on my neckline. product_title: Bean Bag Chair - Matte Black
review_body: I read the reviews for this product and they seemed good, so I ordered this as a Christmas gift for my grandchild. When I took it out of the shipping box to wrap it in a giant gift bag, I noticed the warning label on the bottom of the bean bag chair. It's one of those tags like the ones on mattresses or pillows, so I almost didn't read it, but I'm glad I did! Here is what it said: \\"WARNING - This product contains a chemical known to the state of California to cause cancer or birth defects or other reproductive harm.\\" Wow! product_title: Sleep Innovations Shiloh Memory Foam Mattress
review_body: LOVE IT ITS SUPER COMFORTABLE AND DOESNT SMELL LIKE THEY SAY IT DOES. IT IS DEFINELTY WORTH THE PRICE. It filled out almost immediately and i could move it all by myself.

product_title: SEI Ultra Espresso Media Stand
review_body: This thing was exactly what I was looking for! It looks beautiful when all put together. I was really impressed with it when I finished. The really like the color and the finish seems to be pretty good quality on the parts facing outwards towards you. The color looks like it does in the picture, that is assuming your monitor is calibrated correctly. It isn't made of solid wood but its does seem to be a higher quality denser veneer wood (comparing to Ikea stuff and some other furniture from Amazon). You can also choose how the top shelf sits on the bottom one. It doesn't actually connect to the bottom piece, it just rests on it. I didn't realize that but it works great so you can adjust the size of it and look of it.    But... there were some quality issues I experienced. Maybe you will get luckier than me. Out of the box, some of the pieces were very scratched up. Luckily, almost all of the scratches were on the backside or underneath! I don't know if they planned that during shipping and made the sides facing outwards more protected in packing or not. But still there was some damage visible when put together but not much.    Well other quality issues. I had a lot of trouble putting this thing together! I got pretty frustrated. I've put together several furniture items that I have bought from Amazon and Ikea. This was my worst experience by far. So here:    1) A screw was deformed so I didn't have enough. Easy fix though, I have plenty of screws hanging around. Just annoying because I ran into other problems.  2) The holes the screws go into were really really hard to align. 2 of 3 would go in fine and the last was way off. I really had to play/force with the wood and screw alignment to get them in. Happened on several occasions but it worked out.  3) The circular that you turn with a screwdriver to connect pieces together (the thing where the cylinder slides into and you tighten it by twisting it) didn't fit in the wood correctly on almost all of the holes! They went in too far because the holes were drilled too deep so if you push them in all the way wedge them out a big with your screwdriver. Took me awhile to figure it out and kept trying to force things in.  4) Plus the damages I mentioned before completes this list.  5) Also a tip, slide the backing pieces for the bottom shelf in first before you tighten anything otherwise they don't align and you cant get them in and have to take it apart.    Overall, I am satisfied with it cause it looks great. I am happy with the price for the quality but I just wish those scratches weren't there. It should get 5 stars otherwise.

product_title: Baywood Microwave Cart
review_body: Easy to put together, and is a nice solid little cart, and it fits perfectly in the space that I wanted it. Great buy, I use it every day!

review_headline: Comfortable, good quality chair, but with minor annoyance...

product_title: Venture Horizon Top Load Media Cabinet
review_headline: Not all DVDs are created equal
review_body:
I bought this product from a company called Spin Keeper. I was really excited about moving my collection off of a bookshelf and into a nice, compact cabinet, safe from collecting dust from behind wooden doors.

Assembly was mostly easy, but very time consuming. For me, it took over nine hours working by myself. I ran into several hurdles. First of all, whoever counted parts for my cabinet was drunk. There are two magnets that each have two screws holding them to the cabinet and four smaller screws to hold a metal plate to each door, but I only had three screws for the magnets and five small screws for the plates. Luckily, I had a similar screw lying around that I could use.

The instructions state that there are 40 nails, but the illustration in the instructions clearly show 48 nails being used, so if you follow the diagram exactly, you will come up short. The drunk gave me 43 nails, so I was able to slightly improvise.

At one point, the instructions tell you to use the SF612BL screws, but there are no such screws in the parts manifest. This is a minor complaint, since the screws you are actually supposed to use (SP816BL in the manifest) are bundled with the plates they screw down in a plastic bag.

The nut that is supposed to hold the lock in place can easily slip into a crooked position and become hard to tighten. In fact, it's easier to put it on crooked than it is to put it on straight. I tried to tighten the nut with my wrench, but it just turned the lock with it, sanding the hole down larger than it's supposed to be.

The most frustrating part of the construction for me was one of the shelves, which would drop all of my DVDs and tip over whenever I put enough on top of it. I had to wedge pieces of cardboard into the interlocking sections for the shelf to stay level.

After assembling the unit, I took a moment to admire the finished product. Despite being made out of mostly composite woodand a few plastic pieces, it is quite an attractive looking cabinet. But my problems were far from over.

The worst thing about this unit, the deal-breaker, is that there is clearly not enough depth to completely fill it with DVDs of variable width. See the photos I uploaded illustrating this point.

If all you have are standard-sized plastic DVD clamshells, then you should have no problems. If you're like me, like most people, your collection will have various kinds of DVD cases. Let's do some math. From the rear of the cabinet to the door, it measures almost 11¼\\". A standard clamshell DVD case measures just over 5¼\\" in width. Side by side, there is still about three quarters of an inch of space between. My box sets of Buffy The Vampire Slayer measure 5 5/8\\". The widest box sets in my collection (James Bond movie set and Band of Brothers) measure 5 7/8\\". Any combination of these slightly wider sets will either cause you to press your hand against the door for it to shut against the magnet or prevent the doors from closing entirely. You could organize your collection in an odd order that prevents the wider sets from facing each other from the door shelves, but that's a game of Tetris no one wants to play.

This would be a beautiful storage cabinet if all you wanted to store was DVDs, CDs, blu-rays, VHS tapes or games for Wii, Xbox 360 or PS3, all in standard-sized cases, but one size most definitely does not fit all. If only it had one extra inch of depth.

Flying DeLorean
+Very attractive looking design
+Top locking cabinet is handy for light security purposes
+No problems if you only have standard-sized cases

Bluth Staircar
-Not enough depth to hold slightly wider DVDs
-Cheap composite wood with easily chipping laminate; poorly cut shelf pieces
-Instructions aren't very good; likely to have the wrong amount of parts

review_body: Arrived on time and was easy to put together.  We were pleased with service and quality of product as described.

product_title: Light Purple Tart Warmer + Nightlight
review_body: This product is just what i wanted and it came so fast too. Very nice color and works well. Matches any room cuz it comes in many different colors.

product_title: Rug Carpet Stair Treads Set Of 12
review_body: This product was a good purchase for us. We ripped out our carpet in the living room and on the stairs. product_title: Quality Importers Sao Paolo 50 Cigar Humidor, Mahogany Finish
review_headline: Relatively cheap price for a really nice humidor
review_body: I have just started my cigar collection. At first, I thought a small humidor(<20) would be just fine for me because I don't know how many cigar I will get. So, I bought a $20 travel humidor. After trying all sorts of technique to get the humidity right, I finally give up. I found it is not because of the humidifier(it turns out the humidifier that comes with the $20 cheap humidor doesn't seem to absorb water while I dip it in water.) The problem is that the cheap humidor can't seal the air properly. That is why I bought this Sao Paolo humidor. BTW, now i see a larger humidor is always better. This humidor seal very nicely and when you close it, you can hear the wind blowing out of the humidor which is a sign of good humidor. If you just started your collection, I highly recommend this humidor. The only cons that I found is that the inlay is a bit short. It doesn't stay in position while you move the humidor around. I don't know if they intentionally did this way or it is a defect. Anyway, that is not a big issue at all. I love this humidor.

product_title: APPLE 6 Glass Glasses & Pitcher Set *NEW!!*

product_title: Black Framed Set of Cupcakes Sweets Cakes Art Print Poster
review_body: These are so cute and very good quality, especially for the price. They look great in my kitchen and really brightened it up. They were packed very well and arrived in perfect condition.

product_title: DynastyMattress Luxury 12-Inch w/5 Memory Foam Mattress
review_body: I purchased this mattress from Dynasty about five years ago and hadn't bothered to write a review until now. While shopping for this product my biggest question was durability and long-term comfort/performance.  The comfort of this bed is readily apparent after the first night, and as for the long-term performance, all I can say is, \\"Wow!\\"  After around 1,800 nights on the mattress I notice absolutely NO DEGRADATION in comfort or any kind of \\"pitting\\". This thing is as comfortable now, perhaps more so as my body knows what to expect, than the first night.  Of course over the past 5 years I have noticed one problem... It makes sleeping on any other mattress almost an exercise in futility! How is it possible that I can be go to bed in a Carribean resort and wish I was home?! This mattress!   Don't let the budget price deter you from grabbing this mattress, it is easily the best I have slept upon, ever.

product_title: Brushed Maple Computer Desk
review_body: This desk arrived quickly, the box was very heavy and my husband doesn't like putting things together so I had to do it myself.  I've been searching for a desk for a while but haven't been able to find anything that matches my style.  Most of the desks I really liked were over $1,000 and the cheaper ones were ugly looking. I love how modern this desk looks and how practical it is.  This desk is stylish but extremely affordable.  I was concerned that the price would mean that the product would be flimsy but it is not. It did take about 3 hours to assemble by myself.  I think if my husband could've helped me, it would've taken half the time.  The instructions that came with the product were awesome.  I hate when the instructions are just pictures with no explanation.  These instructions actually had video online you could watch, though I didn't use that feature.  The one thing I love about this desk is it's color and the straight lines lines.  I struggled with some parts of the assembly like getting the drawers on straight so they lined up together.  I had to redo that a few times.  The instructions said not to use an electrical drill but I did anyway and I think it was fine.  The desk looks much smaller in the picture and it was larger than expected.  The top has a lot of room and now our printer is on the desk, when before we had to put it on a small table beside our other desk. This is the best desk! Buy it but set aside a lot of time to put it together and really follow the instructions carefully.

product_title: BCW Vinyl 20 Pocket Pages With Thumb Cut 10 Ct. Pack
review_body:
I finally decided to organize my coin collection; they were in a ziploc bag for the last 10 years, stupid..

This thing is vinyl plastic so it's very tough and won't tear. 10 pages x 20 pockets each page = 200 coins. They're not double-sided so you can see both the front and back of the coin. Anyway, basically you put the coin into a holder.

Here's what I got, it holds all sizes of the holders since they're all 2 x 2, the only difference between them is the size of the clear plastic hole;
[ 100 2x2 Cardboard Coin Holders HALF DOLLARS ] This size is ideal for all other coin sizes, from medium to tiny.
use the LARGE DOLLARS option for the biggest coins you have

You put the coin onto one of the clear circles and fold the cardboard thing over it into a square, then you can staple it on the open end to secure it better. Simple, fast, easy. You need as many coin holders as you have coins. There's clear plastic there, it's not just a hole.

Once you have all the coins inside the holders just put them into these pocket pages and put it all into a binder you can buy at Staples for $5

product_title: Loft Portable Fireplace
review_headline: For condo owners, it's the cherry on top!
review_body: [[VIDEOID:mo2QVWDTXKOCZ7Z]]\\"WOW!\\"  That's the first word my guests ever utter the moment they walk in the door and see this gorgeous fireplace lit afire.  It literally just warms the place with a glow physically and aesthetically.  This is the perfect centerpiece for those that do not have a traditional fireplace as part of their home. product_title: Canwood Alpine II Twin Bed
review_headline: Good Value, Extra Work Makes it Perfect
review_body:
This is a good value product which can be made even better if the buyer does some extra work. Having read mixed Reviews, I called an old Canwood customer service number and was told that another Canadian company, Storkcraft, had acquired their furniture line and relocated manufacturing. That information made me more comfortable that the quality of the bed should be suitable for my 5-year old grand-daughter because her Storkcraft crib/ youth bed had proven to be an excellent product.
The Pros: Unbelievably quick shipment; The bed is all kiln-dried pine (no MDF); Engineering and parts fit are excellent.
The Surprises: This product was manufactured in Viet Nam, not Canada, and the quality of finish was inferior to our previous Storkcraft white furniture. One box (rails and slats) had a build-date of Aug.2011, and the second box (headboard and footboard) had a build-date of Oct.2011, but paint match was close; None of the wood was primed and only one coat of white paint had been sprayed, so knotholes in the pine had already seeped a yellow color through the finish; This \\"twin bed\\" is made for a bunk application, and Storkcraft doesn't supply any plugs for the holes not used in a single twin-bed application. (Storkcraft customer service did send me a touch-up kit consisting of a wax crayon to fill scratches and a white felt marker.) The Instruction drawing of the bed slats is incorrect, or the plant decided to staple the straps on the opposite side the day they made these parts- hint: counter-sinked holes should be up.
The Easy Fix to Make The Bed Perfect: Sherwin Williams or Home Depot did not have a match for the color. Lowe's has all necessary materials: Valspar #85001 Satin White, wood dowels, Elmer's Carpenters Wood Glue, Elmer's Probond Wood Filler (white), 220-grit sandpaper and Crown Next Paint Thinner.
Hint: Assemble headboard and footboard and determine which holes you will not use when rails are attached. I filled all unused (20) holes, soI needed three different diameter dowels (measure the holes you want to fill with a drill bit). Glue the cut dowels to about 1/16\\" below surface, apply filler (over dowels and deep scratches), sand the filler and any areas where pineknots have seeped, wipe all wood with paint thinner to remove dust, then spray paint. If you want to spray two light coats on headboard, footboard, rails, you'll need about three 12-oz. cans of paint...and you will also have resolved a common complaint in the Reviews- painted the unsightly, unfinished screw heads.

So rather than buy a mount for the Kinect which would give the sensor somewhere to sit, but would not solve the problem of \\"do we move the sofa, the tv or get a new apartment?\\" I bought this on Amazon.     It was super easy and fast to put together (5-10 minutes). It was also a little deeper than I thought it would be so it fits our 32 inch flat screen nicely and the the kinect sensor wound up in front of the flat screen as there enough space. It elevated the screen about 10 inches and the Kinect sensor to a nice height. We use the bottom shelf for controllers, remotes, Netflix subscription dvds, etc.    The swivel aspect is fantastic. We can watch tv from 6 feet away and swivel the entire operation, without disturbing the Kinect, 90 degrees to the part of the room where there is enough space to play. Perfect solution, perfect product and it looks good, too.     Love this shelf!!

product_title: Baxton Studio Azzo Plastic Mid-Century Modern Shell Chair, Set of 2
review_body: Packaged very well and came very quickly (3 days free shipping). Assembly was straightforward. Took me longer because I decided to tighten all the bolts on the preassembled legs. Black rubber caps used to hide those bolts just barely hanging on now. Might glue them on if they fall off. 2 of my 4 chairs didn't sit evenly.
