product_title: A-Tower Corner Wood Computer Desk with Hutch in Pewter and Cherry Finish by Studio RTA
review_body: This desk is amazing!  I love it.  It's made very well and it's very nice looking.  I bought one for my basement office and loved it so much I ended up buying another one for my son's bedroom.  The cherry finish is a great color.  My husband put it together with no problems.  I would recommend this desk to anyone looking for a great desk at affordable price within a confined space.  It's worth the money.  I paid $115 per each desk I purchased both came with free shipping.  AND the packaging was very good also (i.e. the box didn't come all smashed etc.)

product_title: Poundex End Table With Storage Shelf in Two Tone Finish by Poundex
review_body: Received this very attractive table today---was just as nice as it appeared on Amazon site. Was VERY WELL PACKED AND PROTECTED.....It must have taken considerable time, effort, and materials to do. In fact, it took more time to unpack/unwrap than it did to assemble, which was easy. My wife and I both agree that such a table would fetch $250+ in a furniture store--was only $103 plus free shipping!  Happy all around.  :)

product_title: South Shore Axess Collection Desk
review_body: the desk is quite small and unstable. it was easy to assemble. pieces are cheap but it will do for the price.

product_title: koehler Home Bedroom Decor Pink Butterfly Mosquito Net Bed Canopy Polyester
review_body: I just received my purchase and I couldn't be any more excited. I bought this for my daughter's nursery because it is a butterfly theme and this canopy just goes PERFECTLY! =)

product_title: Lorell Executive High-Back Chair, Mesh Fabric, 28-1/2"x28-1/2"x45, BK
review_headline: Very good value for your money
review_body:
If you are looking for a good quality chair that doesn't break the bank, I highly recommend this product. I've used the Aeron by Herman Miller for 11 years (and still use) and it is the greatest chair in the market, but the price is high and most people will not want to for it. This chair is comparable. What I mean is that it has a similar construction, it is comfortable, and it gives you the support you need. Of course, the Aeron is top of the line, and this one is a budget chair.

If you can afford the $600-$800 of a Herman Miller, I definitely will buy it. Considering I have used it for 11 years, it is a great investment. However, if you are looking for something with quality at a lower prices that will leave you satisfied, this chair is probably the best you can find. My only complain are the arm rests, which they only give you three locking positions to lower or raise them. This is a bit unflexible to achieve a good ergonomic position, but it may work for you. Also, the arm rests are probably the cheapest part of the chair. It is kind of surprising that all pieces feel solid and are solid but the arm rests are kind of cheap and plastiky.

Overall, a great chair at a good price.

product_title: Coaster 300080 Flip-Top Vanity Set, Cappuccino
review_body: The item arrived on time but with broken parts. The process for ordering the replacement parts was relatively easy but when installing the replacement stool, I realized that the corner of the table was also damaged from poor packaging. One of the legs is really tight on the table causing you to really pull hard when opening the drawer.

product_title: Bruce Lee T-shirt Dragon Awaits Adult Black
review_headline: Bruce is always a Great Gift!
review_body: This was a gift for my husband, and he loves it!  He prefers to have the design on the front of the shirt, were he can see.  This definitely produced a lot of ahhs and oohs as he opened the box!

product_title: STRUCTURES by Malouf STEELOCK Super Duty Steel Wedge Lock Metal Bed Frame
review_body:
My husband and I purchased a new bed last year, upgrading from a full to a king size bed. The bed came with two small box springs (I believe they are twins?) so we had to use two twin size frames. Unfortunately, for whatever reason, one was slightly shorter than the other and it was causing the bed to slope.

My husband had been after me to get a new king size bed frame for a while but I kept putting it off because I didn't want to spend a lot of money on a flimsy frame. I came across this bed frame which looked much more sturdy that the average frames I've seen AND I got FREE shipping with my Amazon Prime. I paid the extra $4 for overnight shipping. I thought that was a great deal.

My husband put the bed frame together with no issues and it is SO sturdy! When one person moves on one side of the bed, the other person on the other side hardly notices and it isn't creaky like some other frames. I'm really glad I waited until I found this frame - we haven't had it long but it seems like it should last a while. I'd definitely recommend this frame to others looking for something that is sturdy but won't break the bank.

product_title: Leaders Executive Office Chair Fabric: Water Resistant Knit
review_body:
I gambled that this might work for me and it does. In my work I get to try all the high end ergonomic chairs at client sites, sometimes for days; nothing is as comfortable on my back as this. Almost everything's adjustable, and a really big plus is the tilt can be locked in any position. If you buy this you will want to try different settings, nearly everything is adjustable. Be sure to tighten the large hand nuts.

Three cautions. As another reviewer pointed out, the headrest seems farther back than optimum; I'd prefer that it be about 5\\" forward, but it's OK. The chair feels like it might tilt over backward if you lean back hard or fast all the way. And, as another reviewer also pointed out if you weigh over maybe 230 pounds the back may be too springy for you.

Well made, comfortable, very happy here.

product_title: Ashley Furniture Signature Design - Woodboro Lift Top Coffee Table with End Drawers - Rectangular - Dark Brown
review_body: Its solid, real wood.  Because of this, its as heavy as can be.  You'll need help getting it out of the box.  It also comes assembled.  Can't beat that.

product_title: 22 inch Anastasia Collection doll Celeste - Style 30675
review_body: Not as pretty as it looked in the picture. It was cheap though, so I didn't really expect a whole lot better. Something like this should really be bought at a retail store, that way you know for sure what you're getting. I mean, this is hardly worth sending back if you don't like it.

product_title: Designs2Go 2 Tier Swivel
review_body:
I am actually using this as a stand for a pretty large center channel speaker, out in front of my television. The most difficult thing about getting this product ready for use was opening the box! At first I tried opening the side flaps but the glue is so strong I gave up and just used a box cutter. Just be careful if you cut open the box so you don't damage anything inside.

The shelves and tubes are nicely protected inside. Mine had no marks at all. I didn't want the swivel feature and used narrow strips of Gorilla tape to prevent the swivel from operating. As a side note, that tape is really strong. The stand itself was very easy to assemble. The wood shelves are solid. The end caps are pretty cheap so remember to heed the instructions and don't overtighten. The poles are decent. While not the highest of quality, it looks nice and keeps the cost down, and it works perfectly fine within the limits specified by the manufacturer. It is sturdy and I think it's a great little stand. I'm happy with it.

product_title: Leather Shag Rug 3' Round Red Area Rug
review_body: I returned this rug because it was uncomfortable to even walk on in bare feet and it smelled strongly of leather.  It was not what I was looking for.

product_title: Contemporary Black Finish 5-Tier Ladder Book Shelf
review_body: The instructions were great and it has made a great addition to our living room. We put it together in less than 10-minutes and had it against the wall and screwed in for added security as we have a cat in our home. The shelves are solid and hold all of the books and a cat... when she decides to check it out. Good buy.

product_title: Fun Rugs Fun Time Solar System Rug
review_body: I purchased this for my sons room, they have a space theme and I loved the idea of an \\"educational\\" rug. The quality sucks! It is wicked thin, lighter than a bathroom or kitchen rug. There is no real bulk to it at all. Although it is good sized the quality is worse than something I would expect to get at IKEA. I saw it on another sight for $150, had I purchased it there I would definately have returned it. Its not worth $100! I don't expect that it will last very long.

product_title: Winsome Wood 4-Shelf Narrow Shelving Unit
review_body: overall very nice but when you slide the drawers out it scratches the wood pretty bad. Needs to include something to prevent that.

product_title: South Shore Furniture City Life Collection TV Stands
review_headline: Very good TV stand for the money
review_body: I had been looking for a TV stand for a 55\\" flat screen that I plan to purchase that was approximately 20\\" high which would give me direct sight of the set from my sofa.  I did not want to have to look up at a set.  This stand works out perfectly even if it is 22\\" high. On arrival, the box was a little banged up but the contents were in perfect condition even if it had to travel to Hawaii.  I had to pay for having it sent to me but it was well worth it. It took me about 3 hours to assemble it myself.  However, when I was finishing up and putting the shelves in, I found that I had the 2 side panels were reversed and I could not put in the shelf holders which were on the outside.  I wish the instructions were clearer about this.  It took me another 45 min. to switch the sides and in the process caused some damage as the whole thing collapsed! Fortunately the damage was minor could not be seen. But after assembling it, I think that the time I spent was well worth it.  Although it is made from inexpensive material, it really fits my decor.  I think I will be purchasing more \\"legs\\" as I think that the stand will outlast the plastic \\"legs\\".  I would recommend purchasing this if you are looking for a LOW TV stand, just read the instructions and look at the drawings very carefully!

product_title: Coaster Coffee Table with Storage Drawers, Rich Brown Finish
review_body: The original order we received was shipped UPS overnight.  The box looked okay (not damaged) when UPS delivered the item.  Upon opening the box the table top corner was smashed in.  I went on Amazon.com to report the problem and they shipped a new one overnight.  The original one had to be boxed up again - which was difficult to box up such a large item and UPS picked it up the very next day (no charge to me).  Upon receiving the replacement table, the top of the table looked great.  After flipping the table the support rail for one of the drawers was broken.  It appears it was manufactured poorly and I'm unsure how it passed the company's QC check.  I didn't want to hassle with the return of the item so I purchased a metal L-bracket from the hardware store to reattach the support rail back to the main frame of the table.  $5 fix which is not noticeable since it's beneath the table.  Table look great in the living room - much better that the IKEA coffee table I got 7 years ago.  So if you are thinking about purchasing this item, be warned that the quality isn't quite what you would expect for your money.

product_title: Night Therapy -12'' Therapeutic Pressure Relief Memory Foam Mattress - King - FREE SHIPPING To Contiguous 48 States!!!
review_headline: Great Buy!!!! Fibromyalgia is on the run!!!
review_body:
I have fibromyalgia & my old bed became like sleeping on a bed of nails. I needed some restful sleep or I was headed for insanity!!! I was a bit worried ordering this bed for 2 reasons... First, I wasn't able to lay on it before purchase. I was also worried because there was only one review for this item. I got it anyway because of the layer that claimes to reduce the odor as I am VERY sensitive to these particular smells. We opened up the mattress as instructed (easy!) and I couldn't detect an odor with my face smashed into it!!! It is firmer and more supportive than other memory foam beds I've tried. The first night on the bed I used 2 pillows as I always do & had a sore neck in the morning. The second night I went to one pillow & the next morning I woke so very rested & actually came down the stairs with NO hip pain!!! I was out of town for 5 nights and really noticed how much pressure a regular bed puts on my joints!!! I came home & slept on this bed again & now I never want to sleep away from it!!! I can't say enough WONDERFUL things about this bed!!! If it's one you are considering...buy it!!!! The cover is so nice & there is NO heating up through the night. Really, this bed exceeds all it's claims. I am eventually going to replace the guest room bed with one of these as well.
UPDATE...it's been about a month & a half now & everyone has commented on how rested I'm looking, I'm taking less medications & everyone who's laid on it now wants one!!!
UPDATE... here we are almost 3 years later...still LOVE this bed but have one thought that may help some of you... If (like my Husband and I) you are edge sleepers buy 2 twins!!!! The bed cradles you so well that just turning it leaves a bit of a bump in the middle after a few years. I have a friend in need of a bed and might give this one to her & her Husband because they like to sleep close to each other (she wants it ...he wants a standard bed in a Queen size). I can't tell you how happy I am with this bed!!! Maybe our German Shepherd will balance the TINY bump in the middle once he's full grown (currently 4 months old). If I give the bed away I will be buying 2 twins to replace it!!! Never sleeping on anything but this bed again EVER!!!

review_body: I'm fond of this table.  The tiles are larger than I had anticipated, which is a good thing.  The legs and edges of the table are nicely finished. review_body: Consle arrived in two days.It took the UPS driver and myself to get it inside.I opened immediately and it was in perfect shape,no damage.The only down side were the directions,they are from a forign country and are not very explicit.certain pcs of wood should only be installed a certain way but can be done in more than one which isnt obvious until its completely assembled,which culminated in disassembling glued parts and re-assembling,lucky I do this for a living and could repair.once done it looks great and has been admired by family who recently purchased similar proucts at 3 times the price.

product_title: Coaster Home Furnishings  Traditional Rectangular Tufted Upholstered Storage Ottoman - Dark Brown

product_title: TV Console With Doors And Drawers
review_body: We purchased this TV console SKU #181868. When it arrived the finish was terrible & not as the photo shown on their website. We emailed them digital photos to show the markings on both the doors. Also, the two drawers had charcoal-like stenciling but their was no color as shown in their web photo. Virgina tried to tell us that the marks on the door were woodgrain variation and they do not guarantee finishing in reference to the color on the drawers. The door markings were position in the corner area bottom-left and top right on left door and top left and bottom left on the right door. They were symmetrical and looked like something rubbed up against the doors before the stain dried removing some of the stain. Since when is wood variations exact like these in nature?? We were told that we would not be given a replacement--not even just the doors. They told us we could return it at our expense. We called several times asking for a boss or supervisor and they will not return our calls. We ended up taking the doors to a refinisher who did a great job and laughed at Virgina's comment about natural woodgrain variation. The flaws were manufacturer finishing flaws. BEWARE! They are not an honorable company and their only guarantee is that you can ship it back AT YOUR EXPENSE---Think very carefully before ordering--I would NOT recommend this company to anyone!!

product_title: South Shore Furniture City Life Collection TV Stands
review_headline: Nice TV stand with some issues
review_body: Overall, this is a good TV stand / entertainment center. It looks good and it's very functional. While it would be easier to assemble with 2 people, it is not at all necessary, as I did it by myself with out any problems. It is sturdy and well made with a good amount of room to hold most, if not all, the necessary electronics associated with an entertainment center.    The things I don't like about it is that it's a little short. With a TV on top, it's a little too low for me to watch while I'm laying in bed. Because of this, I will be wall mounting my TV so that it's higher up.    Also, it doesn't hold DVD's that well. There's really not a good place for them, especially if you have a big collection.    Other than those 2 issues, I highly recommend this item.

product_title: Set of Six Orange Tozai Vases
review_body: I saw these vases at a boutique store in a large city for $100 more than they were here.  Just because stuff is in a boutique store doesn't mean it won't be available on Amazon or someplace else on the Internet.  The scale is a little smaller than I thought and the color is more persimmon than orange but otherwise I am totally pleased to have found such a deal.

product_title: Design Ideas CD Tower Mesh Mediumium Silver

product_title: LCM Direct Power Charging Station
review_body: Pros:  - well placed outlets that allow you to plug in 4 large converter style plugs  - 2 additional USB Ports for things like blackberry's and iPods  - Did reduce clutter and made finding the right charger for a device easier, since it is always in the same place    Cons/concerns:  - There is no covered well to put all of the loose cords in, they just coil up behind the front panel  - All of the wires thread thru the side or top of the faceplate, while many devices charge from the bottom  - There are only 5 surfaces for placing devices, while there are six power ports, meaning the sixth device needs to lay down next to the LCM  - I am concerne with how long the 'stickiness' will last on the surface of the faceplate (the black areas in the image) to hold the charging devices in place    Overall, I've only had the device for a couple of days, so we'll see how it goes.

product_title: Sarah Peyton 10-Inch Memory Foam Firm Support Mattress with Contour Pillow
review_headline: If you have read a Negative ... you MUST READ THIS...
review_body: I read almost every review before buying this product.  I almost didn't buy it because of the NEGATIVE reviews.  When it arrived, I was shocked how squashed it was... which was to be expected, but as soon as it was placed on the bed and the vacuum seal was removed it inflated itself...  It takes 24 to 48 hours for the mattress to be ready for you... allow it that amount of time... it is worth the weight.  YES... the pillows are not as wide as a regular pillow, but I haven't moved off of one yet.  Bigger pillows would have been a waste to me.    My normal night's sleep is 3 to 4 hours and a wake-up, then toss turn, toss turn, maybe a nap in the next 2 to 3 hours that I lay there...  From my first night on the mattress...here is the HONEST routine:  Go to my room;  Turn on a movie (lately it has been x-files reruns on Netflix), Climb into bed, I am asleep before the credits run at the begining of the show... SLEEP straight no wake-ups for at least 8 to 9 hours unless my alarm goes off.  SUCCESS!!!  I have no complaints.    To the Negative posts who talk about the bed being lumpy, etc. ... and who talk about how they do everything right they EVEN TURN THE MATTRESS OVER every month...  BULL HOCKEY!  The Mattress is Memory foam on top of a base foam....  YOU NEVER FLIP this mattress.  There is even instructions with the mattress that tell you NEVER NEEDS FLIPPING...  I don't know what these people are sleeping on or what they are flipping but it is not this product.  And, if it is, then no wonder they have problems...duh.    WARNING!!!! -  This mattress is listed as FIRM, and make no mistake it is a FIRM mattress, but that is what I wanted and what I enjoy.    I am totally satisfied with this purchase.

product_title: Summer Island Gazebo Replacement Canopy
review_body: We shopped around for a Gazebo after our retractable awning went south. We wanted something with more coverage, so we compared different awnings/gazebo's of this type. After shopping various stores and looking at various styles, we choose this one. My husband and I assembled (mostly me, so a woman can do this)this in about two hours. The only confusing part was the part in the top, and that was because we didnt read the directions once we thought we knew what we were doing...We were so excited once we finished it, I went out an purchased hanging pots for the inside to make it homey...WE LOVE IT!!!...We had our morning coffee out here this morning and sat outside into the late evening...      The only reason I didnt give it 5 stars is due to the fact that the privacy/shade panels are IMPOSSIBLE to find...Other than that, spend the $200 and enjoy a cool shaded summer...We put ours on our patio and put decorative blocks on the four corners to weigh it down...

product_title: 7pc Cappuccino Finish w/Birch Veneers Dining Table & Chairs Set

product_title: Rita Folding Room Divider
review_headline: Looks great, easy-to-assemble, arrived in a compact package
review_body: I live in a small one bedroom apartment, so when a friend decided crash on the couch during a recent visit, I wanted to offer a bit of privacy for both of us by strategically positioning a room divider in the living room. I settled on this model because it looked good in the photos and it's lightweight, so shipping didn't cost a fortune.    When I first opened the box and saw the unassembled poles, brackets and fabric I thought, \\"what have I gotten myself into?\\" But after reading the simple instructions, I was able to put the entire screen together in about five minutes.    The design is clever and elegant. The chrome frame screws together easily and requires no tools or any great amount of mechanical talent (it was a thousand times easier than assembling a recently purchased Ikea dresser) The 'screens' are actually panels of fabric that secure to the top and bottom rails by looping around and fastening with a strong Velcro band. This holds the panels firm and taught.    It's stands stable (not at all wobbly) and extends fairly wide without feeling precarious.    All in all, a pleasant surprise. And since it was so easy to put together, I think I might even take it apart to store in the closet. Unassembled, the box is about the size of a folded two-person tent.     I enthusiastically recommend this product.

product_title: Deco Trundle Combo Upholstered Bed Package
review_body: My friends joked that they didn't want a guest room bed that was TOO comfortable else they'd have too many visitors, ha ha. But we have had this bed for four years and love it.  It is much fancier (and maybe more $$) than some others, but it is super comfy and does not at all feel cheap in any way.  My 70+ year-old inlaws sleep on it for a week and say it's super.      The other review that mentions the shorter side is indeed correct.  That hasn't been a problem since I think I checked it and the shorter one is still pretty much the length of a regular twin bed (I'm going off four year old memeory though).  Twin sheets fit on both beds perfectly fine.  And of course king sheets fit on it just fine.  We have used it mainly as a king bed, but twice used them as sep twins, both options worked perfectly.  The room we have the bed in is pretty small, so the shorter side actually helps us since that makes it easier to get around that side of the bed and out of the room at night, etc. for going to the restroom, etc.  The bent frame part we didn't experience, so I can't truly comment on that.    The only glitch I will say is that I could not find any existing daybed covers/sofa-looking covers for it anywhere.  Now, maybe they have them at this point on some sites, but the bed is too big for regular dust ruffles, or daybed covers from what I found.  My Mom ended up making me a whole cover and pillows for it while she was staying when Baby #2 was born in 06.  So it worked out fine, just want to mention that is def a cost factor if you don't want it to look like a bed the whole time.  We leave it all put together and looking like a sofa/daybed against the wall 90% of the time.      I was hesitant at first due to the price, but it has been well worth the money!  My Mom who is an Interior Designer just asked me for the bed info for one of her clients she likes it so much.  That's how I am now ending up putting up a review after four years.

AFTER the seat cushion is forced into place (we women are not as strong as men) you can then finish tightening the long nails.    PACKAGING:  I cannot say enough about the packaging- it was well thought out, every corner that could possible have scuff marks was generously protected with bubble wrap and some insulated tape too.  All in all, I highly recommend this chair.  So far Amazon is my favorite place to buy household items.  This is the second purchase, and I am so glad I have an ally I can trust- I can safely, and securely make purchases that are amazing in quality, price, and durability.  Can I get an Amen!

review_body: When I bought this chair I was excited, as I needed a new piece of furniture for my \\"man cave\\". I was looking for something soft, comfortable and wouldn't break the bank. I then found this \\"fuf\\" chair. at first glance it met all of my requirements. It looked soft enough. and it certainly looked comfy, and compared to some of the other stuff I looked at, for its size it certainly looked relatively inexpensive. When it got to the house in a very fast time, it looked as though the bands on the package were going to snap off and take an eye out. getting it out of the box was also a hassle. as it was so tightly packed, that I had to rip the box in order to get it out. So, there went the return policy. I had read previously on the internet that you had to assemble it, unzipping the liner, and then putting the foam in, so I was pleasantly surprised when I saw that it came pre-assembled. So size now not a problem I turned to smell, the smell was not as bad as other people said it would be, and thats already fading fast. onto comfort. It was comfy enough though it sometimes feeling a bit lumpy and you could easily fall asleep on it, which I already have numerous times. Finally softness. The twill is not very soft at all and it is a negative factor for the product as a whole. I would take the liner off and wash it as it says there is a double cover on it. but there is no handle on the zipper for the outer cover and I got no indication from anywhere on the cleaning instructions that there even is a second cover. Though i have found that you can wrap it in sheets to make a shell that is a bit more soft.           All in all this is a great item with only a few minor faults and        I would certainly recommend this to a friend.

product_title: Rogar Black Rectangular Pot Rack with Grid 30" x 15"
review_body: This pot rack was a perfect fit for a rather small kitchen.  It is solidly built at a fairly reasonable price, especially compared to other pot racks.  The simplicity of design was just what I was looking for; not only are other potracks sometimes excessively decked out in wrought iron, copper, etc., but this seems to be one of the few rectangular pot racks out there (or that I could find).  The chains may be a bit short for taller ceilings (brownstones, for instance).  A trip to the hardware store could easily fix that, though.  My ceilings are about 9 feet high, and I can comfortably maneuver pots on and off.    The only thing you have to be prepared for is the installation.  The rack itself, not to mention the pots it will carry, is quite heavy, and as such must be anchored into wooden structural members in the ceiling.  If you have a drop-ceiling, you can't just use heavy-duty wall anchors; the rack is likely to rip down your ceiling.  If your ceiling is concrete, you may just have to substitute some of your own hardware to allow you to anchor hooks into the concrete.  This would be adventurous, but not impossible.  A drop-ceiling, however, is probably out of the question.    This is a nice addition to my apartment.  I only hope future apartments I live in will have the right structure to put it up.

review_body: I purchased a Mitsubishi 60 inch DLP and needed a match for that size and for the wall unit confined space which I had. If I were younger and spry, it would have been easy to construct, but age and sore joints made it a little slower assembly, but all the parts were there and they fit together well.  The in process. review_body: I was excited to see these on Amazon for half the price they were at Target, but it appears you get what you pay for, and Target would have only been more of a ripoff.  First of all, I bought two, and the colors aren't even close to matching.  One is the same color as my couch, and the other is significantly lighter, making the difference very noticeable.  Second, the pieces arrived rather beat up -- a few dents, one top wasn't cut the same on both sides, and the front piece looks as though someone took a piece of sandpaper to the bottom edge.  Luckily the assembly was fairly easy; however, because the pieces didn't line up correctly, it took me over two hours to put both together, and my thumb is still throbbing.  I will say the quality of the wood appears pretty good -- it may scratch easily (time will tell), but this is definitely not plastic-covered fiberboard. Forget those ridiculous and huge box springs and foundations, it seems like you're sleeping on a bed from the middle ages. I don't understand how one could want that. product_title: Dolce 4-Shelf Folding Bookcase - Dark Walnut
review_body:
It's a sturdy product, once everything is finally whacked into place, but the color doesn't match the CD tower I bought last year from the same Furio Dolce collection. Read on for the gory details.
I bought the folding bookcase from a local Target store. When I opened the box at home, I immediately noticed it was the wrong color. It was supposed to be dark walnut, but it was closer to a dark cherry. Definitely too much red.
Normally, this might not be a problem, but I bought the dark walnut CD tower last year, and I expected the dark walnut folding bookcase to match perfectly, since it was from the same collection and carried the same brand name. I was wrong. It didn't match.
I brought it back to Target and opened up another box at the store to check the color. Again, too much cherry in my walnut. An employee opened a third box he got from the inventory in back. Same story: wrong color. I then checked the floor model's color, to make sure I wasn't seeing things, but the floor model perfectly matched all the other dark walnut pieces in the collection. Target doesn't sell floor models. Arg!
I went to a different Target location and opened another box. It, too, was more cherry than walnut. Again, the floor model matched the rest of the set perfectly. Out of curiosity I opened the CD tower box, expecting it to not match its floor model counterpart but the folding bookcase from the box. Wrong again. The CD tower from the box had the right color--the true dark walnut--and matched the floor model perfectly.
After waiting a month or so, I found a folding bookcase that is slightly darker, but still too red. It doesn't match my CD tower--with the correct dark walnut color--but I hope I can keep the two pieces far enough apart and cover up the bookcase with enough things to keep me from noticing the difference.
If I see a true dark walnut folding bookcase in the future, I'll buy it on the spot, return the dark cherry knock-off in the same box, and not feel a shred of guilt about it. If the Target customer service person asks, I'll simply tell them, "It was the wrong color." ;)
Had the color been right the first time, or even the second time, I would have given this product four stars. But it simply didn't match the rest of the set.

product_title: Alera IN48AFA10B Interval Series High-Performance Task Chair, Black Fabric
review_body: We love this chair!  Way better than our old one. I work from home so I needed something comfortable.

product_title: Comfort Research 4-Feet Diameter Large Fuf Chair Tan Twill
review_headline: Where's the stuffing in this thing?
review_body: Do not let the picture fool you.  The material it is stuffed with seems like it would be wonderful and so comfortable, but the bag is only about 1/2 full.  There is a ton of extra material and you may as well be sitting on the ground--even our 20lb dog completely sinks, so imagine how it is for an adult.  So dissappointed, and so frustrated about the work it will take to return this gigantic thing!

product_title: 5' x 8' Indoor Outdoor Rug - Contemporary Hand Hooked Rug in Brown and Sage Color
review_body: The rug is very nice as a dining room rug, then to move it out on the deck in the summer.  The price was a bit high for the size, but it is contemporary looking and matches my decor beautifully.

product_title: Winsome Wood Quilt Rack, Walnut
review_headline: Not as winsome as it might be
review_body: The \\"Winsome Wood Quilt Rack\\" comes at a good price, but the quality could be better. Mine arrived broken in two places, although the box came through just fine. It's a bit on the small side for displaying a quilt, although that's useful in tight spaces.

product_title: Zebra Narrow Stripe Pelt | Zebra Collection | Faux Fur Rug | 3 foot X 5 foot
review_body: I do not like this rug at all.  It continues to shed fuzz balls everywhere, despite daily vaccuming.  It also looks cheap, as others have commented who have seen it in my son's room.  We have to roll it up every time my 7 yr old son plays on the floor, or he is covered in fuzz balls.  I wanted to return it - I had ordered for Christmas- but missed the 7 day return time from the vendor, which was also disappointing.  So I am stuck with it and very disappointed.

product_title: LexMod Eero Saarinen Style Tulip Armchair with Yellow Cushion
review_body: This item is a nice representation of the original Knoll chair and in our price range.  We love it.  Ordered one to see what the quality was before we placed the larger order for the table and other chairs.  The chair was shipped fairly well from Lexington Modern.  The base was wrapped beautifully.  The chair should have been wrapped similarly as there was just a light piece of bubble wrap tossed over it.  The edges had rubbed slightly in the box but not too noticeable and certainly not enough of an issue to return it.  The cushion looks better in person than what is represented on the site.  I have just ordered the rest of the set.  Thank you!

product_title: Covered Recycle Bin, Stackable Plastic, One Bin (Frosted Clear) (12"H x 12.5 "W x 17.75"D)
review_body: It was sent packaged well and on time.  However, it does not stack well and it easily knocka over. The lids do not lock on so if it falls over, everything spills out.  Not happy with product.

product_title: 100% Cotton - 2 Piece Sofa Slipcover - Natural
review_body: Don't expect this to stay pristine with dogs around, but it does wash easily.  It's easy to put on.  The two piece styling stays secure on the sofa (way more than a 1 piece does) and looks beautiful.  I'm pleased.

product_title: Ribbed Mid Back Office Chair
review_body:
This product is definitely better than it deserves to be for the price. The leather is surprisingly good. My only complaint is that one of the arms was slightly loose when it arrived. I had to flip it over and get busy with an allen key to tighten it up. Tbh, it's still ever so slightly loose but not in a way that bothers me.

Give how much cheaper this is than the original product, I have to give it 4 stars. If it's paid $2,000 I would have sent it back, however...

product_title: Altra Quinton Point Bookcase with Glass Doors, Inspire Cherry
review_headline: Poor Quality Materials Cause Assembly Problems.
review_body:
We bought three glass door bookcases which arrived very quickly! However, this is where our pleasure ends.

What a frustrating time we are having putting these cases together! The first bookcase has 3 areas where the material chipped out when screws would not hold. Luckily the damaged area won't be seen after my husband glued them.

The second case collapsed on itself during construction tonight and my husband is even now gluing broken product chips that popped out with the screws. The second case has damages that are visible even after gluing. I would not buy it if it were sold as damaged goods.

I don't dare guess what the third case will look like. I'm cringing just thinking it is next to put together.

I believe the problem we are having is because of very inferior particle board. The filling is not tight and does not support the normal weight of parts as we assemble the case. Screws pop out so easily chipping the board around them. I don't know how the shelves will hold the books I plan to put in the cases.

12/21/10 I am updating my evaluation from one to two stars. All three cases are up and really look good. Any visible damage is hidden because the bookcases are up against each other. If someone buys this product as a single unit I would be very careful assembling it. The product damages very easily.

product_title: French Country 24"w Four door Tall Cabinet
review_body: I have had a lot of furniture ordered online and assembled at home, so assembling furniture is not a problem for me. But this one was a defective piece, after spending hours and hours, the cabinet still wouldn't assemble - the drawer would not fit. Without the drawer the cabinet was useless. The proportions of the drawer were not correct. Returned the product, but the shipping costs both times during order and return were wasted.

product_title: Mountain Lion Figurine
review_body: Once received this was just as high quality and detailed as I had imagined, looking at it on line.  The person that I purchased it for absolutely LOVED it!.   they are a huge out door person and love anything relative to nature. I would highly recommend this item to anyone looking for something for the out door lover or animal lover.

product_title: Target Marketing Systems 3pc Avila Dining Set
review_body: Overall, I am happy with this table.  There is one thing I need to note.  When I purchased the table, several websites listed the table top dimensions as 29.5\\" x 29.5\\" while Amazon listed it at 29.5\\" x 39.5\\".  I contacted Amazon about the discrepancy, and was told that it was my responsibility to contact the manufacturer, which I never got around to.  I ended up buying the table anyway, but the dimensions are 29.5\\" x 29.5\\".  At the time of my purchase, Amazon's description was wrong.    Now that I have the table I like it.  It comes in 2 boxes.  With the table, you have to attach the legs.  There are 2 bolts per leg (total of 8 bolts) to screw in with a supplied allen wrench.    The chairs are nice and cushioned.  Each chair comes in 3 sections:  the seat, front legs, and a long section including the back and rear legs.  Like the table, there are 8 bolts to attach with a supplied allen wrench per chair.    It's a good looking, small table that fits well in a tight space!

product_title: Linon Mission Secretrary
review_body: I was pleasantly surprised to see what a solid piece of furniture this is. It was a bit of a bear to put together - it took my husband several hours alone, and we were missing a screw so it also required a trip to the hardware store. But overall, it's great quality, solid wood, and everything lined up where it should for assembly. I love the clean, mission styling of the desk; everything else I was looking at was a little too traditional or country, unless it was very expensive custom furniture.     It has cubbies which are perfect for sorting our mail, which is why we purchased it. We use the cubbies for separating coupons, actionable mail (bills), catalogs, and the like. The drawer is perfect for notepads and pens. We put a file basket in the open cabinet below, and also store some odds and ends down there.     My only complaint is there is a strong wood grain in this piece. I couldn't tell how strong it was from the photo, but the wood is a little lighter and the grain very prominent. Overall I love it, it's nice quality, the writing desk fold down portion is sturdy, and it's just the right size for my space. Great purchase! 4/5 stars since the wood grain isn't obvious in the description/photo and for the missing screw that delayed the assembly.

product_title: Spider Plant Hanging Basket
review_body: This is the second hanging plant I have ordered from Silk Plants Plus through Amazon.com.  I was greatly pleased with both.  The Spider hanging plant is very full and beautifully arranged.  The greenery is made from rich silk and is very realistic.  They do not skimp on the baskets either.  You can also call them directly if you want a special arrangement or to find out more information.  They will go out of their way to help you in any way they can.  I called and described a small ivy table plant I needed but couldn't find.  They made one up for me and I couldn't have been more pleased with the results.  Another feature I really like is they ship their products out fast and you will receive your plant within two/three days tops.

product_title: South Shore Furniture Prairie Collection Corner Desk, Country Pine
review_body: This desk was a little larger than expected, but sturdy. My high schooler uses it for all of her school work and art work. Has a lot of shelf space. WAY too much assembly and a bit pricey for the work you have to do to assemble.

product_title: VICTORIIA DELUXE JACQUARD PRINTED 7 PIECE COMFORTER BED ENSEMBLE SET KING
review_body: This is one of the most durable products of such beauty and elegance I have found. I enjoy the softness and color,but my bedding must stand up to the large,active dogs I share my life with. Some pilling after about 30 washes.

product_title: South Shore Libra Collection 3-Drawer Chest
review_body: purchased 2 of these for my daughters room. they assembled easily and look more expensive then they are. I added a few extra paneling nails to the bottom of the drawers and the back only because I have purchased a different brand of furniture with similar construction that had issues with sagging drawers. This furniture appears to be of better quality but better safe then sorry.  All in all they look amazing and really give the room an upgrade in elegance for very little expense.

product_title: Winsome Wood TV/Media Stand with 2 Switch-able Drawers, Antique Walnut
review_body: Arrived in a timely manner and that's where to good things stopped. The directions were mostly pictures with no instructions what so ever. Still putting it together this morning after working on it several hours last night. The wood screws were the wrong ones needed. I had to go to the hardware store and fine the right ones. The holes the dowels were supposed to fit into were all, up to this point, either way too big or way too small ti fit. I even cracked one of the pieces of the table putting one into place. I am going to have to go and purchase some gorilla glue to hold them in place. This is in my opinion a waste of time and money. I would toss it in the trash if it was not given to me as a gift from my girlfriend. That's the ONLY reason that I will make it work so she will think that I like it and I won't hurt her feelings. I would not recomend this to my worst enemy !!!

product_title: Bohemian Crystal Bronze Bowl
review_body: I have tried repeatedly to buy this item. Creations selller lists it on their website as \\"for Sale.\\"  My first order from February has been cancelled by me because it should have been delivered by March 19th. It is now March 24.  Because the item is perfect for my purposes I have cancelled the first order and re-ordered the bowl.  If I don't hear from Creations and/or Amazon about this by the next deliverydate, I will have to assume this is a bogus website and file a complaint (other than this one.) I am reviewing the service of this vendor (not the item).  It is terrible.  Harriet Argento

product_title: Winsome Wood Saddle Seat Stool
review_body: These stools are the perfect height for the countertop in our kitchen.  The longer width than length makes them fit under the counter easily without being in the way of foot traffic when not in use.  They are simple to put together, and they look great.  Nice clean lines.  And not too expensive!

product_title: Twilight Seat Turtle Constellation Night Light by Cloud B
review_body: The turtle is a lot bigger than I thought it was going to be. I should have paid attention to the measurements. There are no instructions for inserting the batteries. Finely figured it out and than found out that it already came with batteries inserted. It projects very nicely and would even make a good gift for an adult. Now that I know how to get batteries into the thing, I think it will be wonderful.

product_title: King of the Rocket Men Poster B 27x40 Tristram Coffin Mae Clarke I. Stanford Jolley
review_headline: Fantastic poster for your living room!
review_body: This is a beautiful poster at a super low price and I love it. If you like camp and kitschy things, this is the product for you. Your stunned guests will not know what to say when they spot this on your wall(unless they ask you how they can get one). It was safely mailed in an atom bomb proof container. These sellers are tops.

product_title: Fasil Wood Bookcase with Doors
review_headline: Looks nice, but a nightmare to put together!
review_body: Sure it looks nice once it's together, but this was a nightmare to assemble!  The box says it takes one person 10 minutes to put together with no tools required.  It should say that it takes two people two hours and a lot of hammering.  The pieces do not slide together easily.  It took hours of pounding on them with a hammer, praying that they didn't splinter, to get them together.  If the shelves aren't pushed in all the way, then the back piece can't slide in.  I was planning to purchase more of this furniture to go with this piece, but after the experience of putting this together, I don't think I'll be buying any more items from this collection.

product_title: Sphere Chair - Pink WW Corduroy
review_body: this chair is very niceand comfortable. my 2 1/2 year old loves it. only problem is that there is no back support.

product_title: Sleep Innovations Shiloh Memory Foam Mattress
review_headline: no reading in bed b/c it's super soft
review_body: This foam mattress is extremely soft. You really sink deep into it. I can foresee difficulty sitting up and reading in this bed because of how deep one sinks into it. However, dissimilar to really cheap foam mattresses I did not sink in until it bottomed out. I am pretty darn heavy, so this is a good sign. I have not slept on it yet, mostly because of the smell and it's for a guest bedroom. My guess is the younger and lighter the sleeper the more they will like it, but the older the sleeper, they might like it, but there will be more difficulty to turning over and maneuvering in and out of bed as there is not a lot of support. When I place my hand down to push off, it just sinks from the pressure because it's so soft. The smell is very strong and made us lightheaded. I have shut it up in its room with the window open and will leave it to off-gas for about a week before I put any bedding on it so that the fabric doesn't capture the smell. As a side note, foam beds sleep hotter. The cells in the foam heat up from your body heat, like a down blanket. Update: the smell,of course, finally went away. My young adult children (20-30 somethings) LOVE this mattress when they come to stay. For the price, I moved it's star up from 3 to 4.

product_title: New Picture frame mixed set (4) 8x10 Wood frames * *
review_body: really nice frames. I was first hoping to get four light wood, but I do like it mixed. Really good quality, and not expensive at all. Shipping was not only free, but it arrieved in few days- 2 days after they shipped it.

product_title: Nutcracker Doxie dog DACHSHUND CHRISTMAS ORNAMENT new
review_body: This Hot Diggity Nutcracker Dachshund ornament is unique and cute! I have a co-worker whose grandson loves to collect anything \\"Nutcracker\\"-related, and when I gave this to her, she thought this ornament was adorable! I love dachshunds. And it was a hoot to find a Christmas-themed dachshund ornament. Raising dachshunds has ran for generations in my family. My grandmother had a dachshund, my mother as a child had a dachshund, my sister and I had a dachshund during our high school and college years. Dachshunds are my favorite dog breed, and once you have a dachshund, you treat him or her as a true member of your family, not a pet. Anyways, this Christmas ornament is light and cute, yet the details are lovely and make you laugh and smile at the same time, especially the jaw, mustache, beard, and nose part! This ornament reminds me of the time when I danced as an 8th grader as one of the Sugar Plum Fairies to the \\"Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy\\" for my junior high school's Christmas version of \\"The Nutcracker\\". For anybody who had to participate, dance, and act in \\"The Nutcracker\\" or for anybody who loves reading and watching \\"The Nutcracker\\", then this ornament is for you. And for all the Doxie lovers out there, this ornament is for you as well. My family has quite a few Hot Diggity Dog items in our house, and when it comes to making the best, most unique, and most amusing dachshund-related figurines, ornaments, etc., Hot Diggity Dog is that company! If you want to give an ornament that's funny, cute, amusing, heart-warming, and unique, then this ornament fits that bill!

product_title: Expandable Cover With This 3 Inch Thick Soft Sleeper 5.5 100% Visco Elastic Memory Foam Mattress Pad Bed Topper Overlay

product_title: Disney Cars Slip Proof Area Rug
review_body: I put this in my son's bathroom and the rug has worked out great. I was very pleased to see that the colors were just as bright as they were on the computer screen. I would buy this again.

product_title: Coaster Swivel Glider with Ottoman, Cream
review_headline: I would have chosen no stars if that had been an option

product_title: Duraflame 00647 Colorful Firelog, 5 Lb
review_headline: Burns Great.... But Where is the Color?
review_body:
I really like Duraflame logs, so much so that we don't even bother with real wood fires anymore-- it's just not worth the hassle. Of course it's not exactly the same, and you don't get as much heat... But the effect, convenience and price make up for it. I can have a nice full fire burning all night for around $2 and don't have to deal with the wood delivery, storage, splitting anymore.

The only reason I'm lowering the score is the Duraflame Colorlogs just don't have the promised effect. They work and burn just fine, but the colored flames are barely noticeable. To my eye, its just the same orange flame, with only a sliver of blue or purple here and there around the edges.

I would recommend using the normal 4 hour duraflame logs because they last longer-- at least 3.5 hours on average. I usually cut the logs in half and use a small amount of starter gel to get them burning faster. The smaller logs still give the same flame height and full burn time--at half the price. I also stick the logs in the middle of a gas-style 'concrete log set' and it looks very similar like a wood fire. We've had more than a few guests surprised that it wasn't.

product_title: DHP Square Ottoman Storage
review_body: This item partially as expected. It stores nicely and the hinges keep the lid up when you open it.  Just the fabric is what seems like it could be better material.  It doesn't wipe quite as clean, I seem smuges on it that I need to pay better attention to.  (again the fabric). product_title: Fake Artificial Aquarium Fish Tank
review_body: my 2 year old daughter loves fish! we felt she was too young for a real aquarium (mommy really didn't want something else to feed or clean up after) so we bought her this aquarium for her birthday. she absolutely loves it! the product is exactly what you see in the photos and it is exactly what is described.  the plastic fish bob and move around quite a bit in the tank, very entertaining for a child.  the only thing i would caution parents about is the tank is very heavy when filled with water and should be put somewhere a child can't knock it over, or mess around with the electrical plug, or take the lid off to get at the fish.  ours is on a table eye level to our daughter.  she can walk up to it and point at the fish, but she can't touch the tank.  i'm very happy with the tank!

product_title: New England Patriots Tom Brady Sports Poster Print Poster Poster Print, 22x34

Still have damaged goods that I can not use.  Very frustrating...

product_title: VILLAGER Bamboo Rug
review_headline: Attractive, feels nice on bare feet, perks up the room--love it!--SEE UPDATE below for problems that surfaced
review_body:
We have an old carpet we need to replace and want to replace with tile or laminates or even a nice linoleum. BUT...with the economy all wonky, we don't want to invest on the new flooring just yet. Nevertheless, the carpet has some stains and I hate the look of it, so I decided to get a bamboo rug to use as a cover for now and a room accent rug later (with new flooring in place.)

After examining the ones available here, I chose this Villager model in the 5x8 size due to the color, which matches the browns and goldens in our living room. I was a little worried that it would not suit, but I was very pleasantly surprised. It's very pretty and it does give the room a bit of freshness and pizzazz. The color is a nice, natural golden-brown with a dark brown edging. It comes rolled up in a tube and is NOT heavy, so it was easy to roll out and, ta-dah, done. Hubby likes it, too.

I love how it feels on my feet, gotta say. Pleasant sensation.

Oh, I should mention that we like to eat on tray tables in the living room (as hubby tends to come home during prime-time and we want to watch our shows together). This rug is flat enough that we can eat off the tables, no problem. It stands upright and level. Nice. So, those of you who also do the tray table thing, this model is safe.

I would add that I also bought a chocolate bamboo Anji rug in the smaller size (2x3) for the walk-in area to the living room (to catch what folks didn't wipe on the seagrass rug at the front door, also by ANJI and interestingly coarse in texture). The chocolate style is also attractive, a darker wood-brown color than the Villager, and the bamboo slats are thicker, so it crunches a bit more underfoot. The Villager is more a discreet feel underfoot. (I purposely checked the slat size in the pics and chose the Villager assuming it would have more of the flatness.)

The backing on the rug grips nicely, but not harshly on the flooring.

Re Color and Amazon Pic: I know monitors are all different, but the pic on amazon as I SEE IT ON MY PUTER shows a more faded color than the one I received. In real life, the wood is more pleasantly golden-brown and the edging is a deeper chocolately brown. The pic is in the right shading family and is accurate to the general look, but the colors are richer in real life.

Very pleased with this. If there is a problem with it as it wears on, I'll update.

UPDATE: August 2009-- Well, I wish I could report it can keep a 5-star status, but the rug has lost quite a few bits of bamboo (cracks rather more easily than I expected, given we don't have kids, are not jumping or doing exercise on it, etc). The edges have curled up a bit (prolly would be better NOT on a carpet, I think). So, while I love the look of this, the wearability is not so great. You get what you pay for? product_title: Painted glass tray, 'Green Garden'
review_body: Beautiful tray. Only drawback is that it didn't come with any form of authenticity or even say on it where it's made.

product_title: Jewelry Armoire Mirror - BLACK Frame
review_body: i had spent hours, days, weeks...searching for a jewelry box/armoire that would be large enough to fit all my jewelry (i never thought i had that much)...i didnt really have the room for a standing armoire (not to mention they are very pricey...and unattractive, imho)...i came across the jewelry armoire mirror by mirrotek...and i thought it was perfect...i already had an over-the-door mirror, so this just replaced my old $10 mirror...id have to say this is one of the best things ive bought!  i can now see all my jewelry and start wearing things i had forgotten i had...and necklaces that had been tangled together for years that now all have their own separate hooks!  i have tons of bracklets and necklaces, which is perfect...but, my one complaint is that now i feel like i need to buy more rings and earrings to fill up all the special spaces...well...not really a complaint...hehe! :)

product_title: South Shore Axess Collection Desk
review_body: The desk is made of a cheap cardboard-like material, and I'm not even sure it will be able to hold all of my books. The drawers slide on a plastic rail, the fake wood sticker finish on the cardboard is easily stained or marked up. Also, it is a child sized desk, so I would recommend it for children but not anyone over the age of 18 who needs a real desk. Overall, not a good buy.

product_title: Dazzling Contemporary Design Wenge Wood Dining Table with 4 Chairs and 2 Benches Set
review_body: I loved the look of this table, however I will caution that this table is cheaply made.  While it looks heavy and study, it is nothing more than that fake wood on the outside with wood filler on the inside.  The chairs are extremely cheap, so if you have kids or plan to use this dining set a lot, beware...it won't last long.  We hardly use this table and the fake wood is already cracking and peeling from just bumping into it walking or the vacuum cleaning bumping it.  For the price I paid for this it definitely wasn't worth it.  I don't even know if I would pay half of what I paid knowing what I know now.  Very disappointing.

product_title: Bush Furniture Midnight Mist TV Stand
review_headline: Best for TVs in the bedroom
review_body:
I needed a tall stand for my new, 40\\" Samsung LCD HDTV to place in my bedroom. Other stands out there are made for the living room and are only between 20\\" and 25\\" -- much too short for me to be able to view over my high bed.

This stand is 31\\" high and solidly constructed of metal and tempered glass. In the description it says it can accomodate a TV up to 37\\", but my Samsung is 40\\" and has a small base that fits perfectly on this stand.

I searched for about two weeks until I found this product. It suited my needs perfectly, and I would definitely recommend it. Oh, and it's packed really well. All of the parts survived shipping here to New Jersey!

product_title: Club Pack of 12 Woodland Inspirations Flying Snowman Christmas Ornaments
review_body: Bought these though in the pic they looked iffy. Good choice. Very nice looking in person and really add some cheer to the tree.

product_title: BEAUTIFUL NEW BIG WHEEL SERVING CART
review_body:
It is NOT beautiful! Wheels are so big they look comical!

On top of all the bad reviews about the product, the lack of assembly instructions and bad customer service....

The Wheels are twice too big. Double the size they should have been which makes the cart look ridiculous like junk. Larger wheels are ok... but NOT that big. They are so ridiculously oversized it looks stupid. Black tires and back leg caps should NEVER be used on something like this. These can make black marks on light colored floors and carpeting. It should have had WHITE tires for the wheels (wheels half the size). This looks like a juvenile designed it (or Homer Simpson).

This could have been a nice looking cart if they had taken the time to design it with quality parts, etched designs on the glass and quality solid polished brass with engineered fittings, white tires & caps, larger grip on the handle and complete assembly instructions with quality parts that fit properly & securely (plus spare screws, etc) and decent factory machining of the item so the parts line up and fit properly.

If they had taken the time to do it right, they could have listed it at 6 times higher than the 56 price. It does not take much effort on something like this to do a quality design with quality parts, good engineering, decent manufacturing with adequate instructions which would reduce the need for customer service interaction down to a fraction. The Mfr would be making a profit instead of cutting the price in half to get rid of stock because they threw together a piece of junk without any care for quality, design or documentation. It is obvious this Mfr thinks of nothing but profit and cheap product.

Here is an opportunity for a conscientious Mfr to create a nice heavy polished brass and etched glass serving cart using quality brass and quality parts with engineered fittings... and smaller wheels... about half that size or at least 2/3 the current size. For more than 2 years, there has not been a single decent brass serving cart available on the entire site. For less pricey versions, a lighter weight brass can be used but the brass framing should be sturdy enough with brass tubing thick walled enough not to be flimsy or bend. Acid etched glass would also look nice and should be sturdy enough to resist scratches and chipping with ground rounded edges and corners which can be removed for cleaning... heat resistant as well. Metals should not interact with each other to avoid having the screws and fittings cause corrosion. White tires, white leg caps & a porcelain handle grip about 1.25\\" diameter. Wood handles would eventually decay or develop cracks or marring so the handle should be something durable which doesn't interact with brass. It only takes a day or two to create a good set of assembly instructions to include. Lack of instructions are sheer laziness and will cost 10 times the price of the cart just to have someone responding to customers for this omission... Be sure the parts all all non-reactive metals for brass and include spares in each kit. But it is also important to choose a manufacturing plant which does quality, precision work with the fittings, cutting, drilling... using quality materials and protective packaging for shipping. The brass framing, etc., should remain a high polish without tarnishing. No one wants to clean tarnish. Then you can charge a decent fee and we would be happy to pay for a quality item which is functional and a truly beautiful serving cart which complements the decore... and would make a decent profit for the Mfr & seller as long as they don't overstock or get overly greedy. Keep it below 350est. High sales at a lower fee will bring in more profit than low sales at a high amount. Also... give it time. It takes a while before anyone notices the availability of a new specialty item unless it comes up on their screen... but once people find it... then you will notice the difference in sales... but it can take as many as 18 months for people to find a new specialty item... so combine online sales with high volume chain store sales where the public will see it.months for people to find a new specialty item... so combine online sales with high volume chain store sales where the public will see it.

product_title: Expandable Cover With This 3 Inch Thick Soft Sleeper 6.5 100% Visco Elastic Memory Foam Mattress Pad Bed Topper Overlay Made From 100% Visco Elastic Temperature Sensitive Memory Foam With Expandable Cover
review_body: I spent hours reading reviews and chose this one based on a distrusting belief that this may stand a good chance of providing me with what I want in a topper.    I realized that the number assigned to it and other *air quotations* memory foam *end air quotes* are completely exaggerated. This thing isn't heavy enough to be truly 4+ pound viscoelastic. Still, I had a belief that it would provide enough support and softness to give me better sleep. My rationale was that sleeping even 5% better would be worth the low hundred-dollars mark.    Odor was much less than expected, and I aired it out for ~36 hours anyway. I get more odor (gasoline and rancifying oil) from my foam pillow than the topper after 1.5 months of use. Product wash cut straight and sized accurately. You won't be able to fit regular fitted sheets to it, but for the benefit of better sleep you ought to stop caring about piddly nothings like sheet fitment. What are you, some sort of bed-sheet snob?    I am 30 and have moderate thoraco-lumbar scoliosis. The last few years have been uncomfortable and I have a better understanding on my back's needs. This product provides some of the support it needs. It seems better suited to back sleeping than side sleeping, although I have tried the pillow-between-the-knees trick. I get more slightly more restful sleep, but don't assume it will or will not work for YOUR back. I'm just writing my experience in hopes that someone will benefit from it.  Stop worrying about the sheets. Seriously, give it a rest.

product_title: Winsome Wood Hailey Small TV Stand
review_body: This sweet little component cabinet is a great value. I was looking for a small unit to replace my larger one. I can fit my receiver, bluray and DRV in it with no problems. It is deep enough for the cables to be hidden as well. I could have fit one more component but it would have just fit and had clearance issues opening the bluray tray.     It is designed perfectly for component width also.     This is all solid wood and the back panel has a cutout for cables in the center so both the top and bottom areas use the same hole. BTW: The shelf is not adjustable but you could probably leave it out if you wanted to.

product_title: Solar Curtain (30x81)
review_body: Purchased these to block out the sun/heat to keep my room cool during the day. These were easy to hang up and worked very well. review_body: I won an Ipad and I wanted to make sure that I had a cover for it.  This cover is funtional.  It protects my Ipad and is just the prefect size.  There are no pockets and it isn't super padded, so if you are looking for something that is SUPER protective, this isn't it.  This is good for an Ipad that sits on a shelf away from major bumps and jarring.

product_title: Sutton Black Plasma TV Center
review_headline: Good quality, set up and instructions not for faint of heart...
review_body:
I've had this for about a week now and I like it a lot. For the money, the quality is good and I like how it looks. The 5 star rating is based on those factors alone.

However, if I were also rating the quality of the set-up instructions, it would definitely be 2 stars. There are times during set-up that you must align the pieces in a certain way so that the slots for the backboards all line up, but the instructions do not cue you in to this at all. I only knew to look for it because I've set up so many of these kind of things before. So if you buy this, make sure you proceed real carefully at each step.

I am a very creative person and was able to figure out the assembly from looking at the pictures and visualizing how the parts would interact, and I put this together by myself. review_body: This table is so cute and dainty. The little drawer is a plus.  And there are carvings on the top.

product_title: 50′s Soda Fountain Table and Chairs Set by Coaster Furniture
review_headline: Looks great, but assembly is a pain
review_body: I ordered this after reading 2 really positive Amazon ratings. The table wasn't too bad to figure out assembly, but the directions were totally unhelpful. Trial and error was a better method, but it worked out fine.    The chairs, however, are very difficult to assemble. You need to do some drilling to get the seat of the chair to its frame, and there are no holes in the seat to attach it. Every chair is going to look a little different as a result. The directions are in chinglish - as if someone with a limited understanding of English translated them from Chinese. It'd be funny if they weren't so unhelpful.     Also, putting the back of the chair onto the frame was really annoying and took at least half an hour per chair. My boyfriend and I spent at least 4-5 hours assembling 6 chairs (we ordered an extra two). I was thoroughly frustrated the entire time. They look really great now, but I feel I was misled about how easy the assembly is. Be prepared to spend at least 3-4 hours if you are handy getting everything together, and stay calm because there will be some frustration with every chair. I can't give more than 3 stars to a product that looks good but is really difficult to put together.

product_title: Wood Grain Table Mate II
review_body:

The table is easily assembled in just a few minutes. It is adjustable in both height and slant. It doesn't look all that bad in the brown color--the white ones might appear to be a bit chincy. I was surprised at the heft of this table. It is well made and finished nicely. There are no sharp edges or pointy metal parts. The best thing is how the legs fit under my chair and I can have my computer positioned on the table in front of me where I can work with it easily.

The only complaint I have is with folding the table flat. It does fold flat for storage, but not all that easily. Picky, picky, picky...

product_title: Ergonomic Kneeling Posture Task Chair w/ Back & Wheels
review_body: I just bought this to replace a similar kneeling chair that I have used and loved for years. I bought this specifically for the back rest, which my last chair did not have. Overall, I love this chair, and it is a real back-saver for me. FYI: I am female/5'4\\"/120 lbs., and have long legs for my height. I'd say this chair would probably work for a small to average sized person.    Pros:     1. The back rest does provide relief and support, even though I mostly just barely touch it. I find it helps prevent the \\"slump\\" often associated with kneeling chairs. It also allows you to lean back and stretch occasionally, which is also very good for the back.    2. The seat/knee angle is comfortable, and remains constant at different heights. (Most adjustable kneeling chairs adjust the seat/knee angle as a function of adjusting the height.)    3. I like having the wheels.    4. Height adjustment is essential for a good ergonomic fit with your desk set-up, and this has a nice smooth lever for up and down.    Cons:    1. As mentioned by another reviewer, the back rest does tend to pitch the sitter forward too far. However, this is easily remedied by removing the spring and inner sleeve from the back rest adjustment assembly. Then you can just set it at the angle that suites you best.    2. While the back rest tension is adjustable with the fix described above, it still requires twisting a handle, which is a bit awkward.

product_title: 6' Capensia (Red/Green) Ficus Tree
review_body: I ordered 2 of these 6' Capensia (Red/Green) Ficus trees to fill in the corners on each side of my large living-room window.  My cat has eaten every single living plant I have ever had, so I have resorted to silk.  I have owned silk trees before, but these are the best I have every seen, especially for the price!  The tops of the leaves are green, and the backs are the muted red; coloration is exactly as the real thing.  Each tree has 2 trunks (looks and feels like real wood to me) that gently twist around each other about a half-turn.  Each \\"limb\\" has 3 branches; 1 large in the center, and a smaller \\"shoot\\" on each side.  Both trunks are loaded with limbs, and each branch is loaded with leaves making the trees really full and lush.  The limbs and branches are very sturdy, so you don't have to worry about breaking the wires inside the flexible, brown, wood-look coating (plastic? rubber?)as you bend them to your liking, and they hold whatever shape you give them.  I just popped in a movie and took my time bending the branches to shape the trees as I liked.  They arrive in a nice little basket just large enough to cover the base, but I like to put them (original basket and all) in the next-size-larger and deeper basket or box with a broader footprint to make them more stable and to match my decor, then pulled the \\"moss\\" apart and arranged it in the top of the larger basket around the base of the trees.  You may have to wait a little for these trees to arrive, but they are absolutely worth it!  I commend Silk Plants Plus for such a quality product and service, and highly recommend them to all of you other Amazonians.

product_title: Adjustable Window Screen
review_headline: Perfect in an apartment with pets
review_body: We had just bought two new kittens, but our inner city apartment gets so hot at times, we realized we needed to find a solution to allow us to open the windows. Many stores sell cheap plastic adjustable screens that look very flimsy. These screens, while very inexpensive (I bought them for around $5 each), are made of solid wood, metal, and screen, and are very well constructed. The wood isn't the most attractive, but it would be very easy to paint to match any walls, so I guess that's a plus (we just don't have any paint!). They are very sturdy. Our cats have grown up to be about 10 pounds each, and they love to sit right up against the screens to get fresh air. Never once have they bent or broke, and the cats haven't been able to do anything to damage them. Excellent product.

review_headline: A Million Dollar Look for just over a hundred bucks
review_body: This is a great product. It arrives in a small package but will make a big punch after your 5 min assembly/installation. The faux leather looks great and feels great. My boyfriend and I are VERY happy we decided to go with this type of headboard by this particular company.

product_title: Alera Strada Series Mid-Back Swivel/Tilt Chair with Black Leather Upholstery
review_body: I just received this chair from UPS.  I actually openned the box and took the pieces out, decided I had received a black chair in error.  I went back to my office and went through the process of getting a return authorization from UPS then went back to make sure the parts were back in the box correctly.  I took everything over to a window, more for warmth than light and under the bright sunlight discovered that it is a brown chair, a REALLY DARK brown chair.  So - I'm now trying to decide whether or not I keep this chair although it is too dark for what I wanted or continue through the process of getting it returned to the supplier. On the plus side, the supplier's customer service representative was very easy to work with, very pleasant and quickly gave me a UPS return authorization code.    If you like DARK BROWN, you will probably like this chair.

product_title: Replacement Bulb for SIB-200 (250w quartz) - LAMP-Q-250W
review_headline: Burned Out In A Couple of Weeks
review_body: I bought a pair of these to replace the bulbs I've been using in my studio for over a year. These burned out in a couple of weeks, and I am now back to using the original bulbs. I don't know why the old pair of bulbs has lasted so long in comparison. This leads me to believe these replacement bulbs are cheaply made and intended to be disposable. I ordered a second pair and will see how long they last. If they last a long time I'll try to remove / update this review.

product_title: Small Shofar: Sized Approx. 9-12 Inch
review_body:
Hear ye the sound of the shofar, the loud, clear blast, oh my people.

These words precede the blowing of the shofar on the high holidays of Rosh Hashonah and Yom Kippur, when the shofar is blown, calling all the Jewish people to renew their covenant with God and to do good deeds.

This is not a simple musical instrument, but one imbued with great religious overtones that have helped to sustain the Jewish people for more than 3,000 years.

It is no doubt for that reason that the Arab populace of Jerusalem in the 1920s and 30s sought to impose laws preventing the Jewish people from blowing this horn at the most sacred Jewish site, the Western Wall of the Second Temple, in Jerusalem. To those laws, the Palestinian Authority constitution seeks to return the governance of the Western Wall--and indeed all of Jerusalem and Israel--the Islamic laws that subjugate, tax, and otherwise oppress all non-Muslims under Islamic rule.

Each shofar is of course unique, and produces notes slightly different than the rest. Yet the song of the shofar is always recognizable as such. Quite simply, the horns produce one of the most haunting blasts ever heard.

--Alyssa A. Lappen

review_body: Was impressed with the condition when it arrived.  Excellent packing and pleased with product.

review_body: Good Sturdy Rocking Chair, very easy to put together, fast shipping,  Good Quality. nice classic design. I am buying this for my wife and my baby, and I am over 6 feet tall. This chair fits me fine. The seating area is about the same as a regular dinning chair.

product_title: Indoor Outdoor Rug Runner - 2.5' X 8' - Mixed-Rainbow
review_headline: Colours are not at all like the photo

I think I will probably keep it because I need the mat and I can make it work, but if you are choosing this product because of the colours you will be disappointed.
