review_body: This coat rack comes in modular pieces, so I've just used the bottom half as a rack for my headphones & microphone & other cables next to my computer -- very handy, and it looks really great. It's well made, heavy metal and sturdy. And it's easy to assemble

product_title: Traditional Style Bycast Leather Rocking Chair
review_body: looks really great in my moms house, pretty sturdy - though you have to put it together yourself - but it's not IKEA cheap - it's good stuff. Highly recommended.

product_title: Carolina Cottage Prairie Dining Table
review_body: This table has a very nice distressed look to it.  It was shipped in very well padded boxes.  Great table and chairs.  Nice heavy wood.  Very happy with it.

product_title: Renegade, The Ultimate Video Game Chair
review_body: This chair was a gift from my wife and I can't tell you how cool it is.  There is no other way to play video games once you've sat in this chair.  The speakers and vibration motors work together to match the action and help raise the tension in Halo and my other games to another level!  Although this chair is compatible with my Xbox and PS2, I can't wait until the Renegade version - it is compatible with every game system.  It is sure to be an instant addition to our living room.

product_title: 16x16 / 16 x 16 Flowery Gold - Real Wood Picture Frame - NEW .. 1.5'' wide
review_body: After trying to purchase a square frame for a picture my siblings and I had made for my mother, I was shocked that 1st Target wouldn't sell a square frame even though that is where we had the photo made (in their photo studio) or that any other store didn't have square frames. When I looked into getting one made it still would cost me over $160 for a 16x16 square frame with Plexiglas, no mat and that was with a 50% off coupon! I thought, let me try my favorite store, Amazon. Voila! I find this company. I will never buy a frame from anywhere else again. The frame was beautiful and affordable. Easy to order and arrived in a timely manner. The had the frame wrapped securely and it come with the pieces to hang it up immediately. Fantastic company, highly recommend. Extra bonus made in the USA.

product_title: Bowron Single PELT RUG 24"x36" (DARK BROWN)
review_body: The product and  shipping to me was excellent,I use this as a seat cover on a Harley,it works very well.  I would deal with this vendor and rate them on a scale 100%.

review_body: The order came within 10 days, and I ordered two.  They didn't completly match, but still looked great together.  Great look, and very light, yet sturdy to sit on.  Found the price good compared to other companies.  Many great comments from friends!  Only downside - box it shipped in slightly stuck to the cubes leaving some on the cube itself, and hard to clean.  But, not very noticable.

review_body: I've tried slip covers in the distant past with lousy results.  Decided on the basis of other reviews to give this fabric & style a try -- it's much better than my past experiences, looks neat and smooth, doesn't wrinkle or bunch up and doesn't look 'cheap.'  It was just a little cumbersome to put on, but any slip cover would be.  I'm very happy I found an interim solution and don't have to replace my loveseat just yet.

product_title: 5pc Dining Table & Chairs Set Nickel Finish
review_body: Very nice table set. Sturdy and looks good. I was hesitant to order because it is a glass table top but it looks fabulous, even in the kitchen. review_body: Easy to assemble, however some of the screws and bolts were missing. Had to call manufacturer to resupply, which they did at no cost, however, had to wait 7 days. So, had pieces of wood laying around room and an anxious 3 year old waiting for his big boy bed. Really looks nice and feels sturdy.

product_title: Lap Desk - Jumbo Sized With Clip - Blue (Black/Blue) (18.75"H x 14.5"W x 3"D)
review_headline: Good Lap Desk For Big Laptops - Recommended
review_body:
This Lap Desk is large enough to accommodate my 17\\" laptop, with room to spare. Since I work from home almost 100% of the time and sit in a recliner, this has been a real nice addition.

The padding is comfortable and provides insulation from the hot air being blown from the laptop's cooling fan.

The large surface area has indentations for holding pencils/pens and clip for hold down papers, etc. This is more useful when using the Lap Desk without the laptop.

The handle is also useful for moving it about, which is nice since this Lap Desk is good for use by passengers in the car.

The only issue is that it does tend to warp fairly easily when any weight is applied.

Overall, this is a fairly inexpensive Lap Desk that is better than expected - Recommended!

product_title: LLF LR6 LED Retrofit Bulb for 6" Recessed Lighting Housing
review_headline: Save BIG $$$ and replace your bulbs
review_body: We replaced 50 incandescent recessed bulbs with LR6's and went from over 3000 Watts to 600 Watts electricity usage in just one afternoon. Our maintenance staff will also be much happier not using 20 foot bulb pole so often!

product_title: DIRT DEVIL UPRIGHT VAC BAGLESS TOOLS ON BOARD
review_body: I think that for the price of this machine ($75 Can), this is a great vacuum.  I have gone through 4 vaccums within 2 years, all have bit the dust for no apparent reason (all eureka products too I might add).  I have low pile carpet and a dog who sheds and this vacuum seems to suck everything up right away.      I have not had any problems like the others have mentioned. Dust bunnies are sucked up and kept in place in the canister.  Sure, its loud, but what vacuum isn't? Its quite powerful and does the job. The reason why I didn'tgive it a 5 star is because the base of it is a wee bit wide for my liking and to switch it to hose is a bit of a pain, but its totally worth it.

product_title: Madison Large Trestle Desk - Antique Black
review_body: I purchased and assembled the desk myself,I love it! Much better than I thought, based on previous reviews. I have actually just purchased the same desk for my daughter at college,I hope she loves it too. My good friend purchased the very same desk at a high-end mail order company and paid more than twice the amount I paid at Target.Ilove Target

product_title: New iJoy 550 Robotic Human Touch Massage Chair Swiveling Recliner - Black with Panoramic Swivel Base
review_body: I first tried the foot massage while on vacation and when I got home a bought one a few months later and it feels really good.  When I was moving I need a chair and I wanted one that would swivel and when I saw this I new it was what i wanted.  It would have been nice in a different color but it really does the trick and doe various form of massage or you can select the type you want and even where you want it.  The other nice thing is the foot massager will plug into it so you only need to use 1 wall socket and there is a main power off switch if you are going to be away.  When people come to visit and they see it I think they kind of roll their eyes and then once they try it they are ready to get one themselves.  Especially when they find out that it does not cost that much more then a regular recliner would.

product_title: Genesis Foam/Cotton/Polyester Futon Mattress
review_body: I sleep best partially sitting up, so I use this mattress in a lounge chair position. It's thick, comfy, and yet perfectly flexible. This has been some of the best sleepin' I've had in years!

product_title: South Shore Step One Collection 5-Drawer Chest, Natural Maple
review_body: For the price I paid, I wasn't expecting anything grand but I was expecting somewhat better quality than what I got. First, it took me about 3 and a half hours of assembling this chest to discover some missing hardware that I was able to find alternates for at Lowes. Then after it was finally assembled, you can tell that holes had been slightly miss-drilled causing the entire chest to have a slight lean to the left and the drawers to sit in crooked manner. Drawers operated smoothly but any clothes or linens you may put in it will inherit a cheap wood smell to it. I would have returned the item had it not been fully assembled already. All in all, I do not recommend this product and I will probably never buy another South Shore item again.

product_title: Mission Computer Desk - Natural
review_body: A good solid desk that fit perfectly into my son's room. It was fairly easy to put together although the instructions were quite vague. If you have never put this type of furntiure together before this would be a poor one to start with. My only complaint is the packaging. It arrived looking like it had rolled down a hill. The nice UPS driver and I checked it and it looked unharmed but after it was all together I found a small damaged spot and the keyboard runner was slightly bent. I was able to push it back into alignment. I would feel better about recommending this if it were packaged better and the instructions were clearer. However, my son is very happy with it and it is quite sturdy. Plus it is inexpensive so I'll give it 4 stars.

product_title: Monterey 2 Drawer Armoire
review_body: Because the instructions are complicated, I had someone put it together for me, especially since it needs to be anchored to the wall.  It looks really great in the room and holds quite a bit.  I'm really happy with it.

product_title: Winsome Wood Wine Cabinet with Drawer and Glass Holder, Walnut
review_body: I had seen this at Bed Bath and Beyond, and Amazon had it for 20.00 less so i went with Amazon.  it looks GREAT, all the parts where there and requires few screws.  easy enough for one person to put together with a little patience.  Pros:  looks great, no visable screws or bolts, good size, drawer is plenty big for just about anything, wine cubbies are sturdy, easy assembly.  Cons: despite looking very sturdy and well built, it seems a little wobbly and is a bit top heavy.  the top piece is about 75% of the weight.  the screws that go under the middle shelf are damn near impossible to screw in all the way.    All in all i'm very pleased, and look foward to filling it up.

product_title: Michael Scott Library Chairs
review_body: I purchased this Michael Scott Library Chair in the Antique Oak color after shopping around.  This was the best deal.  It is useful, attractive and unique.  It is very easy to use and serves many purposes.

product_title: 5pc Matrix Style Black Wrought Iron Square Dining Table w/4 Chairs Set
review_body: Whatever you do, don't buy this or any other product from Vision Decor. The materials are flat-packed and my husband and I built the entire set only to find the final two cushions (to be screwed on to the chairs) didn't fit - they were one centimetre short on all sides.     The company have been absolutely useless and their customer service department are horrendous. product_title: Classic Vinyl Bean Bag Hot Pink
review_body: The chair is very reasonably priced and nice looking.  My my only complaint about it - is that its harder than I expected and not mushy at all.   I like bean bag chairs where you go to sit and you sink in...there is no sinking in to this one.  Very hard...so that is disappointing.

product_title: Full/Queen Bed Frame w/3" Glides
review_body: It was just what I needed for my mattresses. I have a queen sized bed and it adjusts perfectly. It should also work with a full sized bed.

product_title: Frenchi Home Furnishing Wooden Coat/Hat Rack Stand
review_body: I looked in several stores for a coat rack and was not satisfied with the design(s) and not willing to pay the price(s). This is perfect for my needs and very affordable. My space is limited so obtrusive racks were NOT an option. This coat rack is perfect for small spaces.  No tools required to put together.  I'm  not mechanically inclined and within 5 minutes, waaaa-laaa,  my oak finished coat rack was up and standing ready for use!

product_title: Catalina Woven Black Contemporary Rug
review_headline: good for the price; very satisfied
review_body: Plusses for this rug:    + not too heavy - easy to transport  + so far, easy to clean  + rug fabric is smooth and doesn't shed.  my experience with more expensive wool rugs is that they shed.    + this rug has been easier to clean because you can wipe up stuff that spills on it fairly easily, it's dark so it hides any potential stains, and it doesn't shed so I'm not forever picking up rug lint.  this is really important to me cause i have two little ones, one of whom still puts everything in her mouth.      minuses -  the background is black, if you have a roomba, you will have to jimmy rig it to work on this rug b/c of the way roomba cliff sensing technology works - it doesn't go on very dark surfaces, b/c it thinks it's going to fall off stairs or something.  we don't have stairs, so luckily, the we were able to fix this fairly easily.    pattern - it's a little much for me, but to be fair in my review, i didn't choose this rug and i wouldn't have chosen it based on the picture.  my boyfriend and i each liked different rugs and we ended up going with his choice.  i would say the picture is fairly true to the actual design and colors.  you have to keep in mind that this is a very dark rug so it makes the room feel heavier than our last rug.  also, the pattern is pretty busy depending on your other furniture, it could clash.      overall - for the price we are very satisfied.  so far the quality has been more than acceptable, and we are basically expecting this to be our rug until the kids get a little older and we can get something nicer.

product_title: Black Set of 3 Words Live Laugh Love
review_body: I guess I should have read the sizes but for the cost, the words are extremely small.  I can buy much larger 6 inch to 8 inch high lettering in the discount stores.  I would not recommend if you need for a mantle over a fireplace or shelving on your walls, you would not be able to read the words from a distance of more than 5 feet.

It was very \\"blocky,\\" as though seen on a computer monitor with big pixels. I have other similar rugs, and I've seen plenty of inexpensive rugs at stores, so it's not as though I'm disappointed at what everyone thinks is normal. Either the manufacturer is using the wrong picture, or it was an error and they packed the wrong rug with the wrong picture.

product_title: 4D Concepts Slate Sofa Table
review_body: We are very pleased with our puchase.  The top is true slate and very sturdy.  It works well with our existing living room decor.  Overall you can't beat it for the price.

product_title: Honey-Can-Do SRT-01603 Kids Toy Organizer and Storage Bins, White/Pastel
review_body: This organizer was super easy to set up, it looks great, fits a lot of toys and my kids can remove and put in the buckets all by themselves. A must have for a little girls' room that has way too many little toys!

product_title: 12" Therapeutic Pressure Relief Memory Foam Mattress - Queen
review_body: My husband and I have both had lower back (disc) surgery.  He has not been able to sleep well for the last few years and always wakes up stiff and sore.  We have only had this mattress for a few days but we both love it!  We have both slept through the night and are not sore or stiff in the morning.  He said it was the best nights sleep he has ever had and for the first time looked forward to going to bed.  There is a slight smell to the foam (read other reviews that say it will go away) but nothing horrible and I am very sensitive to smells. I will update this review after we have slept on the mattress for a few months.

product_title: Wireless 5-day Forecaster Desk Clock
review_body: I thought I was receiving a wood model but received a white one. Not happy about that but am dealing with it.

product_title: Lipper Kids Small Blue and White Table and Chair Set
review_body: Easy EASYYYYYY assembly! A HUGE plus in my book! Sturdy and THICK wood! It looks beautiful and so cute in my living room. I bought this for my son and daughter to eat lunch on and enjoy drawing and etc and it fits in so beautifully w/my decor in my living room. I LOVE it and will continue buying products by this brand. A++ No complaints at all.

product_title: Home Source Industries PAN20103 Pandora 5-Drawer Chest, Mahogany
review_body: the chest looks good set up, but it took forever to set up...some of the parts broke easily during set up....for the price it should be more sturdy..but i'm okay with it....i would not tell anyone else to buy it..

product_title: Carlyle Chairside End Table by Ashley Furniture
review_body: I also use this end table next to my couch. It is the perfect size for a small apartment! I also love the drink holders because it keeps me from having to run around and put coasters under my guests' drinks. I also like the pull out drawer. I stash magazines and remotes in there normally, but when I have people over I take those out and throw in a trash bag so people don't leave trash all over my living room. The only thing I noticed is that the edging on the pull out drink holder is coming off. Nothing a little super or wood glue can't fix, but just an FYI to those interested!

product_title: Old World Map Photo Globe Usa Art Poster Print - 20" X 16"
review_body: Got this to go with my Pirate -themed decor.  20 x 16 is kinda small, but this is nice high quality hard paper laminate.  At the right price too.

product_title: Red Parrot Macaw 3 Dimensional Hanging Statue Sculpture
review_body: I ordered several of these.  Amazon made it easy to shop online and the seller shipped with careful intent.......was quite pleased with my parrot.

product_title: China Garden Opus Auburn Rug Rug Size: 7'10" x 10'6"
review_body: I fell in love with the design of this rug...and the price made it even more appealing. I've had the rug for about 6 months now. My two boys (5 & 3) run all over it and it still looks brand new. I've had spills on it and it's very easy to clean. The rug is a little thick and semi-soft to walk on. Not a bad deal for the price.

product_title: Winsome Wood Adjustable Lap Tray/Desk
review_body: This is the second table I've owned.  The first was a gift.  I discovered it was perfect for my 2 year old granddaughter to use to work her 24 piece puzzles on.  So I gave mine to her and bought another one.  I find it handy for everything from a snack to writing Christmas cards.  I've never had any problem with either table and would recommend it to others.

product_title: Hazelnut 5 Drawer Dresser
review_body: This is a very nice chest.  I use it in my bedroom for extra storage, but I think it would look nice in any room.  The smaller drawers are perfect for lingerie/socks and for toiletries that would otherwise clutter my dresser.  The 2 larger milk crate size drawers are great for storing linens, towels or clothes.  Several friends have asked me if I bought it at a higher-end retailer.  The rattan panels look like bamboo and they give the chest an exotic look.  It has a nice dark finish.  The only reason I didn't give 5 stars (I say 4.5 stars) is that it was kind of a pain to put together.  But, I don't have too much experience assembling furniture so it may not be any more difficult than other chests.  So don't let that discourage you from buying this is; just pay attention to what you're doing and set aside a few hours.  If you mess up it's easy to unscrew the pieces to redo.  Also, I can't comment on shipping problems because I bought it at the store.  Love it!

product_title: Wooden Beaded Door Curtain ~ Ying Yang ~ Hand Painted ~ Fits Standard Door Way ~ Approx 31 Strands
review_body: We purchased these curtains from Amazon. The beaded curtains are hung in my daughters bedroom doorway.  The beads are threaded with string and are holding up nicely.  They have hung there for at least a month and none of the beads have broken. The bottom for the curtain is about a foot off the floor because we hung it just above the top of the door trim. The top of the curtain is wood and comes with 2 eyelets for hanging.  The ones she had before were threaded with thin gauge wire and the beads would break off leaving the wire exposed with sharp hooked points. I recommend the string beads instead of the wire.

product_title: Madison Large Trestle Desk - Antique Walnut
review_body: I am very pleased with this desk.  First of all, I was a little hesitant because of the cost of shipping, but ended up very pleased because the desk came in only 2 days!!  I immediately put it together myself without the help of my husband.  I'm using this desk for scrapbooking and it is large enough that another person could sit across from me and craft with me.  I am extremely pleased with the desk.  It is also very sturdy.

product_title: Anji Mountain AMB0651-0058 Silky Shag Area Rug, Ivory, 5 x 8-Feet
review_body: We wanted a shag rug that didn't shed and wasn't made of polyester- love the bamboo feel.  The rug is great, soft and very cool looking. The color of the ivory is whiter than I expected and though it is naturally stain resistant, after a month it is getting very dingy.    Update- we finally got this rug cleaned and it fell apart- that is, the glue holding the back on dissolved and so now there are two separate rugs. not sure how we're going to get it back together!      I would not buy this rug again- it gets very dirty and apparently can't be cleaned.

product_title: Mini 3 Tier Rack Shelf
review_body: This three tier stand is perfect for a small bathroom. It does not take up much room. However, the instructions were in chinese. I had to look at the illustration to figure out how to put it together. Overall, this is a great looking stand, and I would recommend this stand to anyone. I'm glad that I picked this stand over other stands that I've seen.

product_title: LIMITED TIME OFFER Prepac Francesca 60" Plasma LCD TV Console Black
review_body: I ordered this item on 12/14 and was assured that the item would be too me by xmas.  In fact, it was to be delivered on 12/24. On 12/24, I checked the tracking and saw that it was not due to be delivered until 1/5 and wasn't shipped until 12/24!! This had nothing to do with weather. Since I needed it by xmas, I had to cancel the order and buy a stand at Best Buy.  The seller refuses a refund and blames Amazon.  Amazon blames the seller.  Beware of buying anything from this merchant.

product_title: Construction Collection 5-pc. Twin Bed Set
review_body: I just ordered this set for my son's room and I love it!  To keep the colors from spreading in the wash I used 1/2 cup of vinegar, Woolite, gentle cycle, cold water and all the colors stayed nicely in place.  There was a little bit of fading, but not too bad.  And for the price I think it was well worth it.  My son loves it!

product_title: Summer Breeze 6-Drawer Dresser
review_body: I have this set in my son's room (with the storage bed with hutch headboard). The blue furniture contrasts so nicely with his tan walls. The \\"rubbed\\" finish looks great, makes it look more stained than painted. I couldn't be more pleased, especially for the price. I looked everywhere, and this was the cheapest kids room furniture I found that still looks cute. I don't know if South Shore has always included this in the packaging, but mine came with a matching blue touch-up pen, but we haven't had any chipping so haven't had to use the touch-up yet.

product_title: Modus Furniture Newport Bed, Cordovan
review_headline: Stylishly squeeze a king into  an upstairs bedroom in a cape cod house
review_body: Bedroom dimensions are 10.5 x 11.75 - we customized our closet and ditched a dresser, and voila we have a king bed. We specifically needed a platform for a memory foam mattress. Easy to assemble, quite sturdy, we are very pleased.

product_title: Dorel Home Products Rome Sofa Bed
review_body: This sofa is a nice size and looks pretty good in a room, but it has hardly any padding.  Might work as a bed for someone who likes a really firm mattress, but as a sofa it's uncomfortable.

product_title: TWILIGHT CULLEN CREST...WALL STICKERS DECALS WORD ART, BLACK
review_body: This product takes a little time and \\"elbow grease\\" to prepare and process, but once you have it done it is BEAUTIFUL.  Very high qualitiy with easy instructions.  If you have a \\"Twilight\\" lover in your family, they will be sure to love the look of this beautiful crest.

product_title: Frenchi Home Furnishing 3 Piece Queen Anne Style Vanity Set with Stool
review_body: I am very happy with this Vanity.  It was all i expected and i am very satified.  It was a gift for my 20 year old daughter who loved it.  It seems very sturdy and it was easy to put together...Not by me but by my husband..lol  Good Luck

review_body: I guess it was a wonderful buy for $25 as I cant find anythign worth this costing $ 25

product_title: Country Lane Pine Armoire
review_headline: A little small, but  very cute
review_body: I bought this at Target and assembled it yesterday. In the store, it was on a shelf above eye level, so it looked big. even though I had the dimensions, I still thought it would look bigger. It is a little small, but still looks very cute in our guest room. Certainly a great deal for the money. We also bought and I assembled the nightstand. I am heading out this evening to buy another nightstand and the 5 shelf book case. The headboard is on its way, as well. Once I get it all together, I think it will look great. It looks a lot like my mother's much more expensive bedroom furniture. I doubt that anyone would guess how little we paid!

product_title: Home Styles The Bedford Entertainment Stand
review_headline: Very disappointed with this TV stand
review_body: Upon opening the undamaged box containing the tv stand I discovered 4 pieces were damaged. The damage obviously happened at the factory but the pieces were shipped anyway. Two damaged pieces were shelves I could just turn around/flip upside down, but the other two (the top and front frame) were pretty bad. I did call the manufacurer and they did send replacement parts fairly quick,(10 days), But the replacement parts had a few to many blemishes also. The stand looks like it is made out of cheap plastic. Even at first glance my wife made the same comment. It is your typical made in China construction, partical board painted black. It was fairly easy to assemble but I would not buy this again.

product_title: Little Tikes Yellow and Blue Table & Chairs Set
review_headline: Cute table and chair set for toddlers and preschoolers
review_body: I bought this table and chair set for my 15 month old grandson.  The table is extremely useful, durable and lightweight.  Since it is hard plastic, it can easily be cleaned.  We use it for many purposes including putting snack foods right on the table, then rinsing it down in the sink.  The chairs have not been used yet.  They should be designed better so that they don't tip over for young children.  Overall, this is a great product and we're all happy to have it.  Can be used indoors or outdoors.

product_title: Butterfly Clothes Drying Rack
review_body: Get a different drying rack.    The plastic is cheap, in fact, it arrived broken and I had to glue it back together. The arms sometimes have trouble catching on the rods when I am setting it up. It is much less sturdy than the one I used overseas. Also, although the rods are a standard lenghth apart, if there was an extra inch it would allow for much quicker drying. (Then again, I am close to the Texas coast, so it takes a long time anyway).     Last summer in London I was introduced to the concept of letting my clothes air dry on a butterfly drying rack - as soon as I got back to the states I bought this one. Don't waste your money on this one like I did!

product_title: Office Star Work Smart Ergonomically Designed Knee Chair with Casters
review_headline: Fast shipment from Amazon, chair is little to high to knee on and typing
review_body: The picture showed in the item was the chair at its highest position, which you can not really knee on it and type in front of the desk computer. Even at its lowest position, I think it is little hard to type while kneeing on it.  I would look for an one that is more leveled on the knee pad, also the knee pad can go lower, so that I can type like setting on the charir.    This knee chair does reduce the pressure on the rear end (that is why you might look for this item), even it is not perfect. Amazon does a great job shipping it, that gets an extra star.

product_title: SounDome Bluetooth Wireless Audio Recliner
review_body: Just got my new recliner and figured ...since I'm basically a dunce with electronics, that I'd have a hard time getting it to work on blue-tooth. Nothing was further from the truth. I read the short information they sent, added the wires to the little BT unit, and poof...done. It works great, just watched a new movie I bought on dvd, and the sound was very good.The chair is comfortable and well made and a snap to put together, so I'd recommend it to anyone who doesn't plan on blasting out the neighbors but likes a private movie viewing.(the sounds good for one person but don't tell your grand-kids they can sit in another chair and watch the movie.)

product_title: Winsome Wood Timber TV Stand
review_body: This piece is worth the money.  It is a solid piece of furniture.  I only gave it four stars because one of the doors is defective, so we are waiting on a replacement.

product_title: Round Dining Table in Natural - Coaster
review_body: Great design, and this rating would be a 5 for customer service and responsiveness of CS support.  The table is solidly built; however the wood shows obvious joins on both the legs and table top.  The table will always be covered in my application, but if that's not the case for you, you may want to reconsider.  I can honestly report that the customer support staff worked quickly to resolve my lost shipment issue - further, I received my order the day I contacted them.

product_title: Folding Laptop Desk/Tray Table
review_body: I love this laptop desk because I can take it anywhere in my house.  It's light, large enough for my laptop and other papers, and I can fold up up and put it away within seconds.  I highly recommend it!

product_title: Home Star Jack & Jill Toy Chest
review_headline: Pleased with product but not worth the price...
review_body: We bought the Jack&Jill toy chest for storage in our family room. I did a large amount of research before deciding on this one. I wanted a good quaility piece that looked nice enough to have in our living space. The construction seems solid and its very attractive. The hinges open smoothly, it was easy to put together, and its able to take some abuse from an active home with 3 kids. However, immediatly after putting it together, my husband commented \\"you paid how much for that??\\" I agree with him. While its a nice piece, it is over priced. I think if I had spent alittle more time I could have found the same thing for cheaper.

product_title: Native American 8" Dream Catcher (#2905)
review_headline: Wrong Item Sent, The Green,Blue & White isn't even available!
review_body: This Dream Catcher was for my nephew in Boston, I made sure to pay close attention to the details because some of the dream catchers said \\"colors may vary\\" this item did not. When it was received instead of dark blue & green it was red,yellow and green with cheap looking dyed feathers that were light green, pale yellow & HOT PINK. I called ShopZeus & spoke with Shawn who was very polite & he said he'd take care of it & get the correct dream catcher sent by Christmas, this was 12/17/10. I thanked him & told him if all goes well no need for a call back, but it there was a problem to call me ASAP. I got no callback. Christmas came & went with no replacement dream catcher sent for my nephew & when I called Shawn 12/27/10 he said that color was no longer in stock & he had processed a refund to my card and was very sorry. He said for my inconvenience I could keep the 1st dream catcher sent. He said that color was never in stock & the colors vary. I told him at the time I bought it that was not stated in the item details, he said \\"I've updated the site & it does now\\". So now I have a ugly Dream Catcher I wouldn't give away.

review_body: This is breathtaking in everyway. What the pic doesn't show and I didn't know when I bought it. Is, the inside the mirror part lights up to a beautiful 3D of Christ on the cross. product_title: VILLAGER EBONY Bamboo Rug
review_headline: A beautiful rug that enhances and feels pleasant underfoot, no funky smell like some cheaper rugs
review_body:
I have the Villager style in 5x8, and it really does perk up a room and cover up any imperfections in your original flooring (such as an older carpet or a scuffed old floor). Instant redecoration for not that much. I think the 5x8 is a very good size for all but the largest living room areas.

The Villager style (this one) has very small bamboo slats, so it is flexible and lies nicely. We eat off tray tables and our tables have no problem standing upright and level on this rug.

If you have brights accenting your room (pinks, reds, turquoise, etc) or a black and white decor with accents, this will look great. With a red sofa, it's killer.

No strange smell, as I've noticed with less expensive rugs. The backing grips nicely, not harshly. It does have some unevenness in how it lays, but that may be cause it was all rolled up for delivery, and that may ease off eventually. Still, not a problem. It's minor.

The edging is of a nice quality, thick fabric with texture.

Really nice. Feels good on my feet. Pretties up my room. What's not to like.

BEWARE: You must choose the size, pick the one that suits you. The previous review is much older and it may have been an error back then. Don't go by the pic. Choose the size with the options bar.

enjoy...

product_title: Kings Brand Copper Finish Metal Astoria Day Bed (Daybed) Frame With Metal Slats
review_body: I'm very happy with this day bed frame, and it looks beautiful! It was very simple to put together, a little elbow grease needed.  And I liked the fact that once it was all put together, we just put the twin mattress on top and were done.  The slats for the mattress are already attached to the frame, welded on. And it has rubber stoppers which was perfect because we have hardwood floors. It was so easy to put together.  I was very pleased with this purchase.

product_title: Winsome Wood End Table/Night Stand with Door and Shelf
review_body: I am an Interior designer and do a great deal of children's rooms that we often change in a year or two. This end table was a budget oriented purchase and I am happy to say appears to be one of the more costly items. It looks high end and is a very study well constructed item. The assembly was a little tricky getting the end panel on correctly and the interior shelfs are SNUG! The product is excellent quality for the price. I would not hesitate for a moment to purchase this for future projects. Michele

product_title: Winsome Wood Wine Cabinet with French Doors, Espresso
review_body: Delivery was quicker than expected.  Product was exactly as described, beautiful wood, dark finish.  Easily fits 8-9 inch wine glasses in top, with room for short glasses underneath.  Very sturdy - an excellent addition to our home.
